      public static boolean shouldExcludeTrack(Context context, String title, String fullPath, long durationMs) {
          String safeTitle = title != null ? title.trim() : "";
          String safePath = fullPath != null ? fullPath : "";
          String lowerPath = safePath.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
  
          if (isIgnoreHiddenEnabled(context) && lowerPath.contains("/.")) {
              return true;
          }
  
          if (isFilterShortClipsEnabled(context) && durationMs > 0 && durationMs < 30000) {
              return true;
          }
  
          if (isExcludePodcastsEnabled(context) && (lowerPath.contains("/podcasts") || lowerPath.contains("/audiobooks"))) {
              return true;
          }
  
          // 1. Check user-excluded folder paths
          Set<String> excludedDirs = getExcludedFolders(context);
          for (String excluded : excludedDirs) {
              if (!excluded.isEmpty() && safePath.startsWith(excluded)) {
                  return true;
              }
          }
  
          // 2. Check WhatsApp folder paths and AUD-YYYYMMDD-WAXXXX filenames
          if (isHideWhatsAppEnabled(context)) {
              if (lowerPath.contains("/whatsapp") || lowerPath.contains("whatsapp audio")
                      || lowerPath.contains("whatsapp voice")) {
                  return true;
              }
              if (WHATSAPP_FILE_PATTERN.matcher(safeTitle).matches()) {
                  return true;
              }
              if (safePath.isEmpty() && safeTitle.toUpperCase(Locale.US).startsWith("AUD-")
                      && safeTitle.toUpperCase(Locale.US).contains("-WA")) {
                  return true;
              }
          }
          return false;
      }
  
      public static boolean isMicroSdPath(String path) {
          if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) return false;
          // Internal storage on Android is /storage/emulated/0 or /data
          if (path.startsWith("/storage/emulated") || path.startsWith("/data") || path.startsWith("/sdcard")) {
              return false;
          }
          // Removable SD cards mount under /storage/XXXX-XXXX
          return path.startsWith("/storage/");
      }

      @NonNull
      public static RouteInfo getActiveRouteInfo(Context context) {
          AudioManager am = (AudioManager) context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
          if (am != null) {
              AudioDeviceInfo[] devices = am.getDevices(AudioManager.GET_DEVICES_OUTPUTS);
              AudioDeviceInfo bestExternal = null;
  
              for (AudioDeviceInfo d : devices) {
                  int type = d.getType();
                  if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_A2DP
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_SCO
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_SPEAKER) {
                      bestExternal = d;
                      break;
                  } else if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_DEVICE
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_ACCESSORY) {
                      bestExternal = d;
                  } else if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_WIRED_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_WIRED_HEADPHONES
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_LINE_ANALOG) {
                      if (bestExternal == null) bestExternal = d;
                  }
              }
  
              if (bestExternal != null) {
                  CharSequence rawName = bestExternal.getProductName();
                  String prodName = (rawName != null && rawName.length() > 0)
                          ? rawName.toString().trim() : "";
                  int type = bestExternal.getType();
  
                  if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_A2DP
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_SCO
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_SPEAKER) {
                      if (prodName.isEmpty() || prodName.equalsIgnoreCase(Build.MODEL)) {
                          prodName = "Bluetooth Audio Device";
                      }
                      return new RouteInfo(prodName, "BLUETOOTH A2DP • WIRELESS STREAM", R.drawable.ic_headphones_24);
                  } else if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_DEVICE
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_ACCESSORY) {
                      if (prodName.isEmpty()) prodName = "External USB Audio DAC";
                      return new RouteInfo(prodName, "DIRECT USB DAC • HI-RES PCM", R.drawable.ic_headphones_24);
                  } else {
                      return new RouteInfo("Wired Headphones / AUX", "3.5MM ANALOG • ZERO LATENCY", R.drawable.ic_headphones_24);
                  }
              }
          }
  
          String model = (Build.MANUFACTURER + " " + Build.MODEL).trim();
          if (model.isEmpty()) model = "Device";
          return new RouteInfo(model + " Speaker", "INTERNAL DAC • 16/24-BIT PCM", R.drawable.ic_music_note_24);
      }
  
      public static void bindRouteViews(Context context,
                                        @Nullable TextView tvName,
                                        @Nullable TextView tvSubtitle,
                                        @Nullable ImageView ivIcon) {
          RouteInfo info = getActiveRouteInfo(context);
          if (tvName != null) tvName.setText(info.deviceName);
          if (tvSubtitle != null) tvSubtitle.setText(info.codecSubtitle);
          if (ivIcon != null) ivIcon.setImageResource(info.iconRes);

      public static AudioDeviceCallback registerLiveRouteCallback(Context context, Runnable onRouteChanged) {
          AudioManager am = (AudioManager) context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
          if (am == null) return null;
          AudioDeviceCallback callback = new AudioDeviceCallback() {
              @Override
              public void onAudioDevicesAdded(AudioDeviceInfo[] addedDevices) {
                  if (onRouteChanged != null) onRouteChanged.run();
              }
  
              @Override
              public void onAudioDevicesRemoved(AudioDeviceInfo[] removedDevices) {
                  if (onRouteChanged != null) onRouteChanged.run();
              }
          };
          am.registerAudioDeviceCallback(callback, new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()));
          return callback;
      }
  
      public static void unregisterLiveRouteCallback(Context context, @Nullable AudioDeviceCallback callback) {
          if (callback == null) return;
          AudioManager am = (AudioManager) context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
          if (am != null) {
              am.unregisterAudioDeviceCallback(callback);
          }
      }
  
      public static void showAudioOutputSwitcher(Context context) {
          RouteInfo current = getActiveRouteInfo(context);
          String[] options = new String[]{
                  "Active: " + current.deviceName + " (" + current.codecSubtitle + ")",
                  "Pair or Switch Bluetooth Device",
                  "System Sound & Output Settings"
          };
  
          new MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
                  .setTitle("Audio Output Route")
                  .setItems(options, (dialog, which) -> {
                      try {
                          if (which == 1) {
                              Intent btIntent = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_BLUETOOTH_SETTINGS);
                              btIntent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                              context.startActivity(btIntent);
                          } else if (which == 2) {
                              Intent soundIntent = new Intent(Settings.ACTION_SOUND_SETTINGS);
                              soundIntent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK);
                              context.startActivity(soundIntent);
                          }
                      } catch (Exception e) {
                          Toast.makeText(context, "Unable to open system settings on this device", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                      }
                  })
                  .setNegativeButton("Close", null)
                  .show();
      }

      private final int[] targetHeights = new int[3];
      private final Random random = new Random();
      private ValueAnimator animator;

          barColor = ContextCompat.getColor(getContext(), R.color.accent_blue);
          paint.setColor(barColor);
          paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
  
          // Convert dp to px
          float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
          barWidth = 4f * density;
          spacing = 3f * density;
          maxBarHeight = 14f * density;
      }
  
      public void animateBars(boolean play) {
          if (play && !isAnimating) {
              isAnimating = true;
              setVisibility(VISIBLE);
              if (animator == null) {
                  animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0, 1);
                  animator.setDuration(180);
                  animator.setInterpolator(new LinearInterpolator());
                  animator.setRepeatCount(ValueAnimator.INFINITE);
                  animator.setRepeatMode(ValueAnimator.REVERSE);
                  animator.addUpdateListener(animation -> {
                      // Smoothly interpolate each bar towards its randomized target height
                      float fraction = (float) animation.getAnimatedValue();
                      for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                          barHeights[i] = (int) (barHeights[i] + (targetHeights[i] - barHeights[i]) * 0.2f);
                      }
                      invalidate();
                  });
  
                  // Assign new random targets slightly less often than the update loop
                  animator.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                      @Override
                      public void onAnimationRepeat(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                          for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                              targetHeights[i] = (int) (random.nextFloat() * maxBarHeight);
                              // Ensure they don't drop to 0 so the view doesn't look empty
                              if (targetHeights[i] < maxBarHeight * 0.2f) {
                                  targetHeights[i] = (int) (maxBarHeight * 0.2f);
                              }
                          }
                      }
                  });
              }
              animator.start();
          } else if (!play) {
              isAnimating = false;
              if (animator != null) {
                  animator.cancel();
              }
              // Freeze bars at a low height when paused
              for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                  barHeights[i] = (int) (maxBarHeight * 0.15f);
              }
              invalidate();
              // Optional: setVisibility(GONE) if you want them to vanish completely when paused
          }
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
          super.onDraw(canvas);
  
          float x = (getWidth() - (3 * barWidth + 2 * spacing)) / 2f;
          float bottomY = getHeight() - (getHeight() - maxBarHeight) / 2f;
  
          for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
              float height = Math.min(Math.max(barHeights[i], maxBarHeight * 0.15f), maxBarHeight);
              float topY = bottomY - height;
  
              rect.set(x, topY, x + barWidth, bottomY);
              // Draw slightly rounded caps for a modern look
              canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, barWidth / 2f, barWidth / 2f, paint);
  
              x += barWidth + spacing;
          }
      }

  import android.app.Activity;
  import android.content.Intent;
  import com.google.android.material.bottomnavigation.BottomNavigationView;
  
  public class NavigationHelper {
      public static void setupBottomNavigation(Activity activity, BottomNavigationView bottomNav, int currentItemId) {
          bottomNav.setSelectedItemId(currentItemId);
          bottomNav.setOnItemSelectedListener(item -> {
              if (item.getItemId() == currentItemId) {
                  return true;
              }
              
              Intent intent = null;
              int itemId = item.getItemId();
              
              if (itemId == R.id.nav_library) {
                  intent = new Intent(activity, MainActivity.class);
              } else if (itemId == R.id.nav_playlists) {
                  intent = new Intent(activity, PlaylistsActivity.class);
              } else if (itemId == R.id.nav_folders) {
                  intent = new Intent(activity, FoldersActivity.class);
              } else if (itemId == R.id.nav_eq) {
                  intent = new Intent(activity, EqualizerActivity.class);
              }
              
              if (intent != null) {
                  intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NO_ANIMATION);
                  activity.startActivity(intent);
                  activity.overridePendingTransition(0, 0);
                  return true;
              }
              return false;
          });
      }

                      if (orResult != null) {
                          mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(orResult[0], orResult[1], true));
                          return;
                      }
                  }
  
                  String[] firebaseResult = callFirebaseAiSdk(rawTitle, rawArtist);
                  if (firebaseResult != null) {
                      mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(firebaseResult[0], firebaseResult[1], true));
                      return;
                  }
  
                  String[] offline = cleanOffline(rawTitle, rawArtist);
                  mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(offline[0], offline[1], false));
              } finally {
                  executor.shutdown();
              }
          });
      }
  
      private static String[] callFirebaseAiSdk(String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          try {
              GenerativeModel ai = FirebaseAI.getInstance(GenerativeBackend.googleAI())
                      .generativeModel("gemini-2.5-flash");
              GenerativeModelFutures model = GenerativeModelFutures.from(ai);
  
              String promptText = "Extract the clean song title and artist from this messy filename/tag. "
                      + "Raw Title: \"" + rawTitle + "\", Raw Artist: \"" + rawArtist + "\". "
                      + "Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format: {\"title\":\"Clean Title\",\"artist\":\"Clean Artist\"}";
  
              Content prompt = new Content.Builder()
                      .addText(promptText)
                      .build();
  
              ListenableFuture<GenerateContentResponse> future = model.generateContent(prompt);
              GenerateContentResponse result = future.get(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
              if (result != null && result.getText() != null) {
                  return parseJsonPair(result.getText().trim(), rawTitle, rawArtist);
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
          return null;
      }
  
      private static String[] callOpenRouterModel(String apiKey, String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          try {
              URL url = new URL("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions");
              HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
              conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
              conn.setConnectTimeout(5000);
              conn.setReadTimeout(7000);
              conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + apiKey);
              conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
              conn.setDoOutput(true);
  
              String prompt = "Extract the clean song title and artist from this messy filename/tag. "
                      + "Raw Title: \"" + rawTitle + "\", Raw Artist: \"" + rawArtist + "\". "
                      + "Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format: {\"title\":\"Clean Title\",\"artist\":\"Clean Artist\"}";
  
              JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
              body.put("model", "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free");
              JSONArray messages = new JSONArray();
              JSONObject msg = new JSONObject();
              msg.put("role", "user");
              msg.put("content", prompt);
              messages.put(msg);
              body.put("messages", messages);
  
              try (OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
                  os.write(body.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
              }
  
              if (conn.getResponseCode() == 200) {
                  StringBuilder resp = new StringBuilder();
                  try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                      String line;
                      while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) resp.append(line);
                  }
                  JSONObject jsonResp = new JSONObject(resp.toString());
                  String content = jsonResp.getJSONArray("choices")
                          .getJSONObject(0)
                          .getJSONObject("message")
                          .getString("content").trim();
  
                  return parseJsonPair(content, rawTitle, rawArtist);
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
          return null;
      }
  
      private static String[] parseJsonPair(String content, String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          try {
              int start = content.indexOf("{");
              int end = content.lastIndexOf("}");
              if (start != -1 && end != -1 && end > start) {
                  JSONObject parsed = new JSONObject(content.substring(start, end + 1));
                  String aiTitle = parsed.optString("title", rawTitle).trim();
                  String aiArtist = parsed.optString("artist", rawArtist).trim();
                  return new String[]{aiTitle, aiArtist};
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
          return null;
      }
  
      public static List<Song> curateSmartMix(Context context, List<Song> allSongs) {
          List<Song> mix = new ArrayList<>();
          List<Song> others = new ArrayList<>();
          for (Song s : allSongs) {
              if (s.getUri() != null && SongMetadataManager.isFavorite(context, s.getUri().toString())) {
                  mix.add(s);
              } else {
                  others.add(s);
              }
          }
          Collections.shuffle(others);
          int limit = Math.min(25, others.size());
          for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
              mix.add(others.get(i));
          }
          return mix.isEmpty() ? new ArrayList<>(allSongs) : mix;
      }
  
      private static String[] cleanOffline(String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          String title = rawTitle != null ? rawTitle : "Unknown Track";
          String artist = (rawArtist != null && !rawArtist.contains("<unknown>")) ? rawArtist : "Unknown Artist";
  
          title = title.replace("_", " ")
                  .replaceAll("(?i)\\(official.*?\\)|\\[official.*?\\]|\\(lyrics.*?\\)|\\[lyrics.*?\\]|\\(audio\\)|\\[audio\\]|\\bHD\\b|\\bHQ\\b|\\b320kbps\\b|\\b128kbps\\b", "")
                  .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                  .trim();
  
          if (title.contains(" - ")) {
              String[] parts = title.split(" - ", 2);
              if (artist.equalsIgnoreCase("Unknown Artist") || artist.equalsIgnoreCase("Unknown")) {
                  artist = parts[0].trim();
                  title = parts[1].trim();
              }
          }
          return new String[]{title, artist};
      }
  }

  # Firebase Crashlytics Android Setup Guide
  
  Important references:
  
  - Refer to the `firebase-basics` skills, particularly those for project and app setup, before proceeding.
  
  ## Project and App Setup
  
  Before you begin, ensure you have the following. If a `google-services.json` file is present, then use that Firebase project and app. Otherwise you may need to create them.
  
  - **Firebase CLI**: Installed and logged in (see `firebase-basics`).
  - **Firebase Project**: Created via `npx -y firebase-tools@latest projects:create` (see `firebase-basics`).
  - **Firebase App**: Created via `npx -y firebase-tools@latest apps:create <IOS|ANDROID|WEB> <package-name-or-bundle-id>`
  
  The `google-services.json` file must be present in the Android app's module directory. If missing, get the config using the Firebase CLI: `npx -y firebase-tools@latest apps:sdkconfig ANDROID <App-ID>`.
  
  ## Add Dependencies to Gradle Build
  
  These changes are made to your Android project's Gradle files.
  
  ### Project-level `build.gradle.kts` (`<project>/build.gradle.kts`)
  
  Add the latest version of the Crashlytics Gradle plugin to the `plugins` block. Fetch the  before adding this. 
  
  ```kotlin
  plugins {
      // ... other plugins
      id("com.google.firebase.crashlytics") version "<latest_plugin_version>" apply false
  }
  ```
  
  ### App-level `build.gradle.kts` (`<project>/<app-module>/build.gradle.kts`)
  
  1.  Add the Crashlytics plugin to the `plugins` block:
  
      ```kotlin
      plugins {
          // ... other plugins
          id("com.google.firebase.crashlytics")
      }
      ```
  
  2.  Add the Firebase Crashlytics dependency to the `dependencies` block. It is recommended to use the Firebase Bill of Materials (BoM) to manage SDK versions. Fetch the  before adding this.
  
      ```kotlin
      dependencies {
          // ... other dependencies
  
          // Import the Firebase BoM
          implementation(platform("com.google.firebase:firebase-bom:<latest_bom_version>"))
  
          // Add the dependencies for the Crashlytics and Analytics
          implementation("com.google.firebase:firebase-crashlytics-ktx")
      }
      ```
  
  
  ## Follow up Steps
  
  ### Optional: Install the NDK SDK to capture native crashes
  
  If your app uses native code (C/C++), or includes a library with native code, you can configure Crashlytics to report native crashes.
  
  App-level `build.gradle.kts` (`<project>/<app-module>/build.gradle.kts`)
  
  1.  Add the `firebase-crashlytics-ndk` dependency:
  
      ```kotlin
      dependencies {
          // ... other dependencies
          implementation("com.google.firebase:firebase-crashlytics-ndk:18.6.2")
      }
      ```
  
  2.  Enable the `nativeSymbolUpload` flag in your `buildTypes` configuration. This will automatically upload symbol files for your native code, which are required to symbolicate native crash reports.
  
      ```kotlin
      android {
          // ... other config
          buildTypes {
              getByName("release") {
                  // ...
                  firebaseCrashlytics {
                      nativeSymbolUploadEnabled = true
                  }
              }
          }
      }
      ```
  
  After these changes, Crashlytics will automatically report crashes in your app's native code.
  
  ### Required: Force a Test Crash
  
  To verify that Crashlytics is correctly installed, you need to force a test crash in the app.
  
  1.  Add code to your main activity (e.g., in `onCreate`) to trigger a crash a few seconds after app startup:
  
      ```kotlin
      import android.os.Handler
      import android.os.Looper
  
      // ... in your Activity's onCreate method or similar startup logic
      ```

  # Firebase Authentication on Android (Kotlin)
  
  This guide walks you through using Firebase Authentication in your Android app using Kotlin DSL (`build.gradle.kts`) and Kotlin code.
  
  ### 1, Enable Authentication via CLI
  
  Before adding dependencies in your app, make sure you enable the Auth service in your Firebase Project using the Firebase CLI:
  
  ```bash
  npx -y firebase-tools@latest init auth
  ```
  
   ---
  
  ### 2. Add Dependencies
  
  In your module-level `build.gradle.kts` (usually `app/build.gradle.kts`), add the dependency for Firebase Authentication:
  
  ```kotlin
  dependencies {
      // [AGENT] Fetch the latest available BoM version from https://firebase.google.com/support/release-notes/android before adding this
      implementation(platform("com.google.firebase:firebase-bom:<latest_bom_version>"))
  
      // Add the dependency for the Firebase Authentication library
      // When using the BoM, you don't specify versions in Firebase library dependencies
      implementation("com.google.firebase:firebase-auth")
  }
  ```
  
  ---
  
  ### 3. Initialize FirebaseAuth
  
  In your Activity or Fragment, initialize the `FirebaseAuth` instance:
  
  ```kotlin
  import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth
  import com.google.firebase.auth.ktx.auth
  import com.google.firebase.ktx.Firebase
  
  class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
  
      private lateinit var auth: FirebaseAuth
  
      override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
          super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
          val auth = Firebase.auth
          
          setContent {
              MaterialTheme {
                  Text("Auth initialized!")
              }
          }
      }
  }
  ```

  ```kotlin
  import android.os.Bundle

  import com.google.firebase.auth.auth

              }
          }
      }
  }
  ```
  
  ---
  
  ### 4. Check Current Auth State
  
  You should check if a user is already signed in when your activity starts:
  
  ```kotlin
  public override fun onStart() {
      super.onStart()
      // Check if user is signed in (non-null) and update UI accordingly.
      val currentUser = auth.currentUser
      if (currentUser != null) {
          // User is signed in, navigate to main screen or update UI
      } else {
          // No user is signed in, prompt for login
      }
  }
  ```
  
  ---
  
  ### 5. Sign Up New Users (Email/Password)
  
  Use `createUserWithEmailAndPassword` to register new users:
  
  ```kotlin
  fun signUpUser(email: String, password: String) {
      auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
          .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
              if (task.isSuccessful) {
                  // Sign up success, update UI with the signed-in user's information
                  val user = auth.currentUser
                  // Navigate to main screen
              } else {
                  // If sign up fails, display a message to the user.
                  Toast.makeText(baseContext, "Authentication failed.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
              }
          }
  }
  ```
  
  ---
  
  ### 6. Sign In Existing Users (Email/Password)
  
  Use `signInWithEmailAndPassword` to log in existing users:
  
  ```kotlin
  fun signInUser(email: String, password: String) {
      auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
          .addOnCompleteListener(this) { task ->
              if (task.isSuccessful) {
                  // Sign in success, update UI with the signed-in user's information
                  val user = auth.currentUser
                  // Navigate to main screen
              } else {
                  // If sign in fails, display a message to the user.
                  Toast.makeText(baseContext, "Authentication failed.", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
              }
          }
  }
  ```
  
  ---
  
  ### 7. Sign Out
  
  To sign out a user, call `signOut()` on the `FirebaseAuth` instance:
  
  ```kotlin
  auth.signOut()
  // Navigate to login screen
  ```

  package com.thando1402.auralis;
  
  import android.content.Context;
  import android.os.Environment;
  import android.os.StatFs;
  import android.text.format.Formatter;
  
  import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
  
  import java.io.File;
  import java.io.FileOutputStream;
  import java.io.PrintWriter;
  import java.io.StringWriter;
  import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
  import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
  import java.util.Date;
  import java.util.Locale;
  
  public class AuralisTelemetryManager {
  
      private static boolean initialized = false;
      private static final String CRASH_LOG_FILE = "auralis_crash_log.txt";
  
      public static void init(Context context) {
          if (initialized) return;
          initialized = true;
  
          final Context appContext = context.getApplicationContext();
          final Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler defaultHandler = Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler();
  
          Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, throwable) -> {
              saveCrashReportLocally(appContext, throwable);
              if (defaultHandler != null) {
                  defaultHandler.uncaughtException(thread, throwable);
              }
          });
      }
  
      private static void saveCrashReportLocally(Context context, Throwable throwable) {
          try {
              StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
              throwable.printStackTrace(new PrintWriter(sw));
              String timestamp = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.US).format(new Date());
              String report = "=== AURALIS CRASH [" + timestamp + "] ===\n"
                      + "RAM Used: " + getRamUsageMb() + " MB | APK Size: " + getApkSizeFormatted(context) + "\n"
                      + sw.toString() + "\n\n";
  
              File logFile = new File(SongMetadataManager.getStorageDirectory(context), CRASH_LOG_FILE);
              try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(logFile, true)) {
                  fos.write(report.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
      }
  
      private static void forwardToFirebaseIfAvailable(Throwable throwable) {
          try {
              Class<?> crashlyticsClass = Class.forName("com.google.firebase.crashlytics.FirebaseCrashlytics");
              Object instance = crashlyticsClass.getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
              crashlyticsClass.getMethod("recordException", Throwable.class).invoke(instance, throwable);
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
              // Firebase Crashlytics not yet linked via google-services.json
          }
      }
  
      public static boolean isFirebaseLinked() {
          try {
              Class.forName("com.google.firebase.crashlytics.FirebaseCrashlytics");
              return true;
          } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
              return false;
          }
      }
  
      public static File getLastCrashLogFile(Context context) {
          return new File(SongMetadataManager.getStorageDirectory(context), CRASH_LOG_FILE);
      }
  
      public static String getApkSizeFormatted(Context context) {
          try {
              String sourceDir = context.getPackageManager().getApplicationInfo(context.getPackageName(), 0).sourceDir;
              long bytes = new File(sourceDir).length();
              return Formatter.formatShortFileSize(context, bytes);
          } catch (Exception e) {
              return "Unknown";
          }
      }
  
      public static long getRamUsageMb() {
          Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
          return (runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory()) / (1024 * 1024);
      }
  
      public static class StorageSnapshot {
          public long internalTotalBytes;
          public long internalFreeBytes;
          public long internalUsedBytes;
          public int internalUsedPercent;
  
          public boolean hasSdCard;
          public String sdCardRootPath;
          public long sdTotalBytes;
          public long sdFreeBytes;
          public long sdUsedBytes;
          public int sdUsedPercent;
      }
  
      public static StorageSnapshot getStorageSnapshot(Context context) {
          StorageSnapshot snap = new StorageSnapshot();
          StatFs internalStat = new StatFs(Environment.getDataDirectory().getPath());
          snap.internalTotalBytes = internalStat.getTotalBytes();
          snap.internalFreeBytes = internalStat.getAvailableBytes();
          snap.internalUsedBytes = Math.max(0, snap.internalTotalBytes - snap.internalFreeBytes);
          snap.internalUsedPercent = snap.internalTotalBytes > 0
                  ? (int) ((snap.internalUsedBytes * 100L) / snap.internalTotalBytes) : 0;
  
          File[] extDirs = ContextCompat.getExternalFilesDirs(context, null);
          if (extDirs.length > 1 && extDirs[1] != null
                  && Environment.MEDIA_MOUNTED.equals(Environment.getExternalStorageState(extDirs[1]))) {
              snap.hasSdCard = true;
              String fullPath = extDirs[1].getAbsolutePath();
              int androidIdx = fullPath.indexOf("/Android");
              snap.sdCardRootPath = androidIdx > 0 ? fullPath.substring(0, androidIdx) : fullPath;
  
              StatFs sdStat = new StatFs(extDirs[1].getPath());
              snap.sdTotalBytes = sdStat.getTotalBytes();
              snap.sdFreeBytes = sdStat.getAvailableBytes();
              snap.sdUsedBytes = Math.max(0, snap.sdTotalBytes - snap.sdFreeBytes);
              snap.sdUsedPercent = snap.sdTotalBytes > 0
                      ? (int) ((snap.sdUsedBytes * 100L) / snap.sdTotalBytes) : 0;
          }
          return snap;
      }
  }

  package com.thando1402.auralis;
  
  import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
  import android.view.MotionEvent;
  import android.view.View;
  import android.view.animation.DecelerateInterpolator;
  import android.view.animation.OvershootInterpolator;
  
  import androidx.interpolator.view.animation.FastOutSlowInInterpolator;
  
  public final class UiAnimationHelper {
  
      public static final DecelerateInterpolator DECELERATE = new DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f);
      public static final OvershootInterpolator OVERSHOOT = new OvershootInterpolator(2.2f);
      public static final FastOutSlowInInterpolator FAST_OUT_SLOW_IN = new FastOutSlowInInterpolator();
  
      private UiAnimationHelper() {}
  
      /**
       * Attaches lightweight RenderThread spring press physics to buttons/cards.
       */
      @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
      public static void attachSpringTouch(View... views) {
          if (views == null) return;
          View.OnTouchListener listener = (v, event) -> {
              int action = event.getActionMasked();
              if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                  v.animate().cancel();
                  v.animate()
                          .scaleX(0.90f)
                          .scaleY(0.90f)
                          .setDuration(85)
                          .setInterpolator(DECELERATE)
                          .start();
              } else if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                  v.animate().cancel();
                  v.animate()
                          .scaleX(1.0f)
                          .scaleY(1.0f)
                          .setDuration(190)
                          .setInterpolator(OVERSHOOT)
                          .start();
              }
              return false;
          };
          for (View view : views) {
              if (view != null) {
                  view.setOnTouchListener(listener);
              }
          }
      }
  
      /**
       * Celebratory pop bounce for toggle buttons (Favorite, Shuffle, Repeat).
       */
      public static void pulseBounce(View view) {
          if (view == null) return;
          view.animate().cancel();
          view.setScaleX(0.80f);
          view.setScaleY(0.80f);
          view.animate()
                  .scaleX(1.0f)
                  .scaleY(1.0f)
                  .setDuration(240)
                  .setInterpolator(OVERSHOOT)
                  .start();
      }
  
      /**
       * Smoothly expands album art when playing and relaxes it slightly when paused.
       */
      public static void animateAlbumArtPlayState(View artView, boolean isPlaying) {
          if (artView == null) return;
          float targetScale = isPlaying ? 1.0f : 0.95f;
          artView.animate().cancel();
          artView.animate()
                  .scaleX(targetScale)
                  .scaleY(targetScale)
                  .setDuration(260)
                  .setInterpolator(FAST_OUT_SLOW_IN)
                  .withLayer()
                  .start();
      }
  
      /**
       * Crisp horizontal slide + crossfade when skipping tracks.
       */
      public static void animateTrackTransition(View view, boolean forward) {
          if (view == null) return;
          float offset = forward ? 28f : -28f;
          view.animate().cancel();
          view.setAlpha(0.25f);
          view.setTranslationX(offset);
          view.animate()
                  .alpha(1.0f)
                  .translationX(0f)
                  .setDuration(210)
                  .setInterpolator(DECELERATE)
                  .withLayer()
                  .start();
      }
  
      /**
       * Staggered entrance animation for cards/controls without heavy layout passes.
       */
      public static void runStaggeredEntrance(View... views) {
          if (views == null) return;
          long delay = 30L;
          for (View v : views) {
              if (v == null || v.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) continue;
              v.setAlpha(0f);
              v.setTranslationY(24f);
              v.animate()
                      .alpha(1f)
                      .translationY(0f)
                      .setStartDelay(delay)
                      .setDuration(220)
                      .setInterpolator(DECELERATE)
                      .withLayer()
                      .start();
              delay += 35L;
          }
      }
  }

  package com.thando1402.auralis;
  
  import android.content.Context;
  import android.content.SharedPreferences;
  import android.graphics.Bitmap;
  import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
  import android.net.Uri;
  import android.os.Environment;
  
  import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
  
  import org.json.JSONObject;
  
  import java.io.BufferedReader;
  import java.io.File;
  import java.io.FileInputStream;
  import java.io.FileOutputStream;
  import java.io.InputStream;
  import java.io.InputStreamReader;
  import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
  
  import java.util.Iterator;
  
  public class SongMetadataManager {
  
      private static final String PREFS_NAME = "auralis_settings";
      private static final String KEY_STORAGE_PREF = "prefer_sd_card";
      private static final String JSON_FILE_NAME = "song_metadata_edits.json";
  
      public static void setPreferSdCard(Context context, boolean preferSd) {
          SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
          prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_STORAGE_PREF, preferSd).apply();
      }
  
      public static boolean isPreferSdCard(Context context) {
          SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
          return prefs.getBoolean(KEY_STORAGE_PREF, true); // Default to SD card to save phone space
      }
  
      public static File getStorageDirectory(Context context) {
          File[] externalDirs = ContextCompat.getExternalFilesDirs(context, null);
          if (isPreferSdCard(context) && externalDirs.length > 1 && externalDirs[1] != null) {
              if (Environment.MEDIA_MOUNTED.equals(Environment.getExternalStorageState(externalDirs[1]))) {
                  return externalDirs[1]; // Physical MicroSD Card
              }
          }
          if (externalDirs.length > 0 && externalDirs[0] != null) {
              return externalDirs[0];
          }
          return context.getFilesDir();
      }
  
      private static File getStableMetadataFile(Context context) {
          File stableFile = new File(context.getFilesDir(), JSON_FILE_NAME);
          if (!stableFile.exists()) {
              // Migrate any existing JSON from external/SD directories
              File[] externalDirs = ContextCompat.getExternalFilesDirs(context, null);
              for (File dir : externalDirs) {
                  if (dir != null) {
                      File legacyFile = new File(dir, JSON_FILE_NAME);
                      if (legacyFile.exists()) {
                          JSONObject legacyJson = readFileToJson(legacyFile);
                          writeJsonToFile(stableFile, legacyJson);
                          break;
                      }
                  }
              }
          }
          return stableFile;
      }
  
      public static void applySavedEdits(Context context, Song song) {
          try {
              JSONObject allEdits = loadJson(context);
              String key = song.getUri().toString();
              if (allEdits.has(key)) {
                  JSONObject edit = allEdits.getJSONObject(key);
                  song.setTitle(edit.optString("title", song.getTitle()));
                  song.setArtist(edit.optString("artist", song.getArtist()));
                  song.setLyrics(edit.optString("lyrics", ""));
                  String coverPath = edit.optString("coverPath", "");
                  if (!coverPath.isEmpty()) {
                      File coverFile = new File(coverPath);
                      if (coverFile.exists()) {
                          song.setCustomCoverUri(Uri.fromFile(coverFile));
                      }
                  }
              }
          } catch (Exception e) {
              e.printStackTrace();
          }
      }
  
      public static void saveSongEdit(Context context, Song song, String newTitle, String newArtist, Uri pickedImageUri, String lyrics) {
          try {
              JSONObject allEdits = loadJson(context);
              String key = song.getUri().toString();
              JSONObject edit = allEdits.optJSONObject(key);
              if (edit == null) edit = new JSONObject();
  
              edit.put("title", newTitle);
              edit.put("artist", newArtist);
              if (lyrics != null) {
                  edit.put("lyrics", lyrics);
                  song.setLyrics(lyrics);
              }
  
              if (pickedImageUri != null) {
                  File savedCover = compressAndSaveCover(context, pickedImageUri, key.hashCode());
                  if (savedCover != null) {
                      edit.put("coverPath", savedCover.getAbsolutePath());
                      song.setCustomCoverUri(Uri.fromFile(savedCover));
                  }
              }
  
              song.setTitle(newTitle);
              song.setArtist(newArtist);
  
              allEdits.put(key, edit);
              saveJson(context, allEdits);
          } catch (Exception e) {
              e.printStackTrace();
          }
      }
  
      public static boolean isFavorite(Context context, String songUriKey) {
          if (songUriKey == null || songUriKey.isEmpty()) return false;
          JSONObject allEdits = loadJson(context);
          JSONObject edit = allEdits.optJSONObject(songUriKey);
          return edit != null && edit.optBoolean("favorite", false);
      }
  
      public static void setFavorite(Context context, String songUriKey, boolean favorite) {
          if (songUriKey == null || songUriKey.isEmpty()) return;
          try {
              JSONObject allEdits = loadJson(context);
              JSONObject edit = allEdits.optJSONObject(songUriKey);
              if (edit == null) edit = new JSONObject();
              edit.put("favorite", favorite);
              allEdits.put(songUriKey, edit);
              saveJson(context, allEdits);
          } catch (Exception e) {
              e.printStackTrace();
          }
      }
  
      public static void removeCustomCover(Context context, String songUriKey) {
          if (songUriKey == null || songUriKey.isEmpty()) return;
          try {
              JSONObject allEdits = loadJson(context);
              JSONObject edit = allEdits.optJSONObject(songUriKey);
              if (edit != null) {
                  edit.remove("coverPath");
                  allEdits.put(songUriKey, edit);
                  saveJson(context, allEdits);
              }
          } catch (Exception e) {
              e.printStackTrace();
          }
      }
  
      private static File compressAndSaveCover(Context context, Uri imageUri, int songHash) {
          try (InputStream in = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(imageUri)) {
              if (in == null) return null;
              Bitmap original = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(in);
              if (original == null) return null;
  
              int width = original.getWidth();
              int height = original.getHeight();
              int cropSize = Math.min(width, height);
              int xOffset = (width - cropSize) / 2;
              int yOffset = (height - cropSize) / 2;
  
              Bitmap squareCrop = Bitmap.createBitmap(original, xOffset, yOffset, cropSize, cropSize);
              if (squareCrop != original) original.recycle();
  
              int targetDim = Math.min(720, cropSize);
              Bitmap scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(squareCrop, targetDim, targetDim, true);
              if (scaled != squareCrop) squareCrop.recycle();
  
              File coversDir = new File(getStorageDirectory(context), "covers");
              if (!coversDir.exists()) coversDir.mkdirs();
  
              File outFile = new File(coversDir, "cover_" + Math.abs(songHash) + "_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".jpg");
              try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(outFile)) {
                  scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 90, out);
              }
              scaled.recycle();
              return outFile;
          } catch (Exception e) {
              e.printStackTrace();
              return null;
          }
      }
  
      private static JSONObject cachedEdits = null;
      private static long lastModifiedTime = 0;
  
      private static JSONObject loadJson(Context context) {
          File f = getStableMetadataFile(context);
          if (cachedEdits != null && f.lastModified() == lastModifiedTime) {
              return cachedEdits;
          }
          cachedEdits = readFileToJson(f);
          lastModifiedTime = f.lastModified();
          return cachedEdits;
      }
  
      private static void saveJson(Context context, JSONObject json) {
          File f = getStableMetadataFile(context);
          writeJsonToFile(f, json);
          cachedEdits = json;
          lastModifiedTime = f.lastModified();
      }
  
      private static JSONObject readFileToJson(File file) {
          if (file == null || !file.exists()) return new JSONObject();
          try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(file);
               BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(fis, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
              StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
              String line;
              while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) sb.append(line);
              return new JSONObject(sb.toString());
          } catch (Exception e) {
              return new JSONObject();
          }
      }
  
      private static void writeJsonToFile(File file, JSONObject json) {
          if (file == null) return;
          try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(file)) {
              fos.write(json.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
          } catch (Exception e) {
              e.printStackTrace();
          }
      }

      public static void autoCleanSongMetadata(Context context, String rawTitle, String rawArtist, MetadataCallback callback) {
          initFirebaseAppCheck(context);
          final String openRouterKey = getApiKey(context);
          ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
          Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
  
          executor.execute(() -> {
              try {
                  if (!openRouterKey.isEmpty()) {
                      String[] orResult = callOpenRouterModel(openRouterKey, rawTitle, rawArtist);
                      if (orResult != null) {
                          mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(orResult[0], orResult[1], true));
                          return;
                      }
                  }
  
                  String[] firebaseResult = callFirebaseAiSdk(rawTitle, rawArtist);
                  if (firebaseResult != null) {
                      mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(firebaseResult[0], firebaseResult[1], true));
                      return;
                  }
  
                  String[] offline = cleanOffline(rawTitle, rawArtist);
                  mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(offline[0], offline[1], false));
              } finally {
                  executor.shutdown();
              }
          });
      }
  
      private static String[] callFirebaseAiSdk(String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          try {
              GenerativeModel ai = FirebaseAI.getInstance(GenerativeBackend.googleAI())
                      .generativeModel("gemini-2.5-flash");
              GenerativeModelFutures model = GenerativeModelFutures.from(ai);
  
              String promptText = "Extract the clean song title and artist from this messy filename/tag. "
                      + "Raw Title: \"" + rawTitle + "\", Raw Artist: \"" + rawArtist + "\". "
                      + "Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format: {\"title\":\"Clean Title\",\"artist\":\"Clean Artist\"}";
  
              Content prompt = new Content.Builder()
                      .addText(promptText)
                      .build();
  
              ListenableFuture<GenerateContentResponse> future = model.generateContent(prompt);
              GenerateContentResponse result = future.get(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
              if (result != null && result.getText() != null) {
                  return parseJsonPair(result.getText().trim(), rawTitle, rawArtist);
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
          return null;
      }
  
      private static String[] callOpenRouterModel(String apiKey, String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          try {
              URL url = new URL("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions");
              HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
              conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
              conn.setConnectTimeout(5000);
              conn.setReadTimeout(7000);
              conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + apiKey);
              conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
              conn.setDoOutput(true);
  
              String prompt = "Extract the clean song title and artist from this messy filename/tag. "
                      + "Raw Title: \"" + rawTitle + "\", Raw Artist: \"" + rawArtist + "\". "
                      + "Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format: {\"title\":\"Clean Title\",\"artist\":\"Clean Artist\"}";
  
              JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
              body.put("model", "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free");
              JSONArray messages = new JSONArray();
              JSONObject msg = new JSONObject();
              msg.put("role", "user");
              msg.put("content", prompt);
              messages.put(msg);
              body.put("messages", messages);
  
              try (OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
                  os.write(body.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
              }
  
              if (conn.getResponseCode() == 200) {
                  StringBuilder resp = new StringBuilder();
                  try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                      String line;
                      while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) resp.append(line);
                  }
                  JSONObject jsonResp = new JSONObject(resp.toString());
                  String content = jsonResp.getJSONArray("choices")
                          .getJSONObject(0)
                          .getJSONObject("message")
                          .getString("content").trim();
  
                  return parseJsonPair(content, rawTitle, rawArtist);
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
          return null;
      }
  
      private static String[] parseJsonPair(String content, String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          try {
              int start = content.indexOf("{");
              int end = content.lastIndexOf("}");
              if (start != -1 && end != -1 && end > start) {
                  JSONObject parsed = new JSONObject(content.substring(start, end + 1));
                  String aiTitle = parsed.optString("title", rawTitle).trim();
                  String aiArtist = parsed.optString("artist", rawArtist).trim();
                  return new String[]{aiTitle, aiArtist};
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
          return null;
      }
  
      public static List<Song> curateSmartMix(Context context, List<Song> allSongs) {
          List<Song> mix = new ArrayList<>();
          List<Song> others = new ArrayList<>();
          for (Song s : allSongs) {
              if (s.getUri() != null && SongMetadataManager.isFavorite(context, s.getUri().toString())) {
                  mix.add(s);
              } else {
                  others.add(s);
              }
          }
          Collections.shuffle(others);
          int limit = Math.min(25, others.size());
          for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
              mix.add(others.get(i));
          }
          return mix.isEmpty() ? new ArrayList<>(allSongs) : mix;
      }
  
      private static String[] cleanOffline(String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
          String title = rawTitle != null ? rawTitle : "Unknown Track";
          String artist = (rawArtist != null && !rawArtist.contains("<unknown>")) ? rawArtist : "Unknown Artist";
  
          title = title.replace("_", " ")
                  .replaceAll("(?i)\\(official.*?\\)|\\[official.*?\\]|\\(lyrics.*?\\)|\\[lyrics.*?\\]|\\(audio\\)|\\[audio\\]|\\bHD\\b|\\bHQ\\b|\\b320kbps\\b|\\b128kbps\\b", "")
                  .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                  .trim();
  
          if (title.contains(" - ")) {
              String[] parts = title.split(" - ", 2);
              if (artist.equalsIgnoreCase("Unknown Artist") || artist.equalsIgnoreCase("Unknown")) {
                  artist = parts[0].trim();
                  title = parts[1].trim();
              }
          }
          return new String[]{title, artist};
      }

      /**
       * Ensures any extracted accent color is visible against dark surfaces and never pure black/white.
       */
      public static int ensureReadableAccent(int rawColor, int fallbackColor) {
          double lum = ColorUtils.calculateLuminance(rawColor);
          if (lum < 0.12) {
              // Too dark (e.g., black album cover) -> blend toward electric cyan/white
              return ColorUtils.blendARGB(rawColor, fallbackColor, 0.65f);
          } else if (lum > 0.85) {
              // Very bright white cover -> slightly tone down so it doesn't wash out
              return ColorUtils.blendARGB(rawColor, fallbackColor, 0.30f);
          }
          return rawColor;
      }

      public static void restoreLastPlayedIfIdle(Context context, MediaController controller) {

      private static void applyPaletteToMiniPlayer(
              Context context,
              Uri artUri,
              View container,
              TextView title,
              TextView subtitle,
              ImageButton btnPlayPause) {

                      int defaultAccent = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.accent_blue);
  
                      int rawDom = palette.getDominantColor(defaultCard);
                      int rawVibrant = palette.getVibrantColor( palette.getLightVibrantColor(rawDom));

      public static boolean isOnline(Context context) {
          try {
              ConnectivityManager cm = (ConnectivityManager) context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
              if (cm == null) return false;
              Network net = cm.getActiveNetwork();
              if (net == null) return false;
              NetworkCapabilities caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(net);
              return caps != null && caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET);

      public static void updateOutputLabels(Context context, TextView tvDeviceName, TextView tvCodec) {

                          codecLabel = "ANALOG 24-BIT / 96KHZ";

                          deviceTitle = !prod.isEmpty() ? prod : "External USB DAC";
                          codecLabel = "USB BIT-PERFECT DIRECT";
                          break;

  package com.thando1402.auralis;
  
  import android.content.Context;
  import android.graphics.Bitmap;
  import android.graphics.BitmapFactory;
  import android.media.MediaMetadataRetriever;
  import android.net.Uri;
  import android.os.Build;
  import android.util.Size;
  
  import androidx.annotation.ColorInt;
  import androidx.annotation.Nullable;
  import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
  import androidx.core.graphics.ColorUtils;
  import androidx.palette.graphics.Palette;
  
  import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
  import java.io.InputStream;
  
  public final class ArtworkColorHelper {
  
      private ArtworkColorHelper() {}
  
      /**
       * Loads album art reliably on Android 10/11+ (including Nokia 1.4) using:
       * 1. ContentResolver.loadThumbnail (if API >= 29)
       * 2. ContentResolver.openInputStream (downsampled)
       * 3. MediaMetadataRetriever.getEmbeddedPicture() from the audio file URI
       */
      @Nullable
      public static Bitmap loadArtworkBitmap(Context context, @Nullable Uri artworkUri, @Nullable Uri audioUri, int reqSize) {
          if (context == null) return null;
  
          // Tier 1 & 2: Try artworkUri
          Bitmap bmp = decodeUri(context, artworkUri, reqSize);
          if (bmp != null) return bmp;
  
          // Tier 3: Fallback to embedded ID3/FLAC picture from audioUri
          if (audioUri != null) {
              bmp = extractEmbeddedPicture(context, audioUri, reqSize);
              if (bmp != null) return bmp;
              bmp = decodeUri(context, audioUri, reqSize);
          }
          return bmp;
      }
  
      @Nullable
      private static Bitmap decodeUri(Context context, @Nullable Uri uri, int reqSize) {
          if (uri == null) return null;
          if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
              try {
                  return context.getContentResolver().loadThumbnail(uri, new Size(reqSize, reqSize), null);
              } catch (Exception ignored) {
              }
          }
          try {
              BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
              bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
              try (InputStream is = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
                  if (is == null) return null;
                  BitmapFactory.decodeStream(is, null, bounds);
              }
              if (bounds.outWidth <= 0 || bounds.outHeight <= 0) return null;
  
              int sampleSize = 1;
              while ((bounds.outWidth / sampleSize) > reqSize || (bounds.outHeight / sampleSize) > reqSize) {
                  sampleSize *= 2;
              }
              BitmapFactory.Options opts = new BitmapFactory.Options();
              opts.inSampleSize = sampleSize;
              opts.inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.RGB_565;
              try (InputStream is2 = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(uri)) {
                  if (is2 == null) return null;
                  return BitmapFactory.decodeStream(is2, null, opts);
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
              return null;
          }
      }
  
      @Nullable
      private static Bitmap extractEmbeddedPicture(Context context, Uri audioUri, int reqSize) {
          MediaMetadataRetriever mmr = new MediaMetadataRetriever();
          try {
              mmr.setDataSource(context, audioUri);
              byte[] data = mmr.getEmbeddedPicture();
              if (data != null && data.length > 0) {
                  BitmapFactory.Options bounds = new BitmapFactory.Options();
                  bounds.inJustDecodeBounds = true;
                  BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(data, 0, data.length, bounds);
  
                  int sampleSize = 1;
                  while ((bounds.outWidth / sampleSize) > reqSize || (bounds.outHeight / sampleSize) > reqSize) {
                      sampleSize *= 2;
                  }
                  BitmapFactory.Options opts = new BitmapFactory.Options();
                  opts.inSampleSize = sampleSize;
                  opts.inPreferredConfig = Bitmap.Config.RGB_565;
                  return BitmapFactory.decodeByteArray(data, 0, data.length, opts);
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          } finally {
              try {
                  mmr.release();
              } catch (Exception ignored) {
              }
          }
          return null;
      }
  
      /**
       * Extracts a guaranteed vibrant accent color from a Palette so UI controls and notifications
       * never turn dull grey or invisible dark black.
       */
      @ColorInt
      public static int extractVibrantAccent(@Nullable Palette palette, Context context) {
          int fallback = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.accent_blue);
          if (palette == null) return fallback;
  
          Palette.Swatch swatch = palette.getVibrantSwatch();
          if (swatch == null) swatch = palette.getLightVibrantSwatch();
          if (swatch == null) swatch = palette.getDarkVibrantSwatch();
          if (swatch == null) swatch = palette.getMutedSwatch();
          if (swatch == null) swatch = palette.getDominantSwatch();
  
          if (swatch == null) return fallback;
  
          int rawColor = swatch.getRgb();
          float[] hsl = new float[3];
          ColorUtils.colorToHSL(rawColor, hsl);
  
          // If the cover art is monochrome/grey (saturation < 0.18), use the signature accent blue
          if (hsl[1] < 0.18f) {
              return fallback;
          }
          // Boost saturation and clamp lightness for dark-theme legibility
          hsl[1] = Math.max(0.55f, Math.min(0.95f, hsl[1] * 1.15f));
          hsl[2] = Math.max(0.54f, Math.min(0.72f, hsl[2]));
          return ColorUtils.HSLToColor(hsl);
      }
  
      @Nullable
      public static byte[] compressToBytes(@Nullable Bitmap bitmap) {
          if (bitmap == null) return null;
          try {
              ByteArrayOutputStream bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
              bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 82, bos);
              return bos.toByteArray();
          } catch (Exception e) {
              return null;
          }
      }

      @NonNull
      public static RouteInfo getActiveRouteInfo(Context context) {

          if (am != null) {
              AudioDeviceInfo[] devices = am.getDevices(AudioManager.GET_DEVICES_OUTPUTS);
              AudioDeviceInfo bestExternal = null;
  
              for (AudioDeviceInfo d : devices) {
                  int type = d.getType();
                  if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_A2DP
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_SCO
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_SPEAKER) {
                      bestExternal = d;
                      break;
                  } else if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_DEVICE
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_ACCESSORY) {
                      bestExternal = d;
                  } else if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_WIRED_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_WIRED_HEADPHONES
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_LINE_ANALOG) {
                      if (bestExternal == null) bestExternal = d;
                  }
              }
  
              if (bestExternal != null) {
                  CharSequence rawName = bestExternal.getProductName();
                  String prodName = (rawName != null && rawName.length() > 0)
                          ? rawName.toString().trim() : "";
                  int type = bestExternal.getType();
  
                  if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_A2DP
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLUETOOTH_SCO
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_HEADSET
                          || type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_BLE_SPEAKER) {
                      if (prodName.isEmpty() || prodName.equalsIgnoreCase(Build.MODEL)) {
                          prodName = "Bluetooth Audio Device";
                      }
                      return new RouteInfo(prodName, "BLUETOOTH A2DP • WIRELESS STREAM", R.drawable.ic_headphones_24);
                  } else if (type == AudioDeviceInfo.TYPE_USB_HEADSET

                      if (prodName.isEmpty()) prodName = "External USB Audio DAC";
                      return new RouteInfo(prodName, "DIRECT USB DAC • HI-RES PCM", R.drawable.ic_headphones_24);
                  } else {
                      return new RouteInfo("Wired Headphones / AUX", "3.5MM ANALOG • ZERO LATENCY", R.drawable.ic_headphones_24);
                  }
              }

  import android.animation.ValueAnimator;
  import android.content.Context;
  import android.graphics.Canvas;
  import android.graphics.Paint;
  import android.graphics.RectF;
  import android.util.AttributeSet;
  import android.view.View;
  import android.view.animation.LinearInterpolator;
  
  import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat;
  
  import java.util.Random;
  
  public class EqualizerBarsView extends View {
  
      private final Paint paint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
      private final RectF rect = new RectF();
      private final int[] barHeights = new int[3];
      private final int[] targetHeights = new int[3];
      private final Random random = new Random();
      private ValueAnimator animator;
      private boolean isAnimating = false;
      private int barColor;
  
      // Values that adapt nicely to small phone screens (e.g. Nokia 1.4)
      private float barWidth;
      private float spacing;
      private float maxBarHeight;
  
      public EqualizerBarsView(Context context) {
          super(context);
          init();
      }
  
      public EqualizerBarsView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
          super(context, attrs);
          init();
      }
  
      private void init() {
          barColor = ContextCompat.getColor(getContext(), R.color.accent_blue);
          paint.setColor(barColor);
          paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);
  
          // Convert dp to px
          float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
          barWidth = 4f * density;
          spacing = 3f * density;
          maxBarHeight = 14f * density;
      }
  
      public void animateBars(boolean play) {
          if (play && !isAnimating) {
              isAnimating = true;
              setVisibility(VISIBLE);
              if (animator == null) {
                  animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0, 1);
                  animator.setDuration(180);
                  animator.setInterpolator(new LinearInterpolator());
                  animator.setRepeatCount(ValueAnimator.INFINITE);
                  animator.setRepeatMode(ValueAnimator.REVERSE);
                  animator.addUpdateListener(animation -> {
                      // Smoothly interpolate each bar towards its randomized target height
                      float fraction = (float) animation.getAnimatedValue();
                      for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                          barHeights[i] = (int) (barHeights[i] + (targetHeights[i] - barHeights[i]) * 0.2f);
                      }
                      invalidate();
                  });
  
                  // Assign new random targets slightly less often than the update loop
                  animator.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                      @Override
                      public void onAnimationRepeat(android.animation.Animator animation) {
                          for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                              targetHeights[i] = (int) (random.nextFloat() * maxBarHeight);
                              // Ensure they don't drop to 0 so the view doesn't look empty
                              if (targetHeights[i] < maxBarHeight * 0.2f) {
                                  targetHeights[i] = (int) (maxBarHeight * 0.2f);
                              }
                          }
                      }
                  });
              }
              animator.start();
          } else if (!play) {
              isAnimating = false;
              if (animator != null) {
                  animator.cancel();
              }
              // Freeze bars at a low height when paused
              for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                  barHeights[i] = (int) (maxBarHeight * 0.15f);
              }
              invalidate();
              // Optional: setVisibility(GONE) if you want them to vanish completely when paused
          }
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onDraw(Canvas canvas) {
          super.onDraw(canvas);
  
          float x = (getWidth() - (3 * barWidth + 2 * spacing)) / 2f;
          float bottomY = getHeight() - (getHeight() - maxBarHeight) / 2f;
  
          for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
              float height = Math.min(Math.max(barHeights[i], maxBarHeight * 0.15f), maxBarHeight);
              float topY = bottomY - height;
  
              rect.set(x, topY, x + barWidth, bottomY);
              // Draw slightly rounded caps for a modern look
              canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, barWidth / 2f, barWidth / 2f, paint);
  
              x += barWidth + spacing;
          }
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
          super.onDetachedFromWindow();
          if (animator != null) {
              animator.cancel();
              animator = null;
          }
      }
  }

      private void loadAndParseLyrics(String rawLyrics) {
          parsedLrcLines.clear();
          plainLyricLines.clear();
          Pattern lrcPattern = Pattern.compile("\\[(\\d{1,2}):(\\d{2})(?:\\.(\\d{1,3}))?\\](.*)");
          if (rawLyrics == null) return;
          String[] lines = rawLyrics.split("\\r?\\n");
          for (String line : lines) {
              Matcher m = lrcPattern.matcher(line.trim());
              if (m.matches()) {
                  long min = Long.parseLong(m.group(1));
                  long sec = Long.parseLong(m.group(2));
                  String msPart = m.group(3);
                  long ms = 0;
                  if (msPart != null && !msPart.isEmpty()) {
                      ms = Long.parseLong(msPart) * (msPart.length() == 1 ? 100 : (msPart.length() == 2 ? 10 : 1));
                  }
                  String text = m.group(4) != null ? m.group(4).trim() : "";
                  if (!text.isEmpty()) {
                      parsedLrcLines.add(new LrcLine(min * 60000L + sec * 1000L + ms, text));
                  }
              } else if (!line.trim().isEmpty() && !line.trim().startsWith("[")) {
                  plainLyricLines.add(line.trim());
              }
          }
      }
  
      private void updateSynchronizedLyrics(long posMs, long durMs) {
          if (tvLyricActive == null || tvLyricNext == null) return;
          if (!parsedLrcLines.isEmpty()) {
              int activeIdx = 0;
              for (int i = 0; i < parsedLrcLines.size(); i++) {
                  if (posMs >= parsedLrcLines.get(i).timeMs) {
                      activeIdx = i;
                  } else {
                      break;
                  }
              }
              tvLyricActive.setText("♪ " + parsedLrcLines.get(activeIdx).text);
              tvLyricActive.setTextColor(currentAccentColor);
              if (activeIdx + 1 < parsedLrcLines.size()) {
                  tvLyricNext.setText(parsedLrcLines.get(activeIdx + 1).text);
              } else {
                  tvLyricNext.setText("");
              }
          } else if (!plainLyricLines.isEmpty() && durMs > 0) {
              int idx = (int) ((posMs * plainLyricLines.size()) / durMs);
              idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(plainLyricLines.size() - 1, idx));
              tvLyricActive.setText("♪ " + plainLyricLines.get(idx));
              tvLyricActive.setTextColor(currentAccentColor);
              if (idx + 1 < plainLyricLines.size()) {
                  tvLyricNext.setText(plainLyricLines.get(idx + 1));
              } else {
                  tvLyricNext.setText("");
              }
          }
      }
  
      private void extractPalette(Uri artUri) {
          try (InputStream is = getContentResolver().openInputStream(artUri)) {
              if (is == null) {
                  resetPalette();
                  return;
              }
              Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeStream(is);
              if (bitmap != null) {
                  Palette.from(bitmap).generate(palette -> {
                      if (palette != null && !isDestroyed()) {
                          int defaultColor = ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.accent_blue);
                          int raw = palette.getVibrantColor(palette.getLightVibrantColor(palette.getDominantColor(defaultColor)));
                          int safeColor = PlaybackStateHelper.ensureReadableAccent(raw, defaultColor);
                          applyThemeColor(safeColor);
                      }
                  });
              }
          } catch (Exception e) {
              resetPalette();
          }
      }
  
      private void resetPalette() {
          applyThemeColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.accent_blue));
      }

      }
  
      private void syncFavoriteState(int activeColor) {

      private void syncPlayPauseState() {

      private void syncShuffleState(int activeColor) {

          if (mediaController == null || btnRepeat == null) return;
          int mode = mediaController.getRepeatMode();
          int tint = mode != Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF ? activeColor : ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_secondary);
          btnRepeat.setIconTint(ColorStateList.valueOf(tint));
      }
  
      private void syncProgress() {
          if (mediaController == null || isTracking) return;
          long pos = mediaController.getCurrentPosition();
          long dur = mediaController.getDuration();
          if (dur > 0) {
              seekBar.setProgress((int) ((pos * 1000L) / dur));
              tvTimeCurrent.setText(formatTime(pos));
              tvTimeRemaining.setText("-" + formatTime(dur - pos));
              updateSynchronizedLyrics(pos, dur);
          }
      }
  
      private String formatTime(long ms) {
          long totalSec = Math.max(0, ms / 1000);
          return String.format(Locale.US, "%d:%02d", totalSec / 60, totalSec % 60);
      }

      private void saveAndFinish() {

      private void scanMedia() {
          scanExecutor.execute(() -> {

              Uri collection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                      ? MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL)
                      : MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;

                          MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST,
                          MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
                          MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION
                      };
  
              String selection = MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC + " != 0";
  
              try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(collection, projection, selection, null, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE + " ASC")) {
                  if (cursor != null) {
                      int idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID);
                      int titleColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE);
                      int artistColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST);
                      int dataColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA);
                      int durationColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION);
                      int volumeColumn = cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Audio.Media.VOLUME_NAME);
  
                      while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                          long id = cursor.getLong(idColumn);
                          String title = cursor.getString(titleColumn);
                          String artist = cursor.getString(artistColumn);
                          String data = cursor.getString(dataColumn);
                          long duration = cursor.getLong(durationColumn);
  
                          Uri contentUri;
                          if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && volumeColumn != -1) {
                              String volName = cursor.getString(volumeColumn);
                              if (volName != null && !volName.isEmpty()) {
                                  contentUri = MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(volName, id);
                              } else {
                                  contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                              }
                          } else {
                              contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                          }
  
                          if (!AudioFilterManager.shouldExcludeTrack(this, title, data, duration)) {
                              Song temp = new Song(title, artist, contentUri, duration);
                              SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(this, temp);

      @Override
      protected void onStart() {
          super.onStart();
          SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
          final ListenableFuture<MediaController> future = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
          controllerFuture = future;
          future.addListener(() -> {
              if (future != controllerFuture || future.isCancelled() || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                  return;

              try {
                  mediaController = future.get();
                  mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                  syncMiniPlayerUI();
              } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | CancellationException e) {
                  e.printStackTrace();
              }
          }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));

      private void syncMiniPlayerUI() {
