      private void loadLocalTracks() {
          allSongs.clear();
          Uri collection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                  ? MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL)
                  : MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
  
          String[] proj = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                  ? new String[]{MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE, MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION, MediaStore.Audio.Media.VOLUME_NAME}
                  : new String[]{MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE, MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION};
  
          int favCounter = 0;
          try (Cursor c = getContentResolver().query(collection, proj, MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC + " != 0", null, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE + " ASC")) {
              if (c != null) {
                  int idCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID);
                  int tCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE);
                  int aCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST);
                  int dCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA);
                  int durCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION);
                  int volCol = c.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Audio.Media.VOLUME_NAME);
  
                  while (c.moveToNext()) {
                      long id = c.getLong(idCol);
                      String title = c.getString(tCol);
                      String artist = c.getString(aCol);
                      String data = c.getString(dCol);
                      long duration = c.getLong(durCol);
  
                      if (AudioFilterManager.shouldExcludeTrack(this, title, data, duration)) continue;
  
                      Uri uri;
                      if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && volCol != -1) {
                          String vol = c.getString(volCol);
                          uri = (vol != null && !vol.isEmpty()) ? MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(vol, id) : ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                      } else {
                          uri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                      }
  
                      Song s = new Song(title, artist, uri, duration);
                      SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(this, s);
                      allSongs.add(s);
                      if (SongMetadataManager.isFavorite(this, uri.toString())) favCounter++;
                  }
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
          if (tvFavCount != null) {
              tvFavCount.setText(favCounter + " starred tracks • Tap to play");
          }
      }

      }
  
      private void showTrackPickerDialog(String playlistName) {

      private void saveCustomPlaylist(String name, JSONArray trackUris) {
          try {
              SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_PLAYLISTS, MODE_PRIVATE);
              JSONObject root = new JSONObject(prefs.getString(KEY_JSON, "{}"));
              root.put(name, trackUris);
              prefs.edit().putString(KEY_JSON, root.toString()).apply();
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
      }
  
      private void renderCustomPlaylists() {
          if (containerCustomPlaylists == null) return;
          containerCustomPlaylists.removeAllViews();
          try {
              SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_PLAYLISTS, MODE_PRIVATE);
              JSONObject root = new JSONObject(prefs.getString(KEY_JSON, "{}"));
              Iterator<String> keys = root.keys();
              while (keys.hasNext()) {
                  String name = keys.next();
                  JSONArray arr = root.optJSONArray(name);
                  int count = arr != null ? arr.length() : 0;
  
                  LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
                  card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                  card.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_rounded_card_12dp);
                  int pad = (int) (14 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
                  card.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
                  LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                          LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                  lp.bottomMargin = (int) (8 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
                  card.setLayoutParams(lp);
  
                  TextView title = new TextView(this);
                  title.setText(name);
                  title.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_primary));
                  title.setTextSize(15f);
  
                  TextView sub = new TextView(this);
                  sub.setText(count + " tracks • Tap to play • Long-press to export .M3U");
                  sub.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_secondary));
                  sub.setTextSize(12f);
  
                  card.addView(title);
                  card.addView(sub);
  
                  card.setOnClickListener(v -> playCustomPlaylist(name, arr));
                  card.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
                      exportPlaylistM3u(name, arr);
                      return true;
                  });
                  containerCustomPlaylists.addView(card);
              }
          } catch (Exception ignored) {
          }
      }
  
      private void playCustomPlaylist(String name, JSONArray uriArray) {
          if (uriArray == null || uriArray.length() == 0) return;
          List<Song> queue = new ArrayList<>();
          for (int i = 0; i < uriArray.length(); i++) {
              String u = uriArray.optString(i, "");
              for (Song s : allSongs) {
                  if (s.getUri().toString().equals(u)) {
                      queue.add(s);
                      break;
                  }
              }
          }
          if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
              playSongQueue(queue, "Playing \"" + name + "\"");
          }
      }
  
      private void exportPlaylistM3u(String name, JSONArray uriArray) {
          try {
              File dir = new File(SongMetadataManager.getStorageDirectory(this), "playlists");
              if (!dir.exists()) dir.mkdirs();
              File m3u = new File(dir, name.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]", "_") + ".m3u");
              StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("#EXTM3U\n");
              if (uriArray != null) {
                  for (int i = 0; i < uriArray.length(); i++) {
                      sb.append(uriArray.optString(i)).append("\n");
                  }
              }
              try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(m3u)) {
                  fos.write(sb.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
              }
              Toast.makeText(this, "Exported: " + m3u.getAbsolutePath(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
          } catch (Exception e) {
              Toast.makeText(this, "Export failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
          }
      }
  
      private void playSongQueue(List<Song> songs, String toastMessage) {
          if (mediaController == null || songs.isEmpty()) return;
          List<MediaItem> items = new ArrayList<>();
          for (Song song : songs) {
              MediaMetadata.Builder meta = new MediaMetadata.Builder()
                      .setTitle(song.getTitle())
                      .setArtist(song.getArtist());
              if (song.getCustomCoverUri() != null) meta.setArtworkUri(song.getCustomCoverUri());
              items.add(new MediaItem.Builder()
                      .setUri(song.getUri())
                      .setMediaId(song.getUri().toString())
                      .setMediaMetadata(meta.build())
                      .build());
          }
          mediaController.setMediaItems(items, 0, 0);
          mediaController.prepare();
          mediaController.play();
          syncMiniPlayerUI();
          Toast.makeText(this, toastMessage, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
      }
  
      private void setupMiniPlayer() {
          if (btnPlayPause != null) {
              btnPlayPause.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                  if (mediaController != null) {
                      if (mediaController.isPlaying()) mediaController.pause();
                      else mediaController.play();
                  }
              });
          }
          if (btnPrev != null) {
              btnPrev.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                  if (mediaController != null) mediaController.seekToPrevious();
              });
          }
          if (btnNext != null) {
              btnNext.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                  if (mediaController != null) mediaController.seekToNext();
              });
          }
          View mini = findViewById(R.id.mini_player_playlists);
          if (mini != null) {
              mini.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                  startActivity(new Intent(this, NowPlayingActivity.class));
                  overridePendingTransition(R.anim.slide_up_in, 0);
              });
          }
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onStart() {
          super.onStart();
          SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
          final ListenableFuture<MediaController> future = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
          controllerFuture = future;
          future.addListener(() -> {
              if (future != controllerFuture || future.isCancelled() || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
              try {
                  mediaController = future.get();
                  mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                  syncMiniPlayerUI();
              } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | CancellationException ignored) {}
          }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onStop() {
          super.onStop();
          if (mediaController != null) {
              mediaController.removeListener(playerListener);
              mediaController = null;
          }
          if (controllerFuture != null) {
              MediaController.releaseFuture(controllerFuture);
              controllerFuture = null;
          }
      }
  
      private void syncMiniPlayerUI() {
          if (mediaController == null) return;
          MediaItem currentItem = mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem();
          if (currentItem != null) {
              CharSequence title = currentItem.mediaMetadata.title;
              CharSequence artist = currentItem.mediaMetadata.artist;
              if (miniTitle != null && title != null && title.length() > 0) miniTitle.setText(title);
              if (miniSubtitle != null && artist != null && artist.length() > 0) miniSubtitle.setText(artist);
              if (miniArt != null) {
                  if (currentItem.mediaMetadata.artworkUri != null) {
                      miniArt.setImageURI(currentItem.mediaMetadata.artworkUri);
                  } else {
                      miniArt.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_album_placeholder);
                  }
              }
          }
          if (btnPlayPause != null) {
              btnPlayPause.setImageResource(mediaController.isPlaying() ? R.drawable.ic_pause_24 : R.drawable.ic_play_arrow_24);
          }
      }

              if (textSdStorageTitle != null) textSdStorageTitle.setText("MicroSD Card (" + snap.sdUsedPercent + "% used)");
              if (textSdStorageFree != null) textSdStorageFree.setText(Formatter.formatShortFileSize(this, snap.sdFreeBytes) + " free / " + Formatter.formatShortFileSize(this, snap.sdTotalBytes));
              if (progressSdStorage != null) progressSdStorage.setProgress(snap.sdUsedPercent);
          } else {
              if (textSdStorageTitle != null) textSdStorageTitle.setText("MicroSD Card");
              if (textSdStorageFree != null) textSdStorageFree.setText("No MicroSD Detected");
              if (progressSdStorage != null) progressSdStorage.setProgress(0);
          }
      }
  
      private void showStorageAndTelemetryDialog() {
          AuralisTelemetryManager.StorageSnapshot snap = AuralisTelemetryManager.getStorageSnapshot(this);
          File crashFile = AuralisTelemetryManager.getLastCrashLogFile(this);
          boolean hasCrashLog = crashFile.exists() && crashFile.length() > 0;
  
          StringBuilder msg = new StringBuilder();
          msg.append("• Phone Free Space: ").append(Formatter.formatShortFileSize(this, snap.internalFreeBytes))

          msg.append("• MicroSD Card: ").append(snap.hasSdCard ? Formatter.formatShortFileSize(this, snap.sdFreeBytes) + " free / " + Formatter.formatShortFileSize(this, snap.sdTotalBytes) : "Not Detected").append("\n");
          msg.append("• Indexed Audio Footprint: ").append(Formatter.formatShortFileSize(this, totalAudioBytes)).append("\n");
          msg.append("• Auralis APK Binary Size: ").append(AuralisTelemetryManager.getApkSizeFormatted(this)).append("\n");
          msg.append("• Active RAM Heap Usage: ").append(AuralisTelemetryManager.getRamUsageMb()).append(" MB / 45 MB Cap\n");
          msg.append("• Edits & Cover Storage Path:\n  ").append(SongMetadataManager.getStorageDirectory(this).getAbsolutePath()).append("\n");
          msg.append("• Crash Telemetry: ").append(AuralisTelemetryManager.isFirebaseLinked()
                  ? "Firebase Crashlytics + Local SD Log"
                  : "Local SD Crash Guard Active").append("\n");
          msg.append("• Recorded Crashes: ").append(hasCrashLog ? "Yes (Saved to log)" : "0 crashes recorded");
  
          boolean preferSd = SongMetadataManager.isPreferSdCard(this);
  
          new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                  .setTitle("Storage & Crash Telemetry")
                  .setMessage(msg.toString())
                  .setPositiveButton(preferSd ? "Switch Cache to Internal" : "Switch Cache to MicroSD", (d, w) -> {
                      SongMetadataManager.setPreferSdCard(this, !preferSd);
                      updateStorageCardUI();
                      Toast.makeText(this, "Storage preference updated", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                  })
                  .setNeutralButton("Filter Settings", (d, w) -> {
                      boolean currentlyHiding = AudioFilterManager.isHideWhatsAppEnabled(this);
                      new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                              .setTitle("Filter Settings")
                              .setItems(new String[]{
                                      currentlyHiding ? "Show WhatsApp Audio" : "Hide WhatsApp Audio",
                                      "Restore Hidden Folders"
                              }, (dialog, which) -> {
                                  if (which == 0) {
                                      AudioFilterManager.setHideWhatsAppEnabled(this, !currentlyHiding);
                                      scanStorageAndAudioFolders();
                                  } else if (which == 1) {
                                      AudioFilterManager.clearExcludedFolders(this);
                                      scanStorageAndAudioFolders();
                                      Toast.makeText(this, "Hidden folders restored", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                                  }
                              }).show();
                  })
                  .setNegativeButton("Close", null)
                  .show();

      private void scanStorageAndAudioFolders() {
          updateStorageCardUI();
          Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());
  
          scanExecutor.execute(() -> {
              Map<String, List<Song>> groupedSongs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
              Map<String, Long> groupedBytes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
              long audioBytesSum = 0;
  
              Uri collection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q ?
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL) :
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
  
              String[] projection = new String[]{
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID,
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST,
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION,
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.SIZE,
                      MediaStore.MediaColumns.VOLUME_NAME
              };
  
              String selection = MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC + " != 0";
              String sortOrder = MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE + " ASC";
  
              try (Cursor cursor = getApplicationContext().getContentResolver().query(
                      collection, projection, selection, null, sortOrder)) {
                  if (cursor != null) {
                      int idCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID);
                      int titleCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE);
                      int artistCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST);
                      int durCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION);
                      int dataCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA);
                      int sizeCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.SIZE);
                      int volumeCol = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q ? cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.MediaColumns.VOLUME_NAME) : -1;
  
                      while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                          long id = cursor.getLong(idCol);
                          String title = cursor.getString(titleCol);
                          String artist = cursor.getString(artistCol);
                          long duration = cursor.getLong(durCol);
                          String fullPath = cursor.getString(dataCol);
                          long fileSize = cursor.getLong(sizeCol);
                          
                          if (AudioFilterManager.shouldExcludeTrack(FoldersActivity.this, title, fullPath)) continue;
  
                          audioBytesSum += Math.max(0, fileSize);
                          
                          Uri contentUri;
                          if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && volumeCol != -1) {
                              String volumeName = cursor.getString(volumeCol);
                              if (volumeName != null && !volumeName.isEmpty()) {
                                  contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                                          MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(volumeName), id);
                              } else {
                                  contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                                          MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, id);
                              }
                          } else {
                              contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                                      MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, id);
                          }
                          
                          if (title == null || title.isEmpty()) title = "Unknown Track";
                          if (artist == null || artist.isEmpty()) artist = "Unknown Artist";
  
                          Song song = new Song(title, artist, contentUri, duration);
                          SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(FoldersActivity.this, song);
  
                          String parentPath = "/storage/Music";
                          if (fullPath != null) {
                              File f = new File(fullPath);
                              if (f.getParent() != null) parentPath = f.getParent();
                          }
  
                          groupedSongs.computeIfAbsent(parentPath, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(song);
                          groupedBytes.put(parentPath, groupedBytes.getOrDefault(parentPath, 0L) + Math.max(0, fileSize));
                      }
                  }
              } catch (Exception e) {
                  e.printStackTrace();
              }
  
              final long finalAudioBytes = audioBytesSum;
              handler.post(() -> {
                  if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                  totalAudioBytes = finalAudioBytes;
                  folderSongsMap.clear();
                  folderSongsMap.putAll(groupedSongs);
                  folderBytesMap.clear();
                  folderBytesMap.putAll(groupedBytes);
  
                  updateStorageCardUI();
                  sortAndRender();
              });
          });
      }
  
      private void sortAndRender() {
          allFolders.clear();
          for (Map.Entry<String, List<Song>> entry : folderSongsMap.entrySet()) {
              String path = entry.getKey();
              String rawName = new File(path).getName();
              if (rawName.isEmpty()) rawName = path;
  
              String badge = AudioFilterManager.isMicroSdPath(path) ? "[MicroSD] " : "[Phone] ";
              long bytes = folderBytesMap.getOrDefault(path, 0L);
              allFolders.add(new FolderItem(badge + rawName, path, entry.getValue().size(), bytes));
          }
  
          if (sortByName) {
              Collections.sort(allFolders, (a, b) -> a.getName().compareToIgnoreCase(b.getName()));
          } else {
              Collections.sort(allFolders, (a, b) -> Long.compare(b.getTotalBytes(), a.getTotalBytes()));
          }
  
          renderCurrentDirectoryState();
      }
  
      private void renderCurrentDirectoryState() {
          if (selectedFolderPath == null) {
              // Root view: show all audio directories, and show all tracks below
              textBreadcrumbs.setText("All Storage  >  Audio Directories");
              if (textDirectoriesHeader != null) {
                  textDirectoriesHeader.setText("AUDIO DIRECTORIES (" + allFolders.size() + ") • Long-press to hide");
                  textDirectoriesHeader.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
              }
              recyclerFolders.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
              if (textLooseFilesHeader != null) textLooseFilesHeader.setVisibility(View.GONE);
              recyclerLooseFiles.setVisibility(View.GONE);
              
              recyclerFolders.setAdapter(new FolderAdapter(allFolders, new FolderAdapter.OnFolderClickListener() {
                  @Override
                  public void onFolderClick(FolderItem folder) {
                      selectedFolderPath = folder.getPath();
                      renderCurrentDirectoryState();
                  }
  
                  @Override
                  public void onFolderLongClick(FolderItem folder) {
                      new AlertDialog.Builder(FoldersActivity.this)
                              .setTitle("Hide Folder")
                              .setMessage("Hide this folder from Auralis Library & Folders?")
                              .setPositiveButton("Hide", (dialog, which) -> {
                                  AudioFilterManager.addExcludedFolder(FoldersActivity.this, folder.getPath());
                                  scanStorageAndAudioFolders();
                              })
                              .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                              .show();
                  }
              }));
          } else {
              // Inside a specific folder
              String folderName = new File(selectedFolderPath).getName();
              textBreadcrumbs.setText("Storage  >  " + folderName);
              if (textDirectoriesHeader != null) {
                  textDirectoriesHeader.setVisibility(View.GONE);
              }
              recyclerFolders.setVisibility(View.GONE);
  
              if (textLooseFilesHeader != null) {
                  textLooseFilesHeader.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                  textLooseFilesHeader.setText("FILES IN " + folderName.toUpperCase());
              }
              recyclerLooseFiles.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
              
              List<Song> folderSongs = folderSongsMap.getOrDefault(selectedFolderPath, new ArrayList<>());
              bindSongsList(folderSongs);
          }
      }
  
      private void bindSongsList(List<Song> songs) {
          SongAdapter adapter = new SongAdapter(songs, new SongAdapter.OnSongClickListener() {
              @Override
              public void onSongClick(int position) {
                  if (mediaController != null) {
                      mediaController.clearMediaItems();
                      for (Song s : songs) {
                          MediaMetadata.Builder meta = new MediaMetadata.Builder()
                                  .setTitle(s.getTitle())
                                  .setArtist(s.getArtist());
                          if (s.getCustomCoverUri() != null) meta.setArtworkUri(s.getCustomCoverUri());
                          mediaController.addMediaItem(new MediaItem.Builder()
                                  .setUri(s.getUri())
                                  .setMediaId(s.getUri().toString())
                                  .setMediaMetadata(meta.build())
                                  .build());
                      }
                      mediaController.seekToDefaultPosition(position);
                      mediaController.prepare();
                      mediaController.play();
                  }
              }
  
              @Override
              public void onSongOptionsClick(int position) {
                  Song s = songs.get(position);
                  Intent intent = new Intent(FoldersActivity.this, EditTrackActivity.class);
                  intent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_URI", s.getUri().toString());
                  intent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_TITLE", s.getTitle());
                  intent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_ARTIST", s.getArtist());
                  startActivity(intent);
              }
          });
          recyclerLooseFiles.setAdapter(adapter);
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onResume() {
          super.onResume();
          scanStorageAndAudioFolders();
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onStart() {
          super.onStart();
          SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
          final ListenableFuture<MediaController> future = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
          controllerFuture = future;
          future.addListener(() -> {
              if (future != controllerFuture || future.isCancelled() || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                  return;
              }
              try {
                  mediaController = future.get();
                  mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                  syncMiniPlayerUI();
              } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | java.util.concurrent.CancellationException e) {
                  e.printStackTrace();
              }
          }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onStop() {
          super.onStop();
          if (mediaController != null) {
              mediaController.removeListener(playerListener);
              mediaController = null;
          }
          if (controllerFuture != null) {
              MediaController.releaseFuture(controllerFuture);
              controllerFuture = null;
          }
      }
  
      @Override
      protected void onDestroy() {
          super.onDestroy();
          scanExecutor.shutdownNow();
      }
  
      private void syncMiniPlayerUI() {
          if (mediaController == null) return;
          MediaItem currentItem = mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem();
          if (currentItem != null && currentItem.mediaMetadata != null) {
              CharSequence title = currentItem.mediaMetadata.title;
              CharSequence artist = currentItem.mediaMetadata.artist;
              if (miniTitle != null && title != null && title.length() > 0) miniTitle.setText(title);
              if (miniSubtitle != null && artist != null && artist.length() > 0) miniSubtitle.setText(artist);
              if (miniArt != null) {
                  if (currentItem.mediaMetadata.artworkUri != null) {
                      miniArt.setImageURI(currentItem.mediaMetadata.artworkUri);
                  } else {
                      miniArt.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_album_placeholder);
                  }
              }
          }
          if (btnPlayPause != null) {
              btnPlayPause.setImageResource(mediaController.isPlaying() ? R.drawable.ic_pause_24 : R.drawable.ic_play_arrow_24);
          }
      }
  }

      private static final String PREFS_NAME = "auralis_settings";

      private static final String KEY_EXCLUDED_FOLDERS = "excluded_folder_paths";
  
      // Matches WhatsApp filenames like AUD-20230130-WA0016 or PTT-20240101-WA0001
      private static final Pattern WHATSAPP_FILE_PATTERN =
              Pattern.compile("^(?i)(aud|ptt)-\\d{8}-wa\\d+.*");
  
      public static boolean isHideWhatsAppEnabled(Context context) {
          SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
          return prefs.getBoolean(KEY_HIDE_WHATSAPP, true); // Enabled by default

          prefs.edit().putBoolean(KEY_HIDE_WHATSAPP, enabled).apply();
      }

          SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);

      }
  
      public static boolean isRespectNomediaEnabled(Context context) {
          return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                  .getBoolean(KEY_RESPECT_NOMEDIA, true);
      }
      public static void setRespectNomediaEnabled(Context context, boolean enabled) {
          context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                  .edit().putBoolean(KEY_RESPECT_NOMEDIA, enabled).apply();
      }
  
      public static boolean isFilterShortClipsEnabled(Context context) {
          return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                  .getBoolean(KEY_FILTER_SHORT_CLIPS, true);
      }
      public static void setFilterShortClipsEnabled(Context context, boolean enabled) {
          context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                  .edit().putBoolean(KEY_FILTER_SHORT_CLIPS, enabled).apply();
      }
  
      public static boolean isExcludePodcastsEnabled(Context context) {
          return context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                  .getBoolean(KEY_EXCLUDE_PODCASTS, false);
      }
      public static void setExcludePodcastsEnabled(Context context, boolean enabled) {
          context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                  .edit().putBoolean(KEY_EXCLUDE_PODCASTS, enabled).apply();
      }
  
      public static boolean shouldExcludeTrack(Context context, String title, String fullPath) {
          return shouldExcludeTrack(context, title, fullPath, 30000L);
      }
  
      public static boolean shouldExcludeTrack(Context context, String title, String fullPath, long durationMs) {
          String safeTitle = title != null ? title.trim() : "";
          String safePath = fullPath != null ? fullPath : "";
          String lowerPath = safePath.toLowerCase(Locale.US);
  
          if (isIgnoreHiddenEnabled(context) && lowerPath.contains("/.")) {
              return true;
          }
  
          if (isFilterShortClipsEnabled(context) && durationMs > 0 && durationMs < 30000) {
              return true;
          }
  
          if (isExcludePodcastsEnabled(context) && (lowerPath.contains("/podcasts") || lowerPath.contains("/audiobooks"))) {
              return true;
          }
  
          // 1. Check user-excluded folder paths
          Set<String> excludedDirs = getExcludedFolders(context);
          for (String excluded : excludedDirs) {
              if (!excluded.isEmpty() && safePath.startsWith(excluded)) {
                  return true;
              }
          }
  
          // 2. Check WhatsApp folder paths and AUD-YYYYMMDD-WAXXXX filenames
          if (isHideWhatsAppEnabled(context)) {
              if (lowerPath.contains("/whatsapp") || lowerPath.contains("whatsapp audio")
                      || lowerPath.contains("whatsapp voice")) {
                  return true;
              }
              if (WHATSAPP_FILE_PATTERN.matcher(safeTitle).matches()) {
                  return true;
              }
              if (safePath.isEmpty() && safeTitle.toUpperCase(Locale.US).startsWith("AUD-")
                      && safeTitle.toUpperCase(Locale.US).contains("-WA")) {
                  return true;
              }
          }
          return false;
      }
  
      public static boolean isMicroSdPath(String path) {
          if (path == null || path.isEmpty()) return false;
          // Internal storage on Android is /storage/emulated/0 or /data
          if (path.startsWith("/storage/emulated") || path.startsWith("/data") || path.startsWith("/sdcard")) {
              return false;
          }
          // Removable SD cards mount under /storage/XXXX-XXXX
          return path.startsWith("/storage/");
      }
  }

      private void syncSwitchesFromPrefs() {
          if (switchIgnoreHidden != null) switchIgnoreHidden.setChecked(AudioFilterManager.isIgnoreHiddenEnabled(this));
          if (switchRespectNomedia != null) switchRespectNomedia.setChecked(AudioFilterManager.isRespectNomediaEnabled(this));
          if (switchFilterShort != null) switchFilterShort.setChecked(AudioFilterManager.isFilterShortClipsEnabled(this));
          if (switchExcludeWhatsapp != null) switchExcludeWhatsapp.setChecked(AudioFilterManager.isHideWhatsAppEnabled(this));
          if (switchExcludePodcasts != null) switchExcludePodcasts.setChecked(AudioFilterManager.isExcludePodcastsEnabled(this));
          if (switchExcludeHires != null) switchExcludeHires.setChecked(false);
          updateSummaryText();
      }
  
      private void updateSummaryText() {
          if (summaryExcludedCount == null) return;
          int activeRules = 0;
          if (AudioFilterManager.isIgnoreHiddenEnabled(this)) activeRules++;
          if (AudioFilterManager.isRespectNomediaEnabled(this)) activeRules++;
          if (AudioFilterManager.isFilterShortClipsEnabled(this)) activeRules++;
          if (AudioFilterManager.isHideWhatsAppEnabled(this)) activeRules++;
          if (AudioFilterManager.isExcludePodcastsEnabled(this)) activeRules++;
          int customFolders = AudioFilterManager.getExcludedFolders(this).size();
          summaryExcludedCount.setText("🛡 " + activeRules + " Active Filter Rules • " + customFolders + " Custom Hidden Folders");
      }

Call: write_file(absolutePath=C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/CrashReportSyncWorker.java, text=package com.thando1402.auralis;

import android.content.Context;

import androidx.annotation.NonNull;
import androidx.work.Worker;
import androidx.work.WorkerParameters;

import com.google.firebase.FirebaseApp;
import com.google.firebase.crashlytics.FirebaseCrashlytics;

import org.json.JSONArray;
import org.json.JSONObject;

/**
 * Store-and-Forward WorkManager Worker that runs when NetworkType.CONNECTED is satisfied.
 * Flushes locally serialized JSON crash reports from context.getFilesDir() to Firebase Crashlytics.
 */
public class CrashReportSyncWorker extends Worker {

    public static class OfflineQueuedCrashException extends Exception {
        public OfflineQueuedCrashException(String message) {
            super(message);
        }
    }

    public CrashReportSyncWorker(@NonNull Context context, @NonNull WorkerParameters workerParams) {
        super(context, workerParams);
    }

    @NonNull
    @Override
    public Result doWork() {
        Context appContext = getApplicationContext();
        JSONArray pendingReports = AuralisTelemetryManager.readQueuedCrashReports(appContext);
        if (pendingReports.length() == 0) {
            return Result.success();
        }

        try {
            FirebaseApp.initializeApp(appContext);
            FirebaseCrashlytics crashlytics = FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance();
            crashlytics.setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(true);

            for (int i = 0; i < pendingReports.length(); i++) {
                JSONObject report = pendingReports.optJSONObject(i);
                if (report == null) continue;

                String timestamp = report.optString("timestamp", "unknown");
                String androidVersion = report.optString("androidVersion", "unknown");
                String deviceModel = report.optString("deviceModel", "unknown");
                String threadName = report.optString("threadName", "main");
                String exceptionType = report.optString("exceptionType", "Throwable");
                String message = report.optString("message", "");
                String stackTrace = report.optString("stackTrace", "");
                long ramUsedMb = report.optLong("ramUsedMb", 0L);

                crashlytics.setCustomKey("offline_store_and_forward", true);
                crashlytics.setCustomKey("crash_timestamp", timestamp);
                crashlytics.setCustomKey("crash_android_version", androidVersion);
                crashlytics.setCustomKey("crash_device_model", deviceModel);
                crashlytics.setCustomKey("crash_thread", threadName);
                crashlytics.setCustomKey("crash_ram_used_mb", ramUsedMb);

                crashlytics.log("Offline Crash [" + timestamp + "] on " + deviceModel
                        + " (" + androidVersion + "):\n" + stackTrace);

                String summary = exceptionType + ": " + message + " [Captured offline at " + timestamp + "]";
                OfflineQueuedCrashException synthetic = new OfflineQueuedCrashException(summary);
                crashlytics.recordException(synthetic);
            }

            crashlytics.sendUnsentReports();
            AuralisTelemetryManager.clearQueuedCrashReports(appContext);
            return Result.success();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return Result.retry();
        }
    }
}

Call: write_file(absolutePath=C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/ProfileSetupActivity.java, text=package com.thando1402.auralis;

import android.os.Bundle;
import android.view.View;
import android.widget.TextView;
import android.widget.Toast;

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity;

import com.google.android.material.appbar.MaterialToolbar;
import com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton;
import com.google.android.material.textfield.TextInputEditText;
import com.google.firebase.FirebaseApp;
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseAuth;
import com.google.firebase.auth.FirebaseUser;
import com.google.firebase.auth.UserProfileChangeRequest;

public class ProfileSetupActivity extends AppCompatActivity {

    private TextInputEditText inputDisplayName;
    private TextInputEditText inputEmail;
    private TextInputEditText inputPassword;
    private TextView tvAuthStatusBanner;
    private MaterialButton btnSignOut;
    private FirebaseAuth firebaseAuth;

    @Override
    protected void onCreate(Bundle savedInstanceState) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState);
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_profile_setup);

        try {
            FirebaseApp.initializeApp(this);
            firebaseAuth = FirebaseAuth.getInstance();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        MaterialToolbar toolbar = findViewById(R.id.toolbar_profile_setup);
        if (toolbar != null) {
            toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener(v -> finish());
        }

        inputDisplayName = findViewById(R.id.input_profile_display_name);
        inputEmail = findViewById(R.id.input_auth_email);
        inputPassword = findViewById(R.id.input_auth_password);
        tvAuthStatusBanner = findViewById(R.id.tv_auth_status_banner);
        btnSignOut = findViewById(R.id.btn_auth_sign_out);

        MaterialButton btnSaveLocal = findViewById(R.id.btn_save_local_profile);
        MaterialButton btnSignIn = findViewById(R.id.btn_auth_sign_in);
        MaterialButton btnRegister = findViewById(R.id.btn_auth_register);
        MaterialButton btnAnonymous = findViewById(R.id.btn_auth_anonymous);

        UiAnimationHelper.attachSpringTouch(btnSaveLocal, btnSignIn, btnRegister, btnAnonymous);

        String currentName = OpenRouterAiHelper.getProfileName(this);
        if (inputDisplayName != null && !currentName.equals(getString(R.string.profile_default_name))) {
            inputDisplayName.setText(currentName);
        }

        refreshAuthBanner();

        if (btnSaveLocal != null) {
            btnSaveLocal.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                String enteredName = inputDisplayName != null && inputDisplayName.getText() != null
                        ? inputDisplayName.getText().toString().trim() : "";
                if (enteredName.isEmpty()) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Please enter a display name", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return;
                }
                OpenRouterAiHelper.setProfileName(this, enteredName);
                syncDisplayNameToFirebaseUser(enteredName);
                Toast.makeText(this, "Profile saved as " + enteredName, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                finish();
            });
        }

        if (btnSignIn != null) {
            btnSignIn.setOnClickListener(v -> handleEmailAuth(false));
        }

        if (btnRegister != null) {
            btnRegister.setOnClickListener(v -> handleEmailAuth(true));
        }

        if (btnAnonymous != null) {
            btnAnonymous.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (firebaseAuth == null) {
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Firebase Auth unavailable offline", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                    return;
                }
                firebaseAuth.signInAnonymously().addOnCompleteListener(this, task -> {
                    if (task.isSuccessful()) {
                        String typedName = inputDisplayName != null && inputDisplayName.getText() != null
                                ? inputDisplayName.getText().toString().trim() : "";
                        if (!typedName.isEmpty()) {
                            OpenRouterAiHelper.setProfileName(this, typedName);
                            syncDisplayNameToFirebaseUser(typedName);
                        } else if (!OpenRouterAiHelper.isProfileConfigured(this)) {
                            OpenRouterAiHelper.setProfileName(this, getString(R.string.profile_default_name));
                        }
                        refreshAuthBanner();
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Signed in with Anonymous Cloud Session", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                        finish();
                    } else {
                        String err = task.getException() != null ? task.getException().getLocalizedMessage() : "Check connection or Firebase Console";
                        Toast.makeText(this, "Anonymous sign-in failed: " + err, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                    }
                });
            });
        }

        if (btnSignOut != null) {
            btnSignOut.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (firebaseAuth != null) {
                    firebaseAuth.signOut();
                }
                refreshAuthBanner();
                Toast.makeText(this, "Signed out of cloud session", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            });
        }
    }

    private void handleEmailAuth(boolean isRegistration) {
        if (firebaseAuth == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Firebase Auth unavailable", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        String email = inputEmail != null && inputEmail.getText() != null
                ? inputEmail.getText().toString().trim() : "";
        String password = inputPassword != null && inputPassword.getText() != null
                ? inputPassword.getText().toString() : "";

        if (email.isEmpty() || !email.contains("@")) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Enter a valid email address", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        if (password.length() < 6) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Password must be at least 6 characters", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }

        if (isRegistration) {
            firebaseAuth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
                    .addOnCompleteListener(this, task -> {
                        if (task.isSuccessful()) {
                            applyAuthenticatedProfile(email);
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Account created & synced!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            finish();
                        } else {
                            String err = task.getException() != null ? task.getException().getLocalizedMessage() : "Registration error";
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Registration failed: " + err, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        }
                    });
        } else {
            firebaseAuth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, password)
                    .addOnCompleteListener(this, task -> {
                        if (task.isSuccessful()) {
                            applyAuthenticatedProfile(email);
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Signed in successfully!", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                            finish();
                        } else {
                            String err = task.getException() != null ? task.getException().getLocalizedMessage() : "Sign-in error";
                            Toast.makeText(this, "Sign-in failed: " + err, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
                        }
                    });
        }
    }

    private void applyAuthenticatedProfile(String fallbackEmail) {
        FirebaseUser user = firebaseAuth != null ? firebaseAuth.getCurrentUser() : null;
        String typedName = inputDisplayName != null && inputDisplayName.getText() != null
                ? inputDisplayName.getText().toString().trim() : "";

        if (!typedName.isEmpty()) {
            OpenRouterAiHelper.setProfileName(this, typedName);
            syncDisplayNameToFirebaseUser(typedName);
        } else if (user != null && user.getDisplayName() != null && !user.getDisplayName().trim().isEmpty()) {
            OpenRouterAiHelper.setProfileName(this, user.getDisplayName().trim());
        } else {
            int atIdx = fallbackEmail.indexOf('@');
            String derived = atIdx > 0 ? fallbackEmail.substring(0, atIdx) : fallbackEmail;
            OpenRouterAiHelper.setProfileName(this, derived);
            syncDisplayNameToFirebaseUser(derived);
        }
        refreshAuthBanner();
    }

    private void syncDisplayNameToFirebaseUser(String displayName) {
        if (firebaseAuth == null) return;
        FirebaseUser user = firebaseAuth.getCurrentUser();
        if (user != null && displayName != null && !displayName.isEmpty()) {
            UserProfileChangeRequest profileUpdates = new UserProfileChangeRequest.Builder()
                    .setDisplayName(displayName)
                    .build();
            user.updateProfile(profileUpdates);
        }
    }

    private void refreshAuthBanner() {
        if (tvAuthStatusBanner == null) return;
        FirebaseUser user = firebaseAuth != null ? firebaseAuth.getCurrentUser() : null;
        if (user != null) {
            String label = user.isAnonymous()
                    ? "Cloud Sync Active • Anonymous Session"
                    : "Cloud Sync Active • " + (user.getEmail() != null ? user.getEmail() : "Authenticated");
            tvAuthStatusBanner.setText(label);
            if (btnSignOut != null) btnSignOut.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
        } else {
            tvAuthStatusBanner.setText(R.string.setup_status_offline);
            if (btnSignOut != null) btnSignOut.setVisibility(View.GONE);
        }
    }
}

import android.content.Context;

import java.io.BufferedReader;

import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;

public class AuralisTelemetryManager {

    private static volatile boolean initialized = false;
    private static final Object CRASH_LOCK = new Object();
    private static final String CRASH_LOG_FILE = "auralis_crash_log.txt";
    private static final String CRASH_QUEUE_JSON_FILE = "auralis_crash_reports.json";
    private static final String CRASH_SYNC_WORK_NAME = "auralis_crash_sync_work";
    private static final int MAX_QUEUED_REPORTS = 25;

    public static void init(Context context) {
        if (context == null) return;
        final Context appContext = context.getApplicationContext();

        synchronized (CRASH_LOCK) {
            if (!initialized) {
                initialized = true;
                final Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler defaultHandler = Thread.getDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler();

                Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler((thread, throwable) -> {
                    saveCrashReportLocally(appContext, thread, throwable);
                    scheduleCrashReportSync(appContext);
                    if (defaultHandler != null) {
                        defaultHandler.uncaughtException(thread, throwable);
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // If any offline crash reports are waiting in filesDir from a prior crash, enqueue sync immediately
        if (getQueuedCrashReportCount(appContext) > 0) {
            scheduleCrashReportSync(appContext);
        }
    }

    private static void saveCrashReportLocally(Context context, Thread thread, Throwable throwable) {
        synchronized (CRASH_LOCK) {
            try {
                StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
                throwable.printStackTrace(new PrintWriter(sw));
                String stackTraceStr = sw.toString();

                SimpleDateFormat isoFormat = new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'", Locale.US);
                isoFormat.setTimeZone(TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC"));
                String isoTimestamp = isoFormat.format(new Date());
                String androidVer = "Android " + Build.VERSION.RELEASE + " (API " + Build.VERSION.SDK_INT + ")";
                String deviceModel = (Build.MANUFACTURER + " " + Build.MODEL).trim();
                long ramMb = getRamUsageMb();
                String apkSize = getApkSizeFormatted(context);

                // 1. Serialize structured crash payload to JSON in context.getFilesDir()
                File jsonQueueFile = getCrashQueueJsonFile(context);
                JSONArray queue = readJsonArrayLocked(jsonQueueFile);
                while (queue.length() >= MAX_QUEUED_REPORTS) {
                    queue.remove(0);
                }

                JSONObject crashObj = new JSONObject();
                crashObj.put("id", UUID.randomUUID().toString());
                crashObj.put("timestamp", isoTimestamp);
                crashObj.put("epochMs", System.currentTimeMillis());
                crashObj.put("androidVersion", androidVer);
                crashObj.put("deviceModel", deviceModel);
                crashObj.put("threadName", thread != null ? thread.getName() : "unknown");
                crashObj.put("exceptionType", throwable.getClass().getName());
                crashObj.put("message", throwable.getMessage() != null ? throwable.getMessage() : "");
                crashObj.put("stackTrace", stackTraceStr);
                crashObj.put("ramUsedMb", ramMb);
                crashObj.put("apkSize", apkSize);
                queue.put(crashObj);

                writeJsonArrayLocked(jsonQueueFile, queue);

                // 2. Also append human-readable entry for local Storage & Crash Diagnostics view
                String readableReport = "=== AURALIS CRASH [" + isoTimestamp + "] ===\n"
                        + "Device: " + deviceModel + " | " + androidVer + "\n"
                        + "RAM Used: " + ramMb + " MB | APK Size: " + apkSize + "\n"
                        + stackTraceStr + "\n\n";

                File logFile = getLastCrashLogFile(context);
                try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(logFile, true)) {
                    fos.write(readableReport.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    public static void scheduleCrashReportSync(Context context) {
        try {
            Constraints constraints = new Constraints.Builder()
                    .setRequiredNetworkType(NetworkType.CONNECTED)
                    .build();

            OneTimeWorkRequest syncRequest = new OneTimeWorkRequest.Builder(CrashReportSyncWorker.class)
                    .setConstraints(constraints)
                    .setBackoffCriteria(BackoffPolicy.EXPONENTIAL, 30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                    .build();

            WorkManager.getInstance(context.getApplicationContext())
                    .enqueueUniqueWork(CRASH_SYNC_WORK_NAME, ExistingWorkPolicy.REPLACE, syncRequest);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    public static File getCrashQueueJsonFile(Context context) {
        return new File(context.getFilesDir(), CRASH_QUEUE_JSON_FILE);
    }

    public static JSONArray readQueuedCrashReports(Context context) {
        synchronized (CRASH_LOCK) {
            return readJsonArrayLocked(getCrashQueueJsonFile(context));
        }
    }

    public static int getQueuedCrashReportCount(Context context) {
        return readQueuedCrashReports(context).length();
    }

    public static void clearQueuedCrashReports(Context context) {
        synchronized (CRASH_LOCK) {
            writeJsonArrayLocked(getCrashQueueJsonFile(context), new JSONArray());
        }
    }

    private static JSONArray readJsonArrayLocked(File file) {
        if (file == null || !file.exists()) return new JSONArray();
        try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(file);
             BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(fis, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                sb.append(line);
            }
            String content = sb.toString().trim();
            return content.isEmpty() ? new JSONArray() : new JSONArray(content);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONArray();
        }
    }

    private static void writeJsonArrayLocked(File file, JSONArray array) {
        if (file == null) return;
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(file, false)) {
            fos.write(array.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            fos.getFD().sync();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    public static boolean isFirebaseLinked() {
        try {
            Class.forName("com.google.firebase.crashlytics.FirebaseCrashlytics");
            return true;
        } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static File getLastCrashLogFile(Context context) {
        return new File(SongMetadataManager.getStorageDirectory(context), CRASH_LOG_FILE);
    }

    public static String getApkSizeFormatted(Context context) {
        try {
            String sourceDir = context.getPackageManager().getApplicationInfo(context.getPackageName(), 0).sourceDir;
            long bytes = new File(sourceDir).length();
            return Formatter.formatShortFileSize(context, bytes);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "Unknown";
        }
    }

    public static long getRamUsageMb() {
        Runtime runtime = Runtime.getRuntime();
        return (runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory()) / (1024 * 1024);
    }

    public static class StorageSnapshot {
        public long internalTotalBytes;
        public long internalFreeBytes;
        public long internalUsedBytes;
        public int internalUsedPercent;

        public boolean hasSdCard;
        public String sdCardRootPath;
        public long sdTotalBytes;
        public long sdFreeBytes;
        public long sdUsedBytes;
        public int sdUsedPercent;
    }

    public static StorageSnapshot getStorageSnapshot(Context context) {
        StorageSnapshot snap = new StorageSnapshot();
        StatFs internalStat = new StatFs(Environment.getDataDirectory().getPath());
        snap.internalTotalBytes = internalStat.getTotalBytes();
        snap.internalFreeBytes = internalStat.getAvailableBytes();
        snap.internalUsedBytes = Math.max(0, snap.internalTotalBytes - snap.internalFreeBytes);
        snap.internalUsedPercent = snap.internalTotalBytes > 0
                ? (int) ((snap.internalUsedBytes * 100L) / snap.internalTotalBytes) : 0;

        File[] extDirs = ContextCompat.getExternalFilesDirs(context, null);
        if (extDirs.length > 1 && extDirs[1] != null
                && Environment.MEDIA_MOUNTED.equals(Environment.getExternalStorageState(extDirs[1]))) {
            snap.hasSdCard = true;
            String fullPath = extDirs[1].getAbsolutePath();
            int androidIdx = fullPath.indexOf("/Android");
            snap.sdCardRootPath = androidIdx > 0 ? fullPath.substring(0, androidIdx) : fullPath;

            StatFs sdStat = new StatFs(extDirs[1].getPath());
            snap.sdTotalBytes = sdStat.getTotalBytes();
            snap.sdFreeBytes = sdStat.getAvailableBytes();
            snap.sdUsedBytes = Math.max(0, snap.sdTotalBytes - snap.sdFreeBytes);
            snap.sdUsedPercent = snap.sdTotalBytes > 0
                    ? (int) ((snap.sdUsedBytes * 100L) / snap.sdTotalBytes) : 0;
        }
        return snap;
    }

import android.annotation.SuppressLint;
import android.view.MotionEvent;

import androidx.interpolator.view.animation.FastOutSlowInInterpolator;

public final class UiAnimationHelper {

    public static final DecelerateInterpolator DECELERATE = new DecelerateInterpolator(1.6f);
    public static final OvershootInterpolator OVERSHOOT = new OvershootInterpolator(2.2f);
    public static final FastOutSlowInInterpolator FAST_OUT_SLOW_IN = new FastOutSlowInInterpolator();

    private UiAnimationHelper() {}

    /**
     * Attaches lightweight RenderThread spring press physics to buttons/cards using GPU layers.
     */
    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    public static void attachSpringTouch(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        View.OnTouchListener listener = (v, event) -> {
            int action = event.getActionMasked();
            if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) {
                v.animate().cancel();
                v.animate()
                        .scaleX(0.90f)
                        .scaleY(0.90f)
                        .setDuration(85)
                        .setInterpolator(DECELERATE)
                        .withLayer()
                        .start();
            } else if (action == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP || action == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) {
                v.animate().cancel();
                v.animate()
                        .scaleX(1.0f)
                        .scaleY(1.0f)
                        .setDuration(190)
                        .setInterpolator(OVERSHOOT)
                        .withLayer()
                        .start();
            }
            return false;
        };
        for (View view : views) {
            if (view != null) {
                view.setOnTouchListener(listener);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Celebratory pop bounce for toggle buttons (Favorite, Shuffle, Repeat).
     */
    public static void pulseBounce(View view) {
        if (view == null) return;
        view.animate().cancel();
        view.setScaleX(0.80f);
        view.setScaleY(0.80f);
        view.animate()
                .scaleX(1.0f)
                .scaleY(1.0f)
                .setDuration(240)
                .setInterpolator(OVERSHOOT)
                .withLayer()
                .start();
    }

    /**
     * Smoothly expands album art when playing and relaxes it slightly when paused.
     */
    public static void animateAlbumArtPlayState(View artView, boolean isPlaying) {
        if (artView == null) return;
        float targetScale = isPlaying ? 1.0f : 0.95f;
        artView.animate().cancel();
        artView.animate()
                .scaleX(targetScale)
                .scaleY(targetScale)
                .setDuration(260)
                .setInterpolator(FAST_OUT_SLOW_IN)
                .withLayer()
                .start();
    }

    /**
     * Crisp horizontal slide + crossfade when skipping tracks.
     */
    public static void animateTrackTransition(View view, boolean forward) {
        if (view == null) return;
        float offset = forward ? 28f : -28f;
        view.animate().cancel();
        view.setAlpha(0.25f);
        view.setTranslationX(offset);
        view.animate()
                .alpha(1.0f)
                .translationX(0f)
                .setDuration(210)
                .setInterpolator(DECELERATE)
                .withLayer()
                .start();
    }

    /**
     * Staggered entrance animation for cards/controls without heavy layout passes.
     */
    public static void runStaggeredEntrance(View... views) {
        if (views == null) return;
        long delay = 30L;
        for (View v : views) {
            if (v == null || v.getVisibility() != View.VISIBLE) continue;
            v.setAlpha(0f);
            v.setTranslationY(24f);
            v.animate()
                    .alpha(1f)
                    .translationY(0f)
                    .setStartDelay(delay)
                    .setDuration(220)
                    .setInterpolator(DECELERATE)
                    .withLayer()
                    .start();
            delay += 35L;
        }
    }

public class EqualizerBarsView extends View {

    private static final LinearInterpolator LINEAR = new LinearInterpolator();

    private final Paint paint = new Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG);
    private final RectF rect = new RectF();
    private final int[] barHeights = new int[3];
    private final int[] targetHeights = new int[3];
    private final Random random = new Random();
    private ValueAnimator animator;
    private boolean isAnimating = false;

    private float barWidth;
    private float spacing;
    private float maxBarHeight;

    public EqualizerBarsView(Context context) {
        super(context);
        init();
    }

    public EqualizerBarsView(Context context, AttributeSet attrs) {
        super(context, attrs);
        init();
    }

    private void init() {
        int barColor = ContextCompat.getColor(getContext(), R.color.accent_blue);
        paint.setColor(barColor);
        paint.setStyle(Paint.Style.FILL);

        float density = getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density;
        barWidth = 4f * density;
        spacing = 3f * density;
        maxBarHeight = 14f * density;
    }

    public void animateBars(boolean play) {
        if (play && !isAnimating) {
            isAnimating = true;
            setVisibility(VISIBLE);
            if (animator == null) {
                animator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f);
                animator.setDuration(180);
                animator.setInterpolator(LINEAR);
                animator.setRepeatCount(ValueAnimator.INFINITE);
                animator.setRepeatMode(ValueAnimator.REVERSE);
                animator.addUpdateListener(animation -> {
                    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                        barHeights[i] = (int) (barHeights[i] + (targetHeights[i] - barHeights[i]) * 0.2f);
                    }
                    invalidate();
                });

                animator.addListener(new android.animation.AnimatorListenerAdapter() {
                    @Override
                    public void onAnimationRepeat(@NonNull android.animation.Animator animation) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                            targetHeights[i] = (int) (random.nextFloat() * maxBarHeight);
                            if (targetHeights[i] < maxBarHeight * 0.2f) {
                                targetHeights[i] = (int) (maxBarHeight * 0.2f);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                });
            }
            animator.start();
        } else if (!play) {
            isAnimating = false;
            if (animator != null) {
                animator.cancel();
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
                barHeights[i] = (int) (maxBarHeight * 0.15f);
            }
            invalidate();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDraw(@NonNull Canvas canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas);

        float x = (getWidth() - (3 * barWidth + 2 * spacing)) / 2f;
        float bottomY = getHeight() - (getHeight() - maxBarHeight) / 2f;

        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            float height = Math.min(Math.max(barHeights[i], maxBarHeight * 0.15f), maxBarHeight);
            float topY = bottomY - height;

            rect.set(x, topY, x + barWidth, bottomY);
            canvas.drawRoundRect(rect, barWidth / 2f, barWidth / 2f, paint);

            x += barWidth + spacing;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDetachedFromWindow() {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow();
        if (animator != null) {
            animator.cancel();
            animator = null;
        }
    }
}

    public static File getStorageDirectory(Context context) {
        File[] externalDirs = ContextCompat.getExternalFilesDirs(context, null);
        if (isPreferSdCard(context) && externalDirs.length > 1 && externalDirs[1] != null) {
            if (Environment.MEDIA_MOUNTED.equals(Environment.getExternalStorageState(externalDirs[1]))) {
                return externalDirs[1];
            }
        }
        if (externalDirs.length > 0 && externalDirs[0] != null) {
            return externalDirs[0];
        }
        return context.getFilesDir();
    }

    /**
     * Dedicated synced lyrics backup folder:
     * Android/data/com.thando1402.auralis/files/Auralis/Lyrics/
     */
    @NonNull
    public static File getDedicatedLyricsBackupDir(Context context) {
        File primaryExternal = context.getExternalFilesDir(null);
        File base = primaryExternal != null ? primaryExternal : context.getFilesDir();
        File lyricsDir = new File(new File(base, "Auralis"), "Lyrics");
        if (!lyricsDir.exists()) {
            //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            lyricsDir.mkdirs();
        }
        return lyricsDir;
    }

    private static String sanitizeFileSegment(String input) {
        if (input == null) return "Track";
        String cleaned = input.replaceAll("[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]", "_").replaceAll("\\s+", " ").trim();
        if (cleaned.length() > 64) {
            cleaned = cleaned.substring(0, 64).trim();
        }
        return cleaned.isEmpty() ? "Track" : cleaned;
    }

    @NonNull
    public static File getBackupLrcFileForSong(Context context, String title, String artist, String uriKey) {
        File dir = getDedicatedLyricsBackupDir(context);
        String safeArtist = sanitizeFileSegment(artist);
        String safeTitle = sanitizeFileSegment(title);
        int hash = Math.abs(uriKey != null ? uriKey.hashCode() : 0);
        return new File(dir, safeArtist + " - " + safeTitle + "_" + hash + ".lrc");
    }

    private static File getStableMetadataFile(Context context) {
        File stableFile = new File(context.getFilesDir(), JSON_FILE_NAME);
        if (!stableFile.exists()) {
            File[] externalDirs = ContextCompat.getExternalFilesDirs(context, null);
            for (File dir : externalDirs) {
                if (dir != null) {
                    File legacyFile = new File(dir, JSON_FILE_NAME);
                    if (legacyFile.exists()) {
                        JSONObject legacyJson = readFileToJson(legacyFile);
                        writeJsonToFile(stableFile, legacyJson);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return stableFile;
    }

    /**
     * Applies saved metadata overrides without reading heavy fallback lyrics during bulk library scans.
     */
    public static void applySavedEdits(Context context, Song song) {
        applySavedEdits(context, song, false);
    }

    /**
     * Applies saved metadata overrides and optionally resolves full lyrics from:
     * 1. Dedicated backup folder Android/data/com.thando1402.auralis/files/Auralis/Lyrics/
     * 2. Local metadata JSON cache
     * 3. Sidecar .lrc next to original audio or embedded ID3 USLT / Vorbis LYRICS tags
     */
    public static void applySavedEdits(Context context, Song song, boolean resolveFullLyrics) {
        if (context == null || song == null || song.getUri() == null) return;
        try {
            String key = song.getUri().toString();
            JSONObject edit;
            synchronized (CACHE_LOCK) {
                JSONObject allEdits = loadJsonLocked(context);
                edit = allEdits.optJSONObject(key);
            }

            if (edit != null) {
                song.setTitle(edit.optString("title", song.getTitle()));
                song.setArtist(edit.optString("artist", song.getArtist()));
                song.setAlbum(edit.optString("album", song.getAlbum()));
                song.setTrackNumber(edit.optString("trackNumber", song.getTrackNumber()));
                song.setYearGenre(edit.optString("yearGenre", song.getYearGenre()));
                song.setLrcOffsetMs(edit.optLong("lrcOffsetMs", 0L));
                song.setLyrics(edit.optString("lyrics", ""));

                String coverPath = edit.optString("coverPath", "");
                if (!coverPath.isEmpty()) {
                    File coverFile = new File(coverPath);
                    if (coverFile.exists()) {
                        song.setCustomCoverUri(Uri.fromFile(coverFile));
                    }
                }
            }

            if (resolveFullLyrics) {
                String resolvedLyrics = resolveLyricsWithFallback(context, song, edit);
                song.setLyrics(resolvedLyrics);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    @NonNull
    public static String resolveLyricsWithFallback(Context context, Song song, @Nullable JSONObject edit) {
        if (context == null || song == null || song.getUri() == null) return "";
        String key = song.getUri().toString();
        File lyricsDir = getDedicatedLyricsBackupDir(context);

        // Priority 1A: Explicit backup path stored in JSON inside Auralis/Lyrics/
        if (edit != null) {
            String storedPath = edit.optString("lrcBackupPath", "");
            if (!storedPath.isEmpty()) {
                String text = readTextFile(new File(storedPath));
                if (!text.isEmpty()) return text;
            }
        }

        // Priority 1B: Deterministic backup file in Android/data/com.thando1402.auralis/files/Auralis/Lyrics/
        File hashedBackup = getBackupLrcFileForSong(context, song.getTitle(), song.getArtist(), key);
        String fromHashed = readTextFile(hashedBackup);
        if (!fromHashed.isEmpty()) return fromHashed;

        // Priority 1C: User-dropped "<Artist> - <Title>.lrc" or "<Title>.lrc" in Auralis/Lyrics/
        File artistTitleFile = new File(lyricsDir,
                sanitizeFileSegment(song.getArtist()) + " - " + sanitizeFileSegment(song.getTitle()) + ".lrc");
        String fromArtistTitle = readTextFile(artistTitleFile);
        if (!fromArtistTitle.isEmpty()) return fromArtistTitle;

        File titleOnlyFile = new File(lyricsDir, sanitizeFileSegment(song.getTitle()) + ".lrc");
        String fromTitleOnly = readTextFile(titleOnlyFile);
        if (!fromTitleOnly.isEmpty()) return fromTitleOnly;

        // Priority 2: JSON-stored lyrics
        if (edit != null) {
            String jsonLyrics = edit.optString("lyrics", "").trim();
            if (!jsonLyrics.isEmpty()) return jsonLyrics;
        }
        if (song.getLyrics() != null && !song.getLyrics().trim().isEmpty()) {
            return song.getLyrics().trim();
        }

        // Priority 3: Sidecar .lrc next to audio file or embedded ID3v2 USLT / Vorbis LYRICS tags
        String sidecar = readSidecarLrcFromMediaStore(context, song.getUri());
        if (!sidecar.isEmpty()) return sidecar;

        return extractEmbeddedLyricsTag(context, song.getUri());
    }

    public static void saveSongEdit(Context context, Song song, String newTitle, String newArtist, Uri pickedImageUri, String lyrics) {
        saveSongEditFull(context, song, newTitle, newArtist,
                song != null ? song.getAlbum() : "",
                song != null ? song.getTrackNumber() : "",
                song != null ? song.getYearGenre() : "",
                pickedImageUri, lyrics);
    }

    public static void saveSongEditFull(
            Context context,
            Song song,
            String newTitle,
            String newArtist,
            String newAlbum,
            String newTrackNumber,
            String newYearGenre,
            @Nullable Uri pickedImageUri,
            @Nullable String lyrics) {
        if (context == null || song == null || song.getUri() == null) return;
        try {
            String key = song.getUri().toString();
            File savedCover = null;
            if (pickedImageUri != null && !"file".equals(pickedImageUri.getScheme())) {
                savedCover = compressAndSaveCover(context, pickedImageUri, key.hashCode());
            } else if (pickedImageUri != null && pickedImageUri.getPath() != null) {
                File f = new File(pickedImageUri.getPath());
                if (f.exists()) {
                    // If extracted to cacheDir, persist into covers folder
                    if (f.getAbsolutePath().contains(context.getCacheDir().getAbsolutePath())) {
                        savedCover = compressAndSaveCover(context, pickedImageUri, key.hashCode());
                    } else {
                        savedCover = f;
                    }
                }
            }

            File backupLrcFile = null;
            if (lyrics != null && !lyrics.trim().isEmpty()) {
                backupLrcFile = getBackupLrcFileForSong(context, newTitle, newArtist, key);
                writeTextFile(backupLrcFile, lyrics.trim());
            }

            synchronized (CACHE_LOCK) {
                JSONObject allEdits = loadJsonLocked(context);
                JSONObject edit = allEdits.optJSONObject(key);
                if (edit == null) edit = new JSONObject();

                edit.put("title", newTitle);
                edit.put("artist", newArtist);
                if (newAlbum != null) edit.put("album", newAlbum);
                if (newTrackNumber != null) edit.put("trackNumber", newTrackNumber);
                if (newYearGenre != null) edit.put("yearGenre", newYearGenre);

                if (lyrics != null) {
                    edit.put("lyrics", lyrics.trim());
                    song.setLyrics(lyrics.trim());
                }
                if (backupLrcFile != null) {
                    edit.put("lrcBackupPath", backupLrcFile.getAbsolutePath());
                }
                if (savedCover != null) {
                    edit.put("coverPath", savedCover.getAbsolutePath());
                    song.setCustomCoverUri(Uri.fromFile(savedCover));
                }

                song.setTitle(newTitle);
                song.setArtist(newArtist);
                song.setAlbum(newAlbum);
                song.setTrackNumber(newTrackNumber);
                song.setYearGenre(newYearGenre);

                allEdits.put(key, edit);
                saveJsonLocked(context, allEdits);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    public static long getLrcOffsetMs(Context context, String songUriKey) {

        synchronized (CACHE_LOCK) {
