    private static String readSidecarLrcFromMediaStore(Context context, Uri audioUri) {
        try (Cursor c = context.getContentResolver().query(
                audioUri, new String[]{MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA}, null, null, null)) {
            if (c != null && c.moveToFirst()) {
                String dataPath = c.getString(0);
                if (dataPath != null && !dataPath.isEmpty()) {
                    int dot = dataPath.lastIndexOf('.');
                    String lrcPath = (dot > 0 ? dataPath.substring(0, dot) : dataPath) + ".lrc";
                    return readTextFile(new File(lrcPath));
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return "";
    }

    /**
     * Lightweight header scanner for embedded ID3v2 USLT/SYLT or FLAC/OGG Vorbis LYRICS tags
     * (reads at most the first 256 KB so Nokia 1.4 RAM is unaffected).
     */
    private static String extractEmbeddedLyricsTag(Context context, Uri audioUri) {
        try (InputStream is = context.getContentResolver().openInputStream(audioUri)) {
            if (is == null) return "";
            byte[] header = new byte[262_144];
            int totalRead = 0;
            while (totalRead < header.length) {
                int r = is.read(header, totalRead, header.length - totalRead);
                if (r <= 0) break;
                totalRead += r;
            }
            if (totalRead < 16) return "";

            // Check ID3v2 USLT frame
            if (header[0] == 'I' && header[1] == 'D' && header[2] == '3') {
                int version = header[3] & 0xFF;
                int pos = 10;
                while (pos + 10 < totalRead) {
                    if (header[pos] == 0) break;
                    String frameId = new String(header, pos, 4, StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1);
                    int frameSize;
                    if (version == 4) {
                        frameSize = ((header[pos + 4] & 0x7F) << 21)
                                | ((header[pos + 5] & 0x7F) << 14)
                                | ((header[pos + 6] & 0x7F) << 7)
                                | (header[pos + 7] & 0x7F);
                    } else {
                        frameSize = ((header[pos + 4] & 0xFF) << 24)
                                | ((header[pos + 5] & 0xFF) << 16)
                                | ((header[pos + 6] & 0xFF) << 8)
                                | (header[pos + 7] & 0xFF);
                    }
                    if (frameSize <= 0 || pos + 10 + frameSize > totalRead) break;
                    if ("USLT".equals(frameId) && frameSize > 4) {
                        int enc = header[pos + 10] & 0xFF;
                        int start = pos + 14; // skip encoding (1) + language (3)
                        int end = pos + 10 + frameSize;
                        // Skip content descriptor up to null terminator
                        if (enc == 1 || enc == 2) {
                            while (start + 1 < end && !(header[start] == 0 && header[start + 1] == 0)) {
                                start += 2;
                            }
                            start += 2;
                            if (start < end) {
                                return new String(header, start, end - start,
                                        enc == 1 ? StandardCharsets.UTF_16 : StandardCharsets.UTF_16BE).trim();
                            }
                        } else {
                            while (start < end && header[start] != 0) start++;
                            start++;
                            if (start < end) {
                                return new String(header, start, end - start,
                                        enc == 3 ? StandardCharsets.UTF_8 : StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1).trim();
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    pos += 10 + frameSize;
                }
            }

            // Check FLAC/Vorbis comment "LYRICS=" or "UNSYNCEDLYRICS="
            String rawAscii = new String(header, 0, totalRead, StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1);
            int vorbisIdx = rawAscii.toUpperCase().indexOf("LYRICS=");
            if (vorbisIdx >= 4) {
                int lenPos = vorbisIdx - 4;
                if (vorbisIdx >= 11 && rawAscii.regionMatches(true, vorbisIdx - 8, "UNSYNCED", 0, 8)) {
                    lenPos = vorbisIdx - 12;
                }
                if (lenPos >= 0) {
                    int commentLen = (header[lenPos] & 0xFF)
                            | ((header[lenPos + 1] & 0xFF) << 8)
                            | ((header[lenPos + 2] & 0xFF) << 16)
                            | ((header[lenPos + 3] & 0xFF) << 24);
                    int eqPos = vorbisIdx + 7;
                    int valEnd = lenPos + 4 + commentLen;
                    if (commentLen > 7 && valEnd <= totalRead && eqPos < valEnd) {
                        return new String(header, eqPos, valEnd - eqPos, StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return "";
    }

    private static String readTextFile(File file) {
        if (file == null || !file.exists() || !file.isFile()) return "";
        try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(file);
             BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(fis, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) {
                sb.append(line).append('\n');
            }
            return sb.toString().trim();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return "";
        }
    }

    private static void writeTextFile(File file, String content) {
        if (file == null) return;
        File parent = file.getParentFile();
        if (parent != null && !parent.exists()) {
            //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
            parent.mkdirs();
        }
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(file, false)) {
            fos.write(content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    private static File compressAndSaveCover(Context context, Uri imageUri, int songHash) {
        try {
            Bitmap original = ArtworkColorHelper.loadArtworkBitmap(context, imageUri, null, 720);
            if (original == null) return null;

            int width = original.getWidth();
            int height = original.getHeight();
            int cropSize = Math.min(width, height);
            int xOffset = (width - cropSize) / 2;
            int yOffset = (height - cropSize) / 2;

            Bitmap squareCrop = Bitmap.createBitmap(original, xOffset, yOffset, cropSize, cropSize);
            if (squareCrop != original) original.recycle();

            int targetDim = Math.min(720, cropSize);
            Bitmap scaled = Bitmap.createScaledBitmap(squareCrop, targetDim, targetDim, true);
            if (scaled != squareCrop) squareCrop.recycle();

            File coversDir = new File(getStorageDirectory(context), "covers");
            if (!coversDir.exists()) {
                //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                coversDir.mkdirs();
            }

            File outFile = new File(coversDir, "cover_" + Math.abs(songHash) + "_" + System.currentTimeMillis() + ".jpg");
            try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(outFile)) {
                scaled.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 88, out);
            }
            scaled.recycle();
            return outFile;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    private static JSONObject loadJsonLocked(Context context) {
        File f = getStableMetadataFile(context);
        if (cachedEdits != null && f.lastModified() == lastModifiedTime) {
            return cachedEdits;
        }
        cachedEdits = readFileToJson(f);
        lastModifiedTime = f.lastModified();
        return cachedEdits;
    }

    private static void saveJsonLocked(Context context, JSONObject json) {
        File f = getStableMetadataFile(context);
        writeJsonToFile(f, json);
        cachedEdits = json;
        lastModifiedTime = f.lastModified();
    }

    private static JSONObject readFileToJson(File file) {
        if (file == null || !file.exists()) return new JSONObject();
        try (FileInputStream fis = new FileInputStream(file);
             BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(fis, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            String line;
            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) sb.append(line);
            return new JSONObject(sb.toString());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return new JSONObject();
        }
    }

    private static void writeJsonToFile(File file, JSONObject json) {
        if (file == null) return;
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(file)) {
            fos.write(json.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

        if (appCheckInitialized) return;
        try {
            FirebaseApp.initializeApp(context.getApplicationContext());
            // Install debug AppCheck provider reflectively so debugImplementation does not leak into release APK
            Class<?> appCheckClass = Class.forName("com.google.firebase.appcheck.FirebaseAppCheck");
            Class<?> factoryBaseClass = Class.forName("com.google.firebase.appcheck.AppCheckProviderFactory");
            Class<?> debugFactoryClass = Class.forName("com.google.firebase.appcheck.debug.DebugAppCheckProviderFactory");

            Object appCheckInstance = appCheckClass.getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            Object debugFactoryInstance = debugFactoryClass.getMethod("getInstance").invoke(null);
            Method installMethod = appCheckClass.getMethod("installAppCheckProviderFactory", factoryBaseClass);
            installMethod.invoke(appCheckInstance, debugFactoryInstance);
            appCheckInitialized = true;
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Release builds or unconfigured environments safely skip debug AppCheck
        }
    }

    public static String getProfileName(Context context) {
        try {
            FirebaseUser user = FirebaseAuth.getInstance().getCurrentUser();
            if (user != null && user.getDisplayName() != null && !user.getDisplayName().trim().isEmpty()) {
                return user.getDisplayName().trim();
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_NAME, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        String stored = prefs.getString(KEY_PROFILE_NAME, "");
        if (!stored.trim().isEmpty() && !"Alex Vance".equalsIgnoreCase(stored.trim())) {
            return stored.trim();
        }
        try {
            FirebaseUser user = FirebaseAuth.getInstance().getCurrentUser();
            if (user != null && user.getEmail() != null && user.getEmail().contains("@")) {
                return user.getEmail().substring(0, user.getEmail().indexOf('@'));
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return context.getString(R.string.profile_default_name);
    }

    /**
     * 3-Tier Dual-AI Failover Router:
     * Tier 1: OpenRouter (Llama 3.3 70B Free)
     * Tier 2: Official Firebase AI Logic SDK (Gemini Developer API)
     * Tier 3: Offline Smart RegEx Parser
     */
    public static void autoCleanSongMetadata(Context context, String rawTitle, String rawArtist, MetadataCallback callback) {
        initFirebaseAppCheck(context);
        final String openRouterKey = getApiKey(context);
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
        Handler mainHandler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

        executor.execute(() -> {
            try {
                if (!openRouterKey.isEmpty()) {
                    String[] orResult = callOpenRouterModel(openRouterKey, rawTitle, rawArtist);
                    if (orResult != null) {
                        mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(orResult[0], orResult[1], true));
                        return;
                    }
                }

                String[] firebaseResult = callFirebaseAiSdk(rawTitle, rawArtist);
                if (firebaseResult != null) {
                    mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(firebaseResult[0], firebaseResult[1], true));
                    return;
                }

                String[] offline = cleanOffline(rawTitle, rawArtist);
                mainHandler.post(() -> callback.onResult(offline[0], offline[1], false));
            } finally {
                executor.shutdown();
            }
        });
    }

    private static String[] callFirebaseAiSdk(String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
        try {
            GenerativeModel ai = FirebaseAI.getInstance(GenerativeBackend.googleAI())
                    .generativeModel("gemini-2.5-flash");
            GenerativeModelFutures model = GenerativeModelFutures.from(ai);

            String promptText = "Extract the clean song title and artist from this messy filename/tag. "
                    + "Raw Title: \"" + rawTitle + "\", Raw Artist: \"" + rawArtist + "\". "
                    + "Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format: {\"title\":\"Clean Title\",\"artist\":\"Clean Artist\"}";

            Content prompt = new Content.Builder()
                    .addText(promptText)
                    .build();

            ListenableFuture<GenerateContentResponse> future = model.generateContent(prompt);
            GenerateContentResponse result = future.get(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if (result != null && result.getText() != null) {
                return parseJsonPair(result.getText().trim(), rawTitle, rawArtist);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String[] callOpenRouterModel(String apiKey, String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
        try {
            URL url = new URL("https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions");
            HttpURLConnection conn = (HttpURLConnection) url.openConnection();
            conn.setRequestMethod("POST");
            conn.setConnectTimeout(5000);
            conn.setReadTimeout(7000);
            conn.setRequestProperty("Authorization", "Bearer " + apiKey);
            conn.setRequestProperty("Content-Type", "application/json");
            conn.setDoOutput(true);

            String prompt = "Extract the clean song title and artist from this messy filename/tag. "
                    + "Raw Title: \"" + rawTitle + "\", Raw Artist: \"" + rawArtist + "\". "
                    + "Respond ONLY with valid JSON in this exact format: {\"title\":\"Clean Title\",\"artist\":\"Clean Artist\"}";

            JSONObject body = new JSONObject();
            body.put("model", "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free");
            JSONArray messages = new JSONArray();
            JSONObject msg = new JSONObject();
            msg.put("role", "user");
            msg.put("content", prompt);
            messages.put(msg);
            body.put("messages", messages);

            try (OutputStream os = conn.getOutputStream()) {
                os.write(body.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            }

            if (conn.getResponseCode() == 200) {
                StringBuilder resp = new StringBuilder();
                try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(conn.getInputStream(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8))) {
                    String line;
                    while ((line = br.readLine()) != null) resp.append(line);
                }
                JSONObject jsonResp = new JSONObject(resp.toString());
                String content = jsonResp.getJSONArray("choices")
                        .getJSONObject(0)
                        .getJSONObject("message")
                        .getString("content").trim();

                return parseJsonPair(content, rawTitle, rawArtist);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static String[] parseJsonPair(String content, String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
        try {
            int start = content.indexOf('{');
            int end = content.lastIndexOf('}');
            if (start != -1 && end != -1 && end > start) {
                JSONObject parsed = new JSONObject(content.substring(start, end + 1));
                String aiTitle = parsed.optString("title", rawTitle).trim();
                String aiArtist = parsed.optString("artist", rawArtist).trim();
                return new String[]{aiTitle, aiArtist};
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
        return null;
    }

    public static List<Song> curateSmartMix(Context context, List<Song> allSongs) {
        List<Song> mix = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Song> others = new ArrayList<>();
        for (Song s : allSongs) {
            if (s.getUri() != null && SongMetadataManager.isFavorite(context, s.getUri().toString())) {
                mix.add(s);
            } else {
                others.add(s);
            }
        }
        Collections.shuffle(others);
        int limit = Math.min(25, others.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            mix.add(others.get(i));
        }
        return mix.isEmpty() ? new ArrayList<>(allSongs) : mix;
    }

    private static String[] cleanOffline(String rawTitle, String rawArtist) {
        String title = rawTitle != null ? rawTitle : "Unknown Track";
        String artist = (rawArtist != null && !rawArtist.contains("<unknown>")) ? rawArtist : "Unknown Artist";

        title = title.replace("_", " ")
                .replaceAll("(?i)\\(official.*?\\)|\\[official.*?\\]|\\(lyrics.*?\\)|\\[lyrics.*?\\]|\\(audio\\)|\\[audio\\]|\\bHD\\b|\\bHQ\\b|\\b320kbps\\b|\\b128kbps\\b", "")
                .replaceAll("\\s+", " ")
                .trim();

        if (title.contains(" - ")) {
            String[] parts = title.split(" - ", 2);
            if (artist.equalsIgnoreCase("Unknown Artist") || artist.equalsIgnoreCase("Unknown")) {
                artist = parts[0].trim();
                title = parts[1].trim();
            }
        }
        return new String[]{title, artist};
    }

    public static MediaItem buildAdaptiveMediaItem(Song song) {
        Uri artworkUri = song.getCustomCoverUri() != null
                ? song.getCustomCoverUri()
                : Uri.withAppendedPath(song.getUri(), "albumart");

        MediaMetadata meta = new MediaMetadata.Builder()
                .setTitle(song.getTitle())
                .setArtist(song.getArtist())
                .setArtworkUri(artworkUri)
                .build();

        return new MediaItem.Builder()
                .setUri(song.getUri())
                .setMediaId(song.getUri().toString())
                .setMediaMetadata(meta)
                .build();
    }

    public static List<MediaItem> buildAdaptiveQueue(List<Song> songs) {
        List<MediaItem> items = new ArrayList<>(songs.size());
        for (Song s : songs) {
            items.add(buildAdaptiveMediaItem(s));
        }
        return items;
    }

    /**
     * Ensures any extracted accent color is visible against dark surfaces and never pure black/white.
     */
    public static int ensureReadableAccent(int rawColor, int fallbackColor) {
        double lum = ColorUtils.calculateLuminance(rawColor);
        if (lum < 0.12) {
            return ColorUtils.blendARGB(rawColor, fallbackColor, 0.65f);
        } else if (lum > 0.85) {
            return ColorUtils.blendARGB(rawColor, fallbackColor, 0.30f);
        }
        return rawColor;
    }

    public static void saveLastPlayedState(Context context, MediaController controller) {
        if (context == null || controller == null) return;
        MediaItem current = controller.getCurrentMediaItem();
        if (current == null || current.mediaId.isEmpty()) return;

        String uriStr = current.mediaId;
        String title = current.mediaMetadata.title != null ? current.mediaMetadata.title.toString() : "Unknown Track";
        String artist = current.mediaMetadata.artist != null ? current.mediaMetadata.artist.toString() : "Unknown Artist";
        String coverStr = current.mediaMetadata.artworkUri != null ? current.mediaMetadata.artworkUri.toString() : "";
        long posMs = Math.max(0L, controller.getCurrentPosition());

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_LAST_PLAYED, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        prefs.edit()
                .putString(KEY_URI, uriStr)
                .putString(KEY_TITLE, title)
                .putString(KEY_ARTIST, artist)
                .putString(KEY_COVER, coverStr)
                .putLong(KEY_POSITION_MS, posMs)
                .apply();

        if (isOnline(context)) {
            try {
                Bundle payload = new Bundle();
                payload.putString("track_uri", uriStr);
                payload.putString("track_title", title);
                payload.putString("track_artist", artist);
                payload.putLong("position_ms", posMs);
                FirebaseAnalytics.getInstance(context.getApplicationContext())
                        .logEvent("auralis_last_played_sync", payload);
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    public static void restoreLastPlayedIfIdle(Context context, MediaController controller) {
        if (context == null || controller == null) return;
        if (controller.getMediaItemCount() > 0) return;

        SharedPreferences prefs = context.getSharedPreferences(PREFS_LAST_PLAYED, Context.MODE_PRIVATE);
        if (!prefs.getBoolean(KEY_AUTO_RESUME, true)) return;

        String uriStr = prefs.getString(KEY_URI, "");
        if (uriStr.isEmpty()) return;

        try {
            Uri songUri = Uri.parse(uriStr);
            try (android.database.Cursor c = context.getContentResolver().query(
                    songUri, new String[]{android.provider.MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID}, null, null, null)) {
                if (c == null || !c.moveToFirst()) {
                    prefs.edit().clear().apply();
                    return;
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                prefs.edit().clear().apply();
                return;
            }

            String title = prefs.getString(KEY_TITLE, "Unknown Track");
            String artist = prefs.getString(KEY_ARTIST, "Unknown Artist");
            String coverStr = prefs.getString(KEY_COVER, "");
            long posMs = prefs.getLong(KEY_POSITION_MS, 0L);

            Uri artUri = !coverStr.isEmpty() ? Uri.parse(coverStr) : Uri.withAppendedPath(songUri, "albumart");
            MediaMetadata meta = new MediaMetadata.Builder()
                    .setTitle(title)
                    .setArtist(artist)
                    .setArtworkUri(artUri)
                    .build();
            MediaItem item = new MediaItem.Builder()
                    .setUri(songUri)
                    .setMediaId(uriStr)
                    .setMediaMetadata(meta)
                    .build();
            controller.setMediaItems(Collections.singletonList(item), 0, posMs);
            controller.prepare();
            controller.pause();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    public static void syncMiniPlayerView(
            Context context,
            MediaController controller,
            View miniContainer,
            TextView miniTitle,
            TextView miniSubtitle,
            ShapeableImageView miniArt,
            ImageButton btnPlayPause) {
        if (controller == null) return;
        restoreLastPlayedIfIdle(context, controller);

        MediaItem item = controller.getCurrentMediaItem();
        if (item == null || item.mediaId.isEmpty()) {
            if (miniContainer != null) miniContainer.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            return;
        }
        if (miniContainer != null) miniContainer.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

        CharSequence title = item.mediaMetadata.title;
        CharSequence artist = item.mediaMetadata.artist;
        if (miniTitle != null && title != null && title.length() > 0) miniTitle.setText(title);
        if (miniSubtitle != null && artist != null && artist.length() > 0) miniSubtitle.setText(artist);

        if (btnPlayPause != null) {
            btnPlayPause.setImageResource(controller.isPlaying() ? R.drawable.ic_pause_24 : R.drawable.ic_play_arrow_24);
        }

        if (miniArt != null) {
            final Uri artworkUri = item.mediaMetadata.artworkUri;
            final Uri audioUri = Uri.parse(item.mediaId);
            final Context appCtx = context.getApplicationContext();
            miniArt.setTag(item.mediaId);

            ARTWORK_EXECUTOR.execute(() -> {
                Bitmap thumb = ArtworkColorHelper.loadArtworkBitmap(appCtx, artworkUri, audioUri, 128);
                Palette palette = thumb != null ? Palette.from(thumb).generate() : null;
                MAIN_HANDLER.post(() -> {
                    if (!item.mediaId.equals(miniArt.getTag())) return;
                    if (thumb != null) {
                        miniArt.setImageBitmap(thumb);
                        applyPaletteToMiniPlayer(appCtx, palette, miniContainer, miniTitle, miniSubtitle, btnPlayPause);
                    } else {
                        miniArt.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_album_placeholder);
                        resetMiniPlayerPalette(appCtx, miniContainer, miniTitle, miniSubtitle, btnPlayPause);
                    }
                });
            });
        }
    }

    private static void applyPaletteToMiniPlayer(
            Context context,
            Palette palette,
            View container,
            TextView title,
            TextView subtitle,
            ImageButton btnPlayPause) {
        if (container == null || palette == null) return;
        int defaultCard = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.surface_card);
        int defaultAccent = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.accent_blue);

        int rawDom = palette.getDominantColor(defaultCard);
        int rawVibrant = palette.getVibrantColor(palette.getLightVibrantColor(rawDom));
        int safeAccent = ensureReadableAccent(rawVibrant, defaultAccent);

        int startBg = ColorUtils.blendARGB(rawDom, Color.parseColor("#121316"), 0.55f);
        int endBg = Color.parseColor("#181A20");
        GradientDrawable gd = new GradientDrawable(
                GradientDrawable.Orientation.LEFT_RIGHT,
                new int[]{startBg, endBg});
        container.setBackground(gd);

        boolean isLightBg = ColorUtils.calculateLuminance(startBg) > 0.45;
        int primaryText = isLightBg ? Color.parseColor("#121316") : Color.WHITE;
        int secondaryText = isLightBg ? Color.parseColor("#44474E") : Color.parseColor("#B0B5BE");

        if (title != null) title.setTextColor(primaryText);
        if (subtitle != null) subtitle.setTextColor(secondaryText);
        if (btnPlayPause != null) {
            btnPlayPause.setImageTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(safeAccent));
        }
    }

    private static void resetMiniPlayerPalette(
            Context context,
            View container,
            TextView title,
            TextView subtitle,
            ImageButton btnPlayPause) {
        if (container != null) {
            container.setBackgroundColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.surface_card));
        }
        if (title != null) title.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.text_primary));
        if (subtitle != null) subtitle.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.text_secondary));
        if (btnPlayPause != null) {
            btnPlayPause.setImageTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.accent_blue)));
        }
    }

    public static boolean isOnline(Context context) {
        try {
            ConnectivityManager cm = (ConnectivityManager) context.getSystemService(Context.CONNECTIVITY_SERVICE);
            if (cm == null) return false;
            Network net = cm.getActiveNetwork();
            if (net == null) return false;
            NetworkCapabilities caps = cm.getNetworkCapabilities(net);
            return caps != null && caps.hasCapability(NetworkCapabilities.NET_CAPABILITY_INTERNET);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    public static AudioDeviceCallback registerLiveOutputTracker(Context context, TextView tvDeviceName, TextView tvCodec) {
        updateOutputLabels(context, tvDeviceName, tvCodec);
        AudioManager am = (AudioManager) context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        if (am == null) return null;
        AudioDeviceCallback callback = new AudioDeviceCallback() {
            @Override
            public void onAudioDevicesAdded(AudioDeviceInfo[] addedDevices) {
                updateOutputLabels(context, tvDeviceName, tvCodec);
            }
            @Override
            public void onAudioDevicesRemoved(AudioDeviceInfo[] removedDevices) {
                updateOutputLabels(context, tvDeviceName, tvCodec);
            }
        };
        am.registerAudioDeviceCallback(callback, new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()));
        return callback;
    }

    public static void unregisterLiveOutputTracker(Context context, AudioDeviceCallback callback) {
        if (context == null || callback == null) return;
        AudioManager am = (AudioManager) context.getSystemService(Context.AUDIO_SERVICE);
        if (am != null) am.unregisterAudioDeviceCallback(callback);
    }

    public static void updateOutputLabels(Context context, TextView tvDeviceName, TextView tvCodec) {
        if (tvDeviceName == null || tvCodec == null) return;
        AudioRouteHelper.RouteInfo info = AudioRouteHelper.getActiveRouteInfo(context);
        tvDeviceName.setText(info.deviceName);
        tvCodec.setText(info.codecSubtitle);
    }

import androidx.media3.session.MediaSessionService;

public class PlaybackService extends MediaSessionService {

    private static volatile int activeAudioSessionId = C.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_UNSET;

    private ExoPlayer player;
    private MediaSession mediaSession;

    public static int getActiveAudioSessionId() {
        return activeAudioSessionId;
    }

    @OptIn(markerClass = UnstableApi.class)
    @Override
    public void onCreate() {
        super.onCreate();

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
            NotificationChannel channel = new NotificationChannel(
                    "auralis_playback_channel",
                    "Music Playback",
                    NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW
            );
            channel.setDescription("Ongoing music playback controls");
            NotificationManager manager = getSystemService(NotificationManager.class);
            if (manager != null) {
                manager.createNotificationChannel(channel);
            }

        // Explicit Music AudioAttributes so Android automatically ducks on notifications and pauses on phone calls
        AudioAttributes musicAttributes = new AudioAttributes.Builder()
                .setUsage(C.USAGE_MEDIA)
                .setContentType(C.AUDIO_CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC)
                .build();

        player = new ExoPlayer.Builder(this)
                .setAudioAttributes(musicAttributes, true)
                .setHandleAudioBecomingNoisy(true)
                .build();

        activeAudioSessionId = player.getAudioSessionId();
        player.addListener(new Player.Listener() {
            @Override
            public void onAudioSessionIdChanged(int audioSessionId) {
                activeAudioSessionId = audioSessionId;
            }
        });

        DefaultMediaNotificationProvider notificationProvider = new DefaultMediaNotificationProvider.Builder(this)
                .setNotificationId(1)
                .setChannelId("auralis_playback_channel")
                .build();
        notificationProvider.setSmallIcon(R.drawable.ic_library_music_24);

        Intent openPlayerIntent = new Intent(this, NowPlayingActivity.class);
        PendingIntent sessionActivity = PendingIntent.getActivity(
                this,
                0,
                openPlayerIntent,
                PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT | PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE
        );

        mediaSession = new MediaSession.Builder(this, player)
                .setSessionActivity(sessionActivity)
                .build();
        setMediaNotificationProvider(notificationProvider);
    }

    @Nullable
    @Override
    public MediaSession onGetSession(MediaSession.ControllerInfo controllerInfo) {
        return mediaSession;
    }

    @Override
    public void onDestroy() {
        activeAudioSessionId = C.AUDIO_SESSION_ID_UNSET;
        if (mediaSession != null) {
            mediaSession.getPlayer().release();
            mediaSession.release();
            mediaSession = null;
        } else if (player != null) {
            player.release();
        }
        player = null;
        super.onDestroy();
    }
}

    private static class LrcLine implements Comparable<LrcLine> {
        final long timeMs;
        final String text;

        LrcLine(long timeMs, String text) {
            this.timeMs = timeMs;
            this.text = text;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(LrcLine other) {
            return Long.compare(this.timeMs, other.timeMs);
        }

                if (fromUser && mediaController != null) {
                    long duration = mediaController.getDuration();
                    if (duration > 0) {
                        long newPos = (duration * progress) / 1000L;
                        tvTimeCurrent.setText(formatTime(newPos));
                        tvTimeRemaining.setText(getString(R.string.time_remaining_fmt, formatTime(duration - newPos)));
                        lastSyncedLrcIndex = -1;
                        updateSynchronizedLyrics(newPos, duration);

            @Override
            public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {
                isTracking = true;
            }

            @Override
            public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {
                if (mediaController != null) {
                    long duration = mediaController.getDuration();
                    if (duration > 0) {
                        lastSyncedLrcIndex = -1;
                        mediaController.seekTo((duration * seekBar.getProgress()) / 1000L);
                    }
                }
                isTracking = false;

    private void showOverflowMenu(View anchor) {
        PopupMenu popup = new PopupMenu(this, anchor);
        popup.inflate(R.menu.now_playing_overflow_menu);
        popup.setOnMenuItemClickListener(menuItem -> {
            int id = menuItem.getItemId();
            if (id == R.id.action_np_edit_track) {
                openTrackEditorForCurrentSong();
                return true;
            } else if (id == R.id.action_np_ai_clean) {
                aiCleanCurrentSong();
                return true;
            } else if (id == R.id.action_np_calibrate_lyrics) {
                showLyricsSyncCalibrationDialog();
                return true;
            } else if (id == R.id.action_np_equalizer) {
                startActivity(new Intent(this, EqualizerActivity.class));
                return true;
            } else if (id == R.id.action_np_playlists) {
                startActivity(new Intent(this, PlaylistsActivity.class));
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        });
        popup.show();
    }

    private void aiCleanCurrentSong() {
        if (mediaController == null) return;
        MediaItem item = mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem();
        if (item == null || item.mediaId.isEmpty()) return;
        String curTitle = tvTitle.getText().toString();
        String curArtist = tvArtist.getText().toString();
        Toast.makeText(this, "Cleaning tags...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        OpenRouterAiHelper.autoCleanSongMetadata(this, curTitle, curArtist, (cleanTitle, cleanArtist, usedCloudAi) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
            Song temp = new Song(cleanTitle, cleanArtist, Uri.parse(item.mediaId), 0);
            SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(this, temp, true);
            SongMetadataManager.saveSongEdit(this, temp, cleanTitle, cleanArtist, temp.getCustomCoverUri(), temp.getLyrics());
            tvTitle.setText(cleanTitle);
            tvArtist.setText(cleanArtist);
            Toast.makeText(this, (usedCloudAi ? "✨ AI Cleaned: " : "✨ Cleaned: ") + cleanTitle, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        });
    }

    private void showLyricsSyncCalibrationDialog() {
        if (mediaController == null || mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem() == null) return;
        final String mediaId = mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem().mediaId;
        final long[] offsets = new long[]{-400L, -200L, 0L, 200L, 400L};
        final String[] labels = new String[]{
                "Earlier by 400ms (-400ms)",
                "Earlier by 200ms (-200ms)",
                "Default (0ms • ±200ms Auto VBR Tolerance)",
                "Later by 200ms (+200ms)",
                "Later by 400ms (+400ms)"
        };
        int checked = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < offsets.length; i++) {
            if (offsets[i] == userCalibrationOffsetMs) {
                checked = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        new MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.menu_calibrate_lyrics_sync)
                .setSingleChoiceItems(labels, checked, (dialog, which) -> {
                    userCalibrationOffsetMs = offsets[which];
                    SongMetadataManager.setLrcOffsetMs(this, mediaId, userCalibrationOffsetMs);
                    lastSyncedLrcIndex = -1;
                    syncProgress();
                    dialog.dismiss();
                    Toast.makeText(this, "Lyrics sync offset: " + offsets[which] + "ms", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void openTrackEditorForCurrentSong() {
        if (mediaController == null) return;
        MediaItem item = mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem();
        if (item == null || item.mediaId.isEmpty()) return;
        Intent editIntent = new Intent(this, EditTrackActivity.class);
        editIntent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_URI", item.mediaId);
        editIntent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_TITLE", tvTitle != null ? tvTitle.getText().toString() : "");
        editIntent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_ARTIST", tvArtist != null ? tvArtist.getText().toString() : "");
        startActivity(editIntent);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStart() {
        super.onStart();
        AudioRouteHelper.bindRouteViews(this, tvDeviceName, tvDeviceCodec, ivRouteIcon);
        audioDeviceCallback = AudioRouteHelper.registerLiveRouteCallback(this,
                () -> AudioRouteHelper.bindRouteViews(this, tvDeviceName, tvDeviceCodec, ivRouteIcon));

        SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
        controllerFuture = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
        controllerFuture.addListener(() -> {
            try {
                mediaController = controllerFuture.get();
                mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                syncMetadata(true);
                syncPlayPauseState();
                syncShuffleState(currentAccentColor);
                syncRepeatState(currentAccentColor);
                if (mediaController.isPlaying()) {
                    progressHandler.post(progressRunnable);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        refreshDspBadge();
        if (mediaController != null) {
            syncMetadata(true);
        }
    }

    private void refreshDspBadge() {
        if (badgeDspStatus == null) return;
        SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences(OpenRouterAiHelper.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE);
        boolean eqEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("eq_master_enabled", true);
        String preset = prefs.getString("eq_preset_name", "BALANCED");
        badgeDspStatus.setText(eqEnabled ? "DSP: " + preset.toUpperCase(Locale.US) : "DSP: BYPASS");
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStop() {
        super.onStop();
        AudioRouteHelper.unregisterLiveRouteCallback(this, audioDeviceCallback);
        audioDeviceCallback = null;
        if (mediaController != null) {
            PlaybackStateHelper.saveLastPlayedState(this, mediaController);
        }
        progressHandler.removeCallbacks(progressRunnable);
        if (mediaController != null) {
            mediaController.removeListener(playerListener);
            mediaController = null;
        }
        if (controllerFuture != null) {
            MediaController.releaseFuture(controllerFuture);
            controllerFuture = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        if (ioExecutor != null) {
            ioExecutor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    private void syncMetadata(boolean forceReloadAssets) {
        if (mediaController == null) return;
        MediaItem item = mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem();
        if (item == null || item.mediaId.isEmpty()) return;

        final String mediaId = item.mediaId;
        final boolean trackChanged = !mediaId.equals(loadedMediaId);
        loadedMediaId = mediaId;
        if (trackChanged) {
            lastSyncedLrcIndex = -1;
        }

        final String rawTitle = item.mediaMetadata.title != null ? item.mediaMetadata.title.toString() : "Unknown Track";
        final String rawArtist = item.mediaMetadata.artist != null ? item.mediaMetadata.artist.toString() : "Unknown Artist";
        final Uri metadataArtUri = item.mediaMetadata.artworkUri;

        if (!forceReloadAssets && !trackChanged) {
            syncProgress();
            syncFavoriteState(currentAccentColor);
            return;
        }

        ioExecutor.execute(() -> {
            Uri audioUri = Uri.parse(mediaId);
            Song temp = new Song(rawTitle, rawArtist, audioUri, 0);
            SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(getApplicationContext(), temp, true);
            long savedOffset = SongMetadataManager.getLrcOffsetMs(getApplicationContext(), mediaId);

            Uri coverUri = temp.getCustomCoverUri() != null ? temp.getCustomCoverUri() : metadataArtUri;
            Bitmap artBitmap = ArtworkColorHelper.loadArtworkBitmap(getApplicationContext(), coverUri, audioUri, 512);
            Palette palette = artBitmap != null ? Palette.from(artBitmap).generate() : null;

            progressHandler.post(() -> {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed() || !mediaId.equals(loadedMediaId)) return;

                String displayArtist = temp.getAlbum().isEmpty()
                        ? temp.getArtist()
                        : temp.getArtist() + " • " + temp.getAlbum();
                tvTitle.setText(temp.getTitle());
                tvArtist.setText(displayArtist);
                userCalibrationOffsetMs = savedOffset;

                loadAndParseLyrics(temp.getLyrics());

                if (artBitmap != null) {
                    ivArt.setImageBitmap(artBitmap);
                    int accent = ArtworkColorHelper.extractVibrantAccent(palette, NowPlayingActivity.this);
                    applyThemeColor(PlaybackStateHelper.ensureReadableAccent(
                            accent, ContextCompat.getColor(NowPlayingActivity.this, R.color.accent_blue)));
                } else {
                    ivArt.setImageResource(R.drawable.ic_album_placeholder_large);
                    resetPalette();
                }

                syncProgress();
                syncFavoriteState(currentAccentColor);
            });
        });
    }

    private void loadAndParseLyrics(String rawLyrics) {
        parsedLrcLines.clear();
        plainLyricLines.clear();
        lrcHeaderOffsetMs = 0L;
        lastSyncedLrcIndex = -1;

        if (rawLyrics != null && !rawLyrics.trim().isEmpty()) {
            String[] lines = rawLyrics.split("\\r?\\n");
            StringBuilder fullTextBuilder = new StringBuilder();

            for (String rawLine : lines) {
                String line = rawLine.trim();
                if (line.isEmpty()) continue;

                Matcher offsetMatcher = LRC_OFFSET_TAG_PATTERN.matcher(line);
                if (offsetMatcher.matches()) {
                    try {
                        lrcHeaderOffsetMs = Long.parseLong(offsetMatcher.group(1));
                    } catch (NumberFormatException ignored) {
                    }
                    continue;
                }

                Matcher timeMatcher = LRC_TIMESTAMP_PATTERN.matcher(line);
                List<Long> timestamps = new ArrayList<>();
                int lastMatchEnd = 0;
                while (timeMatcher.find()) {
                    long min = Long.parseLong(timeMatcher.group(1));
                    long sec = Long.parseLong(timeMatcher.group(2));
                    String frac = timeMatcher.group(3);
                    long ms = 0L;
                    if (frac != null && !frac.isEmpty()) {
                        ms = Long.parseLong(frac) * (frac.length() == 1 ? 100L : (frac.length() == 2 ? 10L : 1L));
                    }
                    timestamps.add(min * 60_000L + sec * 1_000L + ms);
                    lastMatchEnd = timeMatcher.end();
                }

                if (!timestamps.isEmpty()) {
                    String lyricText = line.substring(lastMatchEnd).trim();
                    if (!lyricText.isEmpty()) {
                        for (Long ts : timestamps) {
                            parsedLrcLines.add(new LrcLine(ts, lyricText));
                        }
                        fullTextBuilder.append(lyricText).append('\n');
                    }
                } else if (!line.startsWith("[")) {
                    plainLyricLines.add(line);
                    fullTextBuilder.append(line).append('\n');
                }
            }

            Collections.sort(parsedLrcLines);
            if (tvScrolledLyrics != null) {
                String built = fullTextBuilder.toString().trim();
                tvScrolledLyrics.setText(built.isEmpty() ? getString(R.string.no_lyrics_loaded) : built);
            }
        } else {
            if (tvScrolledLyrics != null) {
                tvScrolledLyrics.setText(R.string.no_lyrics_loaded);
            }
        }

        if (parsedLrcLines.isEmpty() && plainLyricLines.isEmpty()) {
            if (tvLyricActive != null) {
                tvLyricActive.setText(R.string.lyrics_hint_active);
                tvLyricActive.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_primary));
            }
            if (tvLyricNext != null) {
                tvLyricNext.setText(R.string.lyrics_hint_next);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Synchronizes .lrc timestamps against mediaController.getCurrentPosition() using a ±200ms
     * fuzzy matching tolerance window to absorb VBR seek/frame drift and lead-in silence.
     */
    private void updateSynchronizedLyrics(long rawPositionMs, long durMs) {
        if (tvLyricActive == null || tvLyricNext == null) return;

        if (!parsedLrcLines.isEmpty()) {
            // Apply [offset:] tag and per-song user calibration against live player position
            long effectivePosMs = rawPositionMs - lrcHeaderOffsetMs + userCalibrationOffsetMs;
            // Look ahead up to +200ms fuzzy window so VBR lead-in / encoder padding never lags vocals
            long fuzzyMatchCeilingMs = effectivePosMs + LRC_FUZZY_TOLERANCE_MS;

            int candidateIdx = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < parsedLrcLines.size(); i++) {
                if (fuzzyMatchCeilingMs >= parsedLrcLines.get(i).timeMs) {
                    candidateIdx = i;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (candidateIdx < 0) {
                // Before the first timestamp (outside +200ms window): preview upcoming first line
                tvLyricActive.setText("♪ …");
                tvLyricActive.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_secondary));
                tvLyricNext.setText(parsedLrcLines.get(0).text);
                lastSyncedLrcIndex = -1;
                return;
            }

            // Hysteresis within -200ms tolerance window so VBR jitter never flickers backward by 1 line
            if (lastSyncedLrcIndex >= 0
                    && candidateIdx == lastSyncedLrcIndex - 1
                    && lastSyncedLrcIndex < parsedLrcLines.size()) {
                long prevLineTime = parsedLrcLines.get(lastSyncedLrcIndex).timeMs;
                if (Math.abs(effectivePosMs - prevLineTime) <= LRC_FUZZY_TOLERANCE_MS) {
                    candidateIdx = lastSyncedLrcIndex;
                }
            }

            if (candidateIdx != lastSyncedLrcIndex) {
                lastSyncedLrcIndex = candidateIdx;
                tvLyricActive.setText("♪ " + parsedLrcLines.get(candidateIdx).text);
                tvLyricActive.setTextColor(currentAccentColor);
                if (candidateIdx + 1 < parsedLrcLines.size()) {
                    tvLyricNext.setText(parsedLrcLines.get(candidateIdx + 1).text);
                } else {
                    tvLyricNext.setText("");
                }
            }
        } else if (!plainLyricLines.isEmpty() && durMs > 0) {
            int idx = (int) ((rawPositionMs * plainLyricLines.size()) / durMs);
            idx = Math.max(0, Math.min(plainLyricLines.size() - 1, idx));
            if (idx != lastSyncedLrcIndex) {
                lastSyncedLrcIndex = idx;
                tvLyricActive.setText("♪ " + plainLyricLines.get(idx));
                tvLyricActive.setTextColor(currentAccentColor);
                if (idx + 1 < plainLyricLines.size()) {
                    tvLyricNext.setText(plainLyricLines.get(idx + 1));
                } else {
                    tvLyricNext.setText("");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private void resetPalette() {
        applyThemeColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.accent_blue));
    }

    private void applyThemeColor(int color) {
        currentAccentColor = color;
        ColorStateList accentList = ColorStateList.valueOf(color);

        btnPlayPause.setBackgroundTintList(accentList);
        int fabIconColor = ColorUtils.calculateLuminance(color) > 0.42 ? Color.parseColor("#121316") : Color.WHITE;
        btnPlayPause.setSupportImageTintList(ColorStateList.valueOf(fabIconColor));

        if (btnPrev != null) btnPrev.setIconTint(accentList);
        if (btnNext != null) btnNext.setIconTint(accentList);
        if (btnLyricsSheet != null) btnLyricsSheet.setIconTint(accentList);
        if (badgeDspStatus != null) badgeDspStatus.setTextColor(color);

        TextView badge = findViewById(R.id.badge_lossless_master);
        if (badge != null) {
            badge.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_primary));
        }

        seekBar.setProgressTintList(accentList);
        seekBar.setThumbTintList(accentList);

        if (!parsedLrcLines.isEmpty() || !plainLyricLines.isEmpty()) {
            tvLyricActive.setTextColor(color);
        }

        if (mediaController != null) {
            syncFavoriteState(color);
            syncShuffleState(color);
            syncRepeatState(color);
        }
    }

    private void syncFavoriteState(int activeColor) {
        if (mediaController == null || btnFav == null) return;
        MediaItem item = mediaController.getCurrentMediaItem();
        if (item != null && !item.mediaId.isEmpty()) {
            boolean isFav = SongMetadataManager.isFavorite(this, item.mediaId);
            btnFav.setIconResource(isFav ? R.drawable.ic_favorite_24 : R.drawable.ic_favorite_border_24);
            int tint = isFav ? activeColor : ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_secondary);
            btnFav.setIconTint(ColorStateList.valueOf(tint));
        }
    }

    private void syncPlayPauseState() {
        if (mediaController == null || btnPlayPause == null) return;
        btnPlayPause.setImageResource(mediaController.isPlaying() ? R.drawable.ic_pause_24 : R.drawable.ic_play_arrow_24);
    }

    private void syncShuffleState(int activeColor) {
        if (mediaController == null || btnShuffle == null) return;
        int tint = mediaController.getShuffleModeEnabled() ? activeColor : ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_secondary);
        btnShuffle.setIconTint(ColorStateList.valueOf(tint));
    }

    private void syncRepeatState(int activeColor) {
        if (mediaController == null || btnRepeat == null) return;
        int mode = mediaController.getRepeatMode();
        int tint = mode != Player.REPEAT_MODE_OFF ? activeColor : ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_secondary);
        btnRepeat.setIconTint(ColorStateList.valueOf(tint));
    }

    private void syncProgress() {
        if (mediaController == null || isTracking) return;
        long pos = Math.max(0L, mediaController.getCurrentPosition());
        long dur = mediaController.getDuration();
        if (dur > 0) {
            seekBar.setProgress((int) ((pos * 1000L) / dur));
            tvTimeCurrent.setText(formatTime(pos));
            tvTimeRemaining.setText(getString(R.string.time_remaining_fmt, formatTime(dur - pos)));
            updateSynchronizedLyrics(pos, dur);
        }
    }

    private String formatTime(long ms) {
        long totalSec = Math.max(0, ms / 1000);
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%d:%02d", totalSec / 60, totalSec % 60);
    }
}

            String yrGenre = editYearGenre != null ? editYearGenre.getText().toString().trim() : "";
            String rawSnippet = snippetLrc != null ? snippetLrc.getText().toString() : "";
            String l = !rawSnippet.startsWith("No lyrics") ? rawSnippet.trim() : "";

            if (t == null || t.isEmpty()) t = "Unknown Track";
            if (a == null || a.isEmpty()) a = "Unknown Artist";

            Song updated = new Song(t, a, songUri, 0);
            SongMetadataManager.saveSongEditFull(this, updated, t, a, alb, trkNum, yrGenre, pendingCoverUri, l);
            Toast.makeText(this, "Saved! .lrc backed up to Auralis/Lyrics/", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        }
        finish();

    private void toggleSearchAnimation() {
        if (searchViewLibrary == null) return;
        searchIsVisible = !searchIsVisible;
        searchViewLibrary.animate().cancel();
        if (searchIsVisible) {
            searchViewLibrary.setAlpha(0f);
            searchViewLibrary.setTranslationY(-16f);
            searchViewLibrary.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            searchViewLibrary.animate()
                    .alpha(1f)
                    .translationY(0f)
                    .setDuration(220)
                    .setInterpolator(UiAnimationHelper.OVERSHOOT)
                    .withLayer()
                    .start();
            searchViewLibrary.setIconified(false);
        } else {
            searchViewLibrary.animate()
                    .alpha(0f)
                    .translationY(-16f)
                    .setDuration(150)
                    .setInterpolator(UiAnimationHelper.DECELERATE)
                    .withLayer()
                    .withEndAction(() -> {
                        searchViewLibrary.setVisibility(View.GONE);
                        searchViewLibrary.setQuery("", false);
                    })
                    .start();
        }
    }

    private void setupSearchFilter() {
        if (searchViewLibrary != null) {
            searchViewLibrary.setOnQueryTextListener(new SearchView.OnQueryTextListener() {
                @Override
                public boolean onQueryTextSubmit(String query) {
                    return false;
                }

                @Override
                public boolean onQueryTextChange(String newText) {
                    filterLibrary(newText);
                    return true;
                }
            });
        }
    }

    private void filterLibrary(String query) {
        displayedList.clear();
        if (query == null || query.trim().isEmpty()) {
            displayedList.addAll(songList);
        } else {
            String lower = query.toLowerCase(Locale.US).trim();
            for (Song s : songList) {
                if ((s.getTitle() != null && s.getTitle().toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(lower)) ||
                        (s.getArtist() != null && s.getArtist().toLowerCase(Locale.US).contains(lower))) {
                    displayedList.add(s);
                }
            }
        }
        if (adapter != null) adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
        updateLibraryStats();
    }

    private void checkPermissionAndScan() {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, new String[]{Manifest.permission.READ_MEDIA_AUDIO}, PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE);
            } else {
                scanMedia();
            }
        } else {
            if (ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, new String[]{Manifest.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE}, PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE);
            } else {
                scanMedia();
            }
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onRequestPermissionsResult(int requestCode, @NonNull String[] permissions, @NonNull int[] grantResults) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults);
        if (requestCode == PERMISSION_REQUEST_CODE) {
            if (grantResults.length > 0 && grantResults[0] == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                scanMedia();
            } else {
                if (textLibraryStats != null) textLibraryStats.setText(R.string.storage_permission_required);
            }
        }
    }

    private void scanMedia() {
        scanExecutor.execute(() -> {
            List<Song> newSongs = new ArrayList<>();
            Uri collection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL)
                    : MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;

            String[] projection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? new String[]{
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.VOLUME_NAME
                    }
                    : new String[]{
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION
                    };

            String selection = MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC + " != 0";

            try (Cursor cursor = getContentResolver().query(collection, projection, selection, null, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE + " ASC")) {
                if (cursor != null) {
                    int idColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID);
                    int titleColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE);
                    int artistColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST);
                    int dataColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA);
                    int durationColumn = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION);
                    int volumeColumn = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                            ? cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Audio.Media.VOLUME_NAME) : -1;

                    while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                        long id = cursor.getLong(idColumn);
                        String title = cursor.getString(titleColumn);
                        String artist = cursor.getString(artistColumn);
                        String data = cursor.getString(dataColumn);
                        long duration = cursor.getLong(durationColumn);

                        // Safe for Android 10 (API 29) and Android 11+ (API 30+): uses 1-arg getContentUri + withAppendedId
                        Uri contentUri;
                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && volumeColumn != -1) {
                            String volName = cursor.getString(volumeColumn);
                            if (volName != null && !volName.isEmpty()) {
                                contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(volName), id);
                            } else {
                                contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                            }
                        } else {
                            contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                        }

                        if (!AudioFilterManager.shouldExcludeTrack(getApplicationContext(), title, data, duration)) {
                            Song temp = new Song(title, artist, contentUri, duration);
                            SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(getApplicationContext(), temp, false);
                            newSongs.add(temp);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            mainHandler.post(() -> {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                songList.clear();
                songList.addAll(newSongs);
                displayedList.clear();
                displayedList.addAll(songList);

                if (adapter == null) {
                    adapter = new SongAdapter(displayedList, this);
                    recyclerSongs.setAdapter(adapter);
                    animateRecyclerViewEntrance();
                } else {
                    adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();
                }

                updateLibraryStats();
            });
        });
    }

    private void animateRecyclerViewEntrance() {
        if (recyclerSongs == null || recyclerSongs.getAdapter() == null) return;
        LayoutAnimationController controller = AnimationUtils.loadLayoutAnimation(this, R.anim.layout_anim_fall_down);
        recyclerSongs.setLayoutAnimation(controller);
        recyclerSongs.getAdapter().notifyDataSetChanged();
        recyclerSongs.scheduleLayoutAnimation();
    }

    private void updateLibraryStats() {
        if (textLibraryStats != null) {
            textLibraryStats.setText(getString(R.string.library_stats_fmt, displayedList.size()));
        }
        Chip chipAll = findViewById(R.id.chip_all_songs);
        if (chipAll != null) {
            chipAll.setText(getString(R.string.chip_all_tracks_fmt, songList.size()));
        }
        if (emptyStateContainer != null) {
            emptyStateContainer.setVisibility(displayedList.isEmpty() ? View.VISIBLE : View.GONE);
        }
    }

    @Override
    public void onSongClick(int position) {
        if (mediaController != null && position >= 0 && position < displayedList.size()) {
            List<MediaItem> mediaItems = PlaybackStateHelper.buildAdaptiveQueue(displayedList);
            mediaController.setMediaItems(mediaItems, position, 0);
            mediaController.prepare();

        }
    }

    @Override

        Song clicked = displayedList.get(position);
        Intent editIntent = new Intent(this, EditTrackActivity.class);

    }

    public void onSongAiCleanClick(int position) {
        if (position < 0 || position >= displayedList.size()) return;
        Song target = displayedList.get(position);
        Toast.makeText(this, "✨ Dual-AI cleaning tags for \"" + target.getTitle() + "\"...", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        OpenRouterAiHelper.autoCleanSongMetadata(this, target.getTitle(), target.getArtist(), (cleanTitle, cleanArtist, usedCloudAi) -> {
            if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
            target.setTitle(cleanTitle);
            target.setArtist(cleanArtist);
            SongMetadataManager.saveSongEdit(this, target, cleanTitle, cleanArtist, target.getCustomCoverUri(), target.getLyrics());
            if (adapter != null) adapter.notifyItemChanged(position);
            Toast.makeText(this, (usedCloudAi ? "✨ Cloud AI: " : "✨ Smart Parser: ") + cleanTitle + " — " + cleanArtist, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        });
    }

    private void bounceMiniPlayer() {
        if (miniPlayerContainer != null) {
            miniPlayerContainer.animate().cancel();
            miniPlayerContainer.animate()
                    .scaleX(0.97f)
                    .scaleY(0.97f)
                    .setDuration(90)
                    .setInterpolator(UiAnimationHelper.DECELERATE)
                    .withLayer()
                    .withEndAction(() -> miniPlayerContainer.animate()
                            .scaleX(1.0f)
                            .scaleY(1.0f)
                            .setDuration(220)
                            .setInterpolator(UiAnimationHelper.OVERSHOOT)
                            .withLayer()
                            .start())
                    .start();
        }
    }

    private void setupMiniPlayer() {
        if (btnPlayPause != null) {
            btnPlayPause.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (mediaController != null) {
                    if (mediaController.isPlaying()) mediaController.pause();
                    else mediaController.play();
                }
            });
        }
        if (btnNext != null) {
            btnNext.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (mediaController != null) mediaController.seekToNext();
            });
        }
        if (miniPlayerContainer != null) {
            miniPlayerContainer.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                startActivity(new Intent(MainActivity.this, NowPlayingActivity.class));
                overridePendingTransition(R.anim.slide_up_in, 0);
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStart() {
        super.onStart();
        SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
        final ListenableFuture<MediaController> future = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
        controllerFuture = future;
        future.addListener(() -> {
            if (future != controllerFuture || future.isCancelled() || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }
            try {
                mediaController = future.get();
                mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                syncMiniPlayerUI();
            } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | CancellationException ignored) {
            }
        }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (initialScanTriggered) {
            initialScanTriggered = false;
        } else {
            checkPermissionAndScan();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStop() {
        super.onStop();
        if (mediaController != null) {
            PlaybackStateHelper.saveLastPlayedState(this, mediaController);
            mediaController.removeListener(playerListener);
            mediaController = null;
        }
        if (controllerFuture != null) {
            MediaController.releaseFuture(controllerFuture);
            controllerFuture = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        if (scanExecutor != null) {
            scanExecutor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    private void syncMiniPlayerUI() {
        PlaybackStateHelper.syncMiniPlayerView(
                this,
                mediaController,
                miniPlayerContainer,
                miniTitle,
                miniSubtitle,
                miniArt,
                btnPlayPause
        );
    }
