    private void loadLocalTracksAsync() {
        scanExecutor.execute(() -> {
            List<Song> loaded = new ArrayList<>();
            Uri collection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL)
                    : MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;

            String[] proj = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? new String[]{MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE, MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION, MediaStore.Audio.Media.VOLUME_NAME}
                    : new String[]{MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE, MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA, MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION};

            int favCounter = 0;
            try (Cursor c = getContentResolver().query(collection, proj, MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC + " != 0", null, MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE + " ASC")) {
                if (c != null) {
                    int idCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID);
                    int tCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE);
                    int aCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST);
                    int dCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA);
                    int durCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION);
                    int volCol = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                            ? c.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.Audio.Media.VOLUME_NAME) : -1;

                    while (c.moveToNext()) {
                        long id = c.getLong(idCol);
                        String title = c.getString(tCol);
                        String artist = c.getString(aCol);
                        String data = c.getString(dCol);
                        long duration = c.getLong(durCol);

                        if (AudioFilterManager.shouldExcludeTrack(getApplicationContext(), title, data, duration)) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        Uri uri;
                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && volCol != -1) {
                            String vol = c.getString(volCol);
                            uri = (vol != null && !vol.isEmpty())
                                    ? ContentUris.withAppendedId(MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(vol), id)
                                    : ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                        } else {
                            uri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(collection, id);
                        }

                        Song s = new Song(title, artist, uri, duration);
                        SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(getApplicationContext(), s, false);
                        loaded.add(s);
                        if (SongMetadataManager.isFavorite(getApplicationContext(), uri.toString())) {
                            favCounter++;
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            final int finalFavCount = favCounter;
            mainHandler.post(() -> {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                allSongs.clear();
                allSongs.addAll(loaded);
                if (tvFavCount != null) {
                    tvFavCount.setText(getString(R.string.favourites_count_fmt, finalFavCount));
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private void showCreatePlaylistDialog() {
        if (allSongs.isEmpty()) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "No local tracks available", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            return;
        }
        EditText nameInput = new EditText(this);
        nameInput.setHint("Playlist Name (e.g., Roadtrip Hi-Res)");
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Create New Playlist")
                .setView(nameInput)
                .setPositiveButton("Select Tracks", (d, w) -> {
                    String name = nameInput.getText().toString().trim();
                    if (!name.isEmpty()) showTrackPickerDialog(name);
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void showTrackPickerDialog(String playlistName) {
        String[] labels = new String[allSongs.size()];
        boolean[] checked = new boolean[allSongs.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < allSongs.size(); i++) {
            labels[i] = allSongs.get(i).getTitle() + " — " + allSongs.get(i).getArtist();
        }
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this)
                .setTitle("Add Tracks to " + playlistName)
                .setMultiChoiceItems(labels, checked, (d, which, isChecked) -> checked[which] = isChecked)
                .setPositiveButton("Save Playlist", (d, w) -> {
                    JSONArray uris = new JSONArray();
                    for (int i = 0; i < checked.length; i++) {
                        if (checked[i]) uris.put(allSongs.get(i).getUri().toString());
                    }
                    saveCustomPlaylist(playlistName, uris);
                    renderCustomPlaylists();
                })
                .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                .show();
    }

    private void saveCustomPlaylist(String name, JSONArray trackUris) {
        try {
            SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_PLAYLISTS, MODE_PRIVATE);
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(prefs.getString(KEY_JSON, "{}"));
            root.put(name, trackUris);
            prefs.edit().putString(KEY_JSON, root.toString()).apply();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    private void renderCustomPlaylists() {
        if (containerCustomPlaylists == null) return;
        containerCustomPlaylists.removeAllViews();
        try {
            SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences(PREFS_PLAYLISTS, MODE_PRIVATE);
            JSONObject root = new JSONObject(prefs.getString(KEY_JSON, "{}"));
            Iterator<String> keys = root.keys();
            while (keys.hasNext()) {
                String name = keys.next();
                JSONArray arr = root.optJSONArray(name);
                int count = arr != null ? arr.length() : 0;

                LinearLayout card = new LinearLayout(this);
                card.setOrientation(LinearLayout.VERTICAL);
                card.setBackgroundResource(R.drawable.bg_rounded_card_12dp);
                int pad = (int) (14 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
                card.setPadding(pad, pad, pad, pad);
                LinearLayout.LayoutParams lp = new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(
                        LinearLayout.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, LinearLayout.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT);
                lp.bottomMargin = (int) (8 * getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);
                card.setLayoutParams(lp);

                TextView title = new TextView(this);
                title.setText(name);
                title.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_primary));
                title.setTextSize(15f);

                TextView sub = new TextView(this);
                sub.setText(count + " tracks • Tap to play • Long-press to export .M3U");
                sub.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, R.color.text_secondary));
                sub.setTextSize(12f);

                card.addView(title);
                card.addView(sub);

                card.setOnClickListener(v -> playCustomPlaylist(name, arr));
                card.setOnLongClickListener(v -> {
                    exportPlaylistM3u(name, arr);
                    return true;
                });
                containerCustomPlaylists.addView(card);
            }
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    private void playCustomPlaylist(String name, JSONArray uriArray) {
        if (uriArray == null || uriArray.length() == 0) return;
        List<Song> queue = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < uriArray.length(); i++) {
            String u = uriArray.optString(i, "");
            for (Song s : allSongs) {
                if (s.getUri().toString().equals(u)) {
                    queue.add(s);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        if (!queue.isEmpty()) {
            playSongQueue(queue, "Playing \"" + name + "\"");
        }
    }

    private void exportPlaylistM3u(String name, JSONArray uriArray) {
        try {
            File dir = new File(SongMetadataManager.getStorageDirectory(this), "playlists");
            if (!dir.exists()) {
                //noinspection ResultOfMethodCallIgnored
                dir.mkdirs();
            }
            File m3u = new File(dir, name.replaceAll("[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]", "_") + ".m3u");
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder("#EXTM3U\n");
            if (uriArray != null) {
                for (int i = 0; i < uriArray.length(); i++) {
                    sb.append(uriArray.optString(i)).append("\n");
                }
            }
            try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(m3u)) {
                fos.write(sb.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
            }
            Toast.makeText(this, "Exported: " + m3u.getAbsolutePath(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "Export failed", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
        }
    }

    private void playSongQueue(List<Song> songs, String toastMessage) {
        if (mediaController == null || songs.isEmpty()) return;
        List<MediaItem> items = PlaybackStateHelper.buildAdaptiveQueue(songs);
        mediaController.setMediaItems(items, 0, 0);
        mediaController.prepare();
        mediaController.play();
        syncMiniPlayerUI();
        Toast.makeText(this, toastMessage, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    }

    private void setupMiniPlayer() {
        if (btnPlayPause != null) {
            btnPlayPause.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (mediaController != null) {
                    if (mediaController.isPlaying()) mediaController.pause();
                    else mediaController.play();
                }
            });
        }
        if (btnNext != null) {
            btnNext.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (mediaController != null) mediaController.seekToNext();
            });
        }
        if (miniPlayerContainer != null) {
            miniPlayerContainer.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                startActivity(new Intent(this, NowPlayingActivity.class));
                overridePendingTransition(R.anim.slide_up_in, 0);
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStart() {
        super.onStart();
        SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
        final ListenableFuture<MediaController> future = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
        controllerFuture = future;
        future.addListener(() -> {
            if (future != controllerFuture || future.isCancelled() || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
            try {
                mediaController = future.get();
                mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                syncMiniPlayerUI();
            } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | CancellationException ignored) {
            }
        }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStop() {
        super.onStop();
        if (mediaController != null) {
            mediaController.removeListener(playerListener);
            mediaController = null;
        }
        if (controllerFuture != null) {
            MediaController.releaseFuture(controllerFuture);
            controllerFuture = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        if (scanExecutor != null) {
            scanExecutor.shutdownNow();
        }
    }

    private void syncMiniPlayerUI() {
        PlaybackStateHelper.syncMiniPlayerView(
                this,
                mediaController,
                miniPlayerContainer,
                miniTitle,
                miniSubtitle,
                miniArt,
                btnPlayPause
        );
    }

    private void scanStorageAndAudioFolders() {
        updateStorageCardUI();
        Handler handler = new Handler(Looper.getMainLooper());

        scanExecutor.execute(() -> {
            Map<String, List<Song>> groupedSongs = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            Map<String, Long> groupedBytes = new LinkedHashMap<>();
            long audioBytesSum = 0;

            Uri collection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL)
                    : MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;

            String[] projection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? new String[]{
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.SIZE,
                        MediaStore.MediaColumns.VOLUME_NAME
                    }
                    : new String[]{
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.SIZE
                    };

            String selection = MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC + " != 0";
            String sortOrder = MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE + " ASC";

            try (Cursor cursor = getApplicationContext().getContentResolver().query(
                    collection, projection, selection, null, sortOrder)) {
                if (cursor != null) {
                    int idCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media._ID);
                    int titleCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE);
                    int artistCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.ARTIST);
                    int durCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION);
                    int dataCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA);
                    int sizeCol = cursor.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.SIZE);
                    int volumeCol = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                            ? cursor.getColumnIndex(MediaStore.MediaColumns.VOLUME_NAME) : -1;

                    while (cursor.moveToNext()) {
                        long id = cursor.getLong(idCol);
                        String title = cursor.getString(titleCol);
                        String artist = cursor.getString(artistCol);
                        long duration = cursor.getLong(durCol);
                        String fullPath = cursor.getString(dataCol);
                        long fileSize = cursor.getLong(sizeCol);

                        if (AudioFilterManager.shouldExcludeTrack(getApplicationContext(), title, fullPath, duration)) {
                            continue;
                        }

                        audioBytesSum += Math.max(0, fileSize);

                        Uri contentUri;
                        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && volumeCol != -1) {
                            String volumeName = cursor.getString(volumeCol);
                            if (volumeName != null && !volumeName.isEmpty()) {
                                contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(volumeName), id);
                            } else {
                                contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                                        MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, id);
                            }
                        } else {
                            contentUri = ContentUris.withAppendedId(
                                    MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI, id);
                        }

                        if (title == null || title.isEmpty()) title = "Unknown Track";
                        if (artist == null || artist.isEmpty()) artist = "Unknown Artist";

                        Song song = new Song(title, artist, contentUri, duration);
                        SongMetadataManager.applySavedEdits(getApplicationContext(), song, false);

                        String parentPath = "/storage/Music";
                        if (fullPath != null) {
                            File f = new File(fullPath);
                            if (f.getParent() != null) parentPath = f.getParent();
                        }

                        groupedSongs.computeIfAbsent(parentPath, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(song);
                        groupedBytes.put(parentPath, groupedBytes.getOrDefault(parentPath, 0L) + Math.max(0, fileSize));
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            final long finalAudioBytes = audioBytesSum;
            handler.post(() -> {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                totalAudioBytes = finalAudioBytes;
                folderSongsMap.clear();
                folderSongsMap.putAll(groupedSongs);
                folderBytesMap.clear();
                folderBytesMap.putAll(groupedBytes);

                updateStorageCardUI();
                sortAndRender();
            });
        });
    }

    private void sortAndRender() {
        allFolders.clear();
        for (Map.Entry<String, List<Song>> entry : folderSongsMap.entrySet()) {
            String path = entry.getKey();
            String rawName = new File(path).getName();
            if (rawName.isEmpty()) rawName = path;

            String badge = AudioFilterManager.isMicroSdPath(path) ? "[MicroSD] " : "[Phone] ";
            long bytes = folderBytesMap.getOrDefault(path, 0L);
            allFolders.add(new FolderItem(badge + rawName, path, entry.getValue().size(), bytes));
        }

        if (sortByName) {
            Collections.sort(allFolders, (a, b) -> a.getName().compareToIgnoreCase(b.getName()));
        } else {
            Collections.sort(allFolders, (a, b) -> Long.compare(b.getTotalBytes(), a.getTotalBytes()));
        }

        renderCurrentDirectoryState();
    }

    private void renderCurrentDirectoryState() {
        if (selectedFolderPath == null) {
            textBreadcrumbs.setText(R.string.breadcrumbs_default);
            if (textDirectoriesHeader != null) {
                textDirectoriesHeader.setText("AUDIO DIRECTORIES (" + allFolders.size() + ") • Tap ⋮ or long-press to hide");
                textDirectoriesHeader.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            }
            recyclerFolders.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
            if (textLooseFilesHeader != null) textLooseFilesHeader.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            recyclerLooseFiles.setVisibility(View.GONE);

            recyclerFolders.setAdapter(new FolderAdapter(allFolders, new FolderAdapter.OnFolderClickListener() {
                @Override
                public void onFolderClick(FolderItem folder) {
                    selectedFolderPath = folder.getPath();
                    renderCurrentDirectoryState();
                }

                @Override
                public void onFolderLongClick(FolderItem folder) {
                    new AlertDialog.Builder(FoldersActivity.this)
                            .setTitle("Hide Folder")
                            .setMessage("Hide \"" + folder.getName() + "\" from Auralis Library & Folders?")
                            .setPositiveButton("Hide", (dialog, which) -> {
                                AudioFilterManager.addExcludedFolder(FoldersActivity.this, folder.getPath());
                                scanStorageAndAudioFolders();
                            })
                            .setNegativeButton("Cancel", null)
                            .show();
                }
            }));
        } else {
            String folderName = new File(selectedFolderPath).getName();
            textBreadcrumbs.setText("Storage  >  " + folderName);
            if (textDirectoriesHeader != null) {
                textDirectoriesHeader.setVisibility(View.GONE);
            }
            recyclerFolders.setVisibility(View.GONE);

            if (textLooseFilesHeader != null) {
                textLooseFilesHeader.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);
                textLooseFilesHeader.setText("FILES IN " + folderName.toUpperCase(Locale.US));
            }
            recyclerLooseFiles.setVisibility(View.VISIBLE);

            List<Song> folderSongs = folderSongsMap.getOrDefault(selectedFolderPath, new ArrayList<>());
            bindSongsList(folderSongs);
        }
    }

    private void bindSongsList(List<Song> songs) {
        SongAdapter adapter = new SongAdapter(songs, new SongAdapter.OnSongClickListener() {
            @Override
            public void onSongClick(int position) {
                if (mediaController != null && position >= 0 && position < songs.size()) {
                    List<MediaItem> items = PlaybackStateHelper.buildAdaptiveQueue(songs);
                    mediaController.setMediaItems(items, position, 0);
                    mediaController.prepare();
                    mediaController.play();
                    syncMiniPlayerUI();
                }
            }

            @Override
            public void onSongOptionsClick(int position) {
                if (position < 0 || position >= songs.size()) return;
                Song s = songs.get(position);
                Intent intent = new Intent(FoldersActivity.this, EditTrackActivity.class);
                intent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_URI", s.getUri().toString());
                intent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_TITLE", s.getTitle());
                intent.putExtra("EXTRA_SONG_ARTIST", s.getArtist());
                startActivity(intent);
            }
        });
        recyclerLooseFiles.setAdapter(adapter);
    }

    @Override
    protected void onResume() {
        super.onResume();
        if (initialScanTriggered) {
            initialScanTriggered = false;
        } else {
            scanStorageAndAudioFolders();
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStart() {
        super.onStart();
        SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
        final ListenableFuture<MediaController> future = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
        controllerFuture = future;
        future.addListener(() -> {
            if (future != controllerFuture || future.isCancelled() || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) {
                return;
            }
            try {
                mediaController = future.get();
                mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                syncMiniPlayerUI();
            } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | CancellationException ignored) {
            }
        }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStop() {
        super.onStop();
        if (mediaController != null) {
            mediaController.removeListener(playerListener);
            mediaController = null;
        }
        if (controllerFuture != null) {
            MediaController.releaseFuture(controllerFuture);
            controllerFuture = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        scanExecutor.shutdownNow();
    }

    private void syncMiniPlayerUI() {
        PlaybackStateHelper.syncMiniPlayerView(
                this,
                mediaController,
                miniPlayerContainer,
                miniTitle,
                miniSubtitle,
                miniArt,
                btnPlayPause
        );
    }

    private void refreshIdentityAndStats() {
        if (textUserName != null) {
            textUserName.setText(OpenRouterAiHelper.getProfileName(this));
        }
        FirebaseUser user = null;
        try {
            user = FirebaseAuth.getInstance().getCurrentUser();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }

        if (textUserSubtitle != null) {
            if (user != null) {
                String authInfo = user.isAnonymous()
                        ? "FIREBASE SPARK • ANONYMOUS SESSION"
                        : "FIREBASE SPARK • " + (user.getEmail() != null ? user.getEmail() : "SYNCED");
                textUserSubtitle.setText(authInfo);
            } else {
                textUserSubtitle.setText(R.string.profile_default_subtitle);
            }
        }
        if (tvStatSyncMode != null) {
            tvStatSyncMode.setText(user != null ? "CLOUD" : "100%");
        }

        statsExecutor.execute(() -> {
            int trackCount = 0;
            long totalBytes = 0L;
            Uri collection = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q
                    ? MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(MediaStore.VOLUME_EXTERNAL)
                    : MediaStore.Audio.Media.EXTERNAL_CONTENT_URI;
            String[] proj = new String[]{
                    MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE,
                    MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA,
                    MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION,
                    MediaStore.Audio.Media.SIZE
            };
            try (Cursor c = getContentResolver().query(collection, proj, MediaStore.Audio.Media.IS_MUSIC + " != 0", null, null)) {
                if (c != null) {
                    int tCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.TITLE);
                    int dCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DATA);
                    int durCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.DURATION);
                    int sCol = c.getColumnIndexOrThrow(MediaStore.Audio.Media.SIZE);
                    while (c.moveToNext()) {
                        if (!AudioFilterManager.shouldExcludeTrack(getApplicationContext(),
                                c.getString(tCol), c.getString(dCol), c.getLong(durCol))) {
                            trackCount++;
                            totalBytes += Math.max(0L, c.getLong(sCol));
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            int playlistCount = 0;
            try {
                SharedPreferences plPrefs = getSharedPreferences(PlaylistsActivity.PREFS_PLAYLISTS, MODE_PRIVATE);
                JSONObject obj = new JSONObject(plPrefs.getString(PlaylistsActivity.KEY_JSON, "{}"));
                playlistCount = obj.length();
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }

            final int finalTracks = trackCount;
            final int finalPlaylists = playlistCount;
            final String formattedBytes = Formatter.formatShortFileSize(getApplicationContext(), totalBytes);

            mainHandler.post(() -> {
                if (isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
                if (tvStatTracks != null) tvStatTracks.setText(String.valueOf(finalTracks));
                if (tvStatPlaylists != null) tvStatPlaylists.setText(String.valueOf(finalPlaylists));
                if (tvStatLocalSize != null) tvStatLocalSize.setText(formattedBytes);
            });
        });
    }

                        updateBandLabelAndHardware(bandIdx, progress);
                        if (fromUser) {
                            prefs.edit()
                                    .putInt("eq_band_" + bandIdx, progress)
                                    .putString("eq_preset_name", "CUSTOM")
                                    .apply();
                        }
                    }

                    @Override
                    public void onStartTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {}

                    @Override
                    public void onStopTrackingTouch(SeekBar seekBar) {}
                });
            }
        }

        boolean masterEnabled = prefs.getBoolean("eq_master_enabled", true);
        if (switchEqMaster != null) {
            switchEqMaster.setChecked(masterEnabled);
            updateMasterStatusLabel(masterEnabled);
            switchEqMaster.setOnCheckedChangeListener((b, isChecked) -> {
                prefs.edit().putBoolean("eq_master_enabled", isChecked).apply();
                updateMasterStatusLabel(isChecked);
                setHardwareEffectsEnabled(isChecked);
            });
        }

        Chip chipFlat = findViewById(R.id.chip_eq_flat);
        Chip chipBass = findViewById(R.id.chip_eq_bass);
        Chip chipRock = findViewById(R.id.chip_eq_rock);
        Chip chipElec = findViewById(R.id.chip_eq_electronic);

        if (chipFlat != null) chipFlat.setOnClickListener(v -> applyPreset("FLAT", new int[]{50, 50, 50, 50, 50}));
        if (chipBass != null) chipBass.setOnClickListener(v -> applyPreset("BASS BOOST", new int[]{85, 72, 50, 52, 58}));
        if (chipRock != null) chipRock.setOnClickListener(v -> applyPreset("ROCK", new int[]{75, 62, 44, 68, 80}));
        if (chipElec != null) chipElec.setOnClickListener(v -> applyPreset("ELECTRONIC", new int[]{70, 60, 50, 65, 75}));

        View btnZeroReset = findViewById(R.id.btn_zero_reset);
        if (btnZeroReset != null) {
            btnZeroReset.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                applyPreset("BALANCED", new int[]{50, 50, 50, 50, 50});
                if (chipFlat != null) chipFlat.setChecked(true);
                Toast.makeText(this, "EQ bands reset to 0dB", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
            });
        }

        int bassPct = prefs.getInt("dsp_bass_pct", 65);
        int virtPct = prefs.getInt("dsp_virt_pct", 40);
        applyBassStrength(bassPct);
        applyVirtStrength(virtPct);

        View cardBass = findViewById(R.id.card_bass_boost);
        if (cardBass != null) {
            cardBass.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                int next = (prefs.getInt("dsp_bass_pct", 65) + 25) % 125;
                prefs.edit().putInt("dsp_bass_pct", next).apply();
                applyBassStrength(next);
            });
        }

        View cardVirt = findViewById(R.id.card_virtualizer);
        if (cardVirt != null) {
            cardVirt.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                int next = (prefs.getInt("dsp_virt_pct", 40) + 25) % 125;
                prefs.edit().putInt("dsp_virt_pct", next).apply();
                applyVirtStrength(next);
            });
        }

        if (cardRoute != null) {
            cardRoute.setOnClickListener(v -> AudioRouteHelper.showAudioOutputSwitcher(this));

        miniSubtitle = findViewById(R.id.mini_subtitle);

    private void initHardwareDsp() {
        try {
            int sessionId = PlaybackService.getActiveAudioSessionId();
            hardwareEq = new Equalizer(0, Math.max(0, sessionId));
            hardwareBass = new BassBoost(0, Math.max(0, sessionId));
            hardwareVirt = new Virtualizer(0, Math.max(0, sessionId));

            SharedPreferences prefs = getSharedPreferences(OpenRouterAiHelper.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE);
            boolean enabled = prefs.getBoolean("eq_master_enabled", true);
            setHardwareEffectsEnabled(enabled);
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
                if (bandSeekBars[i] != null) {
                    updateBandLabelAndHardware(i, bandSeekBars[i].getProgress());
                }
            }
            applyBassStrength(prefs.getInt("dsp_bass_pct", 65));
            applyVirtStrength(prefs.getInt("dsp_virt_pct", 40));
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
            // Device audio HAL may restrict session 0 attachment; UI state persists cleanly
        }
    }

    private void setHardwareEffectsEnabled(boolean enabled) {
        try {
            if (hardwareEq != null) hardwareEq.setEnabled(enabled);
            if (hardwareBass != null) hardwareBass.setEnabled(enabled);
            if (hardwareVirt != null) hardwareVirt.setEnabled(enabled);
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    private void applyPreset(String presetName, int[] values) {
        SharedPreferences.Editor editor = getSharedPreferences(OpenRouterAiHelper.PREFS_NAME, MODE_PRIVATE).edit();
        editor.putString("eq_preset_name", presetName);
        for (int i = 0; i < Math.min(5, values.length); i++) {
            editor.putInt("eq_band_" + i, values[i]);
            if (bandSeekBars[i] != null) bandSeekBars[i].setProgress(values[i]);
            updateBandLabelAndHardware(i, values[i]);
        }
        editor.apply();
    }

    private void updateBandLabelAndHardware(int bandIdx, int progress) {
        // Map 0..100 slider to -10dB..+10dB
        int db = Math.round((progress - 50) / 5.0f);
        if (bandGainLabels[bandIdx] != null) {
            String label = db > 0 ? "+" + db + "dB" : db + "dB";
            bandGainLabels[bandIdx].setText(label);
            bandGainLabels[bandIdx].setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(
                    this, db == 0 ? R.color.text_secondary : R.color.accent_blue));
        }
        if (hardwareEq != null) {
            try {
                short numBands = hardwareEq.getNumberOfBands();
                if (bandIdx < numBands) {
                    short[] range = hardwareEq.getBandLevelRange();
                    short minMb = range[0];
                    short maxMb = range[1];
                    short targetMb = (short) (minMb + ((maxMb - minMb) * progress) / 100);
                    hardwareEq.setBandLevel((short) bandIdx, targetMb);
                }
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private void applyBassStrength(int pct) {
        if (circularBass != null) circularBass.setProgress(pct);
        if (tvBassPct != null) tvBassPct.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "%d%%", pct));
        if (hardwareBass != null) {
            try {
                hardwareBass.setStrength((short) (pct * 10));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private void applyVirtStrength(int pct) {
        if (circularVirt != null) circularVirt.setProgress(pct);
        if (tvVirtPct != null) tvVirtPct.setText(String.format(Locale.US, "%d%%", pct));
        if (hardwareVirt != null) {
            try {
                hardwareVirt.setStrength((short) (pct * 10));
            } catch (Exception ignored) {
            }
        }
    }

    private void updateMasterStatusLabel(boolean enabled) {
        if (tvEngineStatus == null) return;
        tvEngineStatus.setText(enabled ? R.string.eq_engine_status_active : R.string.eq_engine_status_bypassed);
        tvEngineStatus.setTextColor(ContextCompat.getColor(this, enabled ? R.color.accent_blue : R.color.text_secondary));
    }

    private void setupMiniPlayer() {
        if (btnPlayPause != null) {
            btnPlayPause.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (mediaController != null) {
                    if (mediaController.isPlaying()) mediaController.pause();
                    else mediaController.play();
                }
            });
        }
        if (btnNext != null) {
            btnNext.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                if (mediaController != null) mediaController.seekToNext();
            });
        }
        if (miniPlayerContainer != null) {
            miniPlayerContainer.setOnClickListener(v -> {
                startActivity(new Intent(this, NowPlayingActivity.class));
                overridePendingTransition(R.anim.slide_up_in, 0);
            });
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStart() {
        super.onStart();
        AudioRouteHelper.bindRouteViews(this, tvRouteName, tvRouteSub, iconHeadphone);
        routeCallback = AudioRouteHelper.registerLiveRouteCallback(this,
                () -> AudioRouteHelper.bindRouteViews(this, tvRouteName, tvRouteSub, iconHeadphone));

        SessionToken sessionToken = new SessionToken(this, new ComponentName(this, PlaybackService.class));
        final ListenableFuture<MediaController> future = new MediaController.Builder(this, sessionToken).buildAsync();
        controllerFuture = future;
        future.addListener(() -> {
            if (future != controllerFuture || future.isCancelled() || isFinishing() || isDestroyed()) return;
            try {
                mediaController = future.get();
                mediaController.addListener(playerListener);
                syncMiniPlayerUI();
            } catch (ExecutionException | InterruptedException | CancellationException ignored) {
            }
        }, ContextCompat.getMainExecutor(this));
    }

    @Override
    protected void onStop() {
        super.onStop();
        AudioRouteHelper.unregisterLiveRouteCallback(this, routeCallback);
        routeCallback = null;
        if (mediaController != null) {
            mediaController.removeListener(playerListener);
            mediaController = null;
        }
        if (controllerFuture != null) {
            MediaController.releaseFuture(controllerFuture);
            controllerFuture = null;
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void onDestroy() {
        super.onDestroy();
        try {
            if (hardwareEq != null) hardwareEq.release();
            if (hardwareBass != null) hardwareBass.release();
            if (hardwareVirt != null) hardwareVirt.release();
        } catch (Exception ignored) {
        }
    }

    private void syncMiniPlayerUI() {
        PlaybackStateHelper.syncMiniPlayerView(
                this,
                mediaController,
                miniPlayerContainer,
                miniTitle,
                miniSubtitle,
                miniArt,
                btnPlayPause
        );
    }

## Summary of Implemented Changes

1. **Offline-First Automatic Error Reporting (Store & Forward)**
   - Registered [AuralisApplication](class://com.thando1402.auralis.AuralisApplication) ([AuralisApplication.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/AuralisApplication.java)) in [AndroidManifest.xml](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml#L20) so [init](method://com.thando1402.auralis.AuralisTelemetryManager#init) attaches `Thread.setDefaultUncaughtExceptionHandler` at process startup rather than only inside [FoldersActivity](class://com.thando1402.auralis.FoldersActivity).
   - Updated [AuralisTelemetryManager](class://com.thando1402.auralis.AuralisTelemetryManager) ([AuralisTelemetryManager.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/AuralisTelemetryManager.java#L69-L138)) to serialize crash details (`stackTrace`, ISO-8601 `timestamp`, `androidVersion`, `deviceModel`, `threadName`, `ramUsedMb`, `apkSize`) into `context.getFilesDir()/auralis_crash_reports.json` (`fsync`-flushed) and enqueue [CrashReportSyncWorker](class://com.thando1402.auralis.CrashReportSyncWorker) ([CrashReportSyncWorker.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/CrashReportSyncWorker.java)) via `WorkManager` with `NetworkType.CONNECTED` and exponential backoff, plus an R8 constructor keep rule in [rules.keep](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/keepRules/rules.keep).

2. **Cover Art Tags Positioning**
   - Moved `badges_container` (`badge_lossless_master` + `badge_dsp_balanced`) out of `fullbleed_art_container` and anchored it directly below `lyrics_live_card` in [activity_now_playing.xml](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/res/layout/activity_now_playing.xml#L161-L202), with `metadata_layout` anchored below `badges_container`.

   - Updated [getDedicatedLyricsBackupDir](method://com.thando1402.auralis.SongMetadataManager#getDedicatedLyricsBackupDir) and [resolveLyricsWithFallback](method://com.thando1402.auralis.SongMetadataManager#resolveLyricsWithFallback) in [SongMetadataManager.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/SongMetadataManager.java#L62-L195) to write edited `.lrc` files to `Android/data/com.thando1402.auralis/files/Auralis/Lyrics/` and check that folder **first**, falling back to saved JSON edits, sidecar `.lrc` files, and embedded ID3v2 `USLT` / FLAC Vorbis `LYRICS` tags.

## Complete Code Review (Bugs, Performance & UI/UX Findings Fixed)

### Critical & Functional Bugs Fixed
- **Android 10 (API 29) `NoSuchMethodError` Crash:** [MainActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/MainActivity.java#L383-L390) and [PlaylistsActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/PlaylistsActivity.java#L200-L205) previously called the 2-argument `MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(String, long)` inside `SDK_INT >= Q` (API 29), even though that overload was added in **API 30 (`R`)**. Replaced with `ContentUris.withAppendedId(MediaStore.Audio.Media.getContentUri(volName), id)` (safe on API 29+).
- **Debug AppCheck Leaked into Release APK:** Moved `com.google.firebase:firebase-appcheck-debug:20.0.0` from `implementation` to `debugImplementation` in [app/build.gradle.kts](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/build.gradle.kts#L65) and guarded [initFirebaseAppCheck](method://com.thando1402.auralis.OpenRouterAiHelper#initFirebaseAppCheck) via reflection so release builds exclude debug tokens.
- **Unpersisted Track Metadata Fields:** [EditTrackActivity](class://com.thando1402.auralis.EditTrackActivity) previously bound `editAlbum`, `editNum`, and `editYearGenre` in UI without reading or saving them. Wired full persistence in [saveSongEditFull](method://com.thando1402.auralis.SongMetadataManager#saveSongEditFull) and synchronized JSON cache access under `CACHE_LOCK`.
- **Stale Lyrics & Empty Expandable Lyrics Sheet:** [NowPlayingActivity](class://com.thando1402.auralis.NowPlayingActivity) previously never populated `tv_scrolled_lyrics` and left the previous song's lyrics on screen when transitioning to an instrumental track. Fixed in [loadAndParseLyrics](method://com.thando1402.auralis.NowPlayingActivity#loadAndParseLyrics).
- **Short-Clip Filter Bypassed in Folders:** [FoldersActivity](class://com.thando1402.auralis.FoldersActivity) called the 3-arg `shouldExcludeTrack` overload (hardcoding `30000L`) instead of passing real track `duration`. Fixed in [FoldersActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/FoldersActivity.java#L337).
- **Unwired Screens & Dead Buttons:** Fully wired [EqualizerActivity](class://com.thando1402.auralis.EqualizerActivity) ([EqualizerActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/EqualizerActivity.java)), [ProfileSettingsActivity](class://com.thando1402.auralis.ProfileSettingsActivity) ([ProfileSettingsActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/ProfileSettingsActivity.java)), Now Playing's `btn_eq_profile` & `btn_switch_audio_route`, and folder rows' `btn_folder_options` in [FolderAdapter.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/FolderAdapter.java#L49-L66).

### Nokia 1.4 Performance & UI/UX Optimizations
- **Eliminated Main-Thread Bitmap & MediaStore Stutter:** Moved `Bitmap` decoding + `Palette` generation off the UI thread in [NowPlayingActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/NowPlayingActivity.java#L522-L558) and [PlaybackStateHelper.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/PlaybackStateHelper.java#L204-L218) (downsampled to `512px` / `128px` `RGB_565` via [ArtworkColorHelper](class://com.thando1402.auralis.ArtworkColorHelper)), and moved [loadLocalTracksAsync](method://com.thando1402.auralis.PlaylistsActivity#loadLocalTracksAsync) onto a background executor.
- **Eliminated Activity Stack Leak & Duplicate Startup Scans:** Added `FLAG_ACTIVITY_REORDER_TO_FRONT | FLAG_ACTIVITY_SINGLE_TOP` in [NavigationHelper.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/NavigationHelper.java#L31-L34) and guarded `onCreate` + `onResume` from running duplicate `MediaStore` scans on launch in [MainActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/MainActivity.java#L545-L551) and [FoldersActivity.java](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/java/com/thando1402/auralis/FoldersActivity.java#L493-L499).
- **Eliminated 2x Full-Bleed Overdraw & Screen Cramping on 720×1600:** Removed the redundant `iv_fullscreen_backdrop_art` behind `iv_hero_album_art` and capped `fullbleed_art_container` (`app:layout_constraintHeight_max="288dp"`) in [activity_now_playing.xml](file:///C:/Users/A/AndroidStudioProjects/Auralis/app/src/main/res/layout/activity_now_playing.xml#L11-L37) so lyrics, badges, seekbar, transport controls, and audio route card fit cleanly without overlapping on compact HD+ screens.
